text: Couldn't wear,... Def runs smaller, rented a 2 should've went with a 4, very low cut, need to forgo or have a very deep cut bra. Will try to size up in the future.

Simple, sexy and Unique First -- this is a 5 star dress, but I couldn't get the 5th star to show up on the site!  The fit was perfect, the fabric was substantial -- it looks very rich and expensive.   For the first time ever at a formal event -- I didn't need to wear spanx. The dress is very forgiving below the bodice. 
I love the pockets.   I don't think sleeveless dresses always are the best choice for older women -- and this is a perfect alternative.   Got lots of compliments and would wear it again.

Winery Wedding Got it to wear to a wedding at a winery.  Loved the dress but felt the navy was too dark and not bold enough for the wedding I was attending.  I decided to go with the my 2nd dress option.  Loved this though. The open back was great and loved how this fit.  I would rent this again for another event.

This was a very pretty dress. I received lots of compliments! I did think it ran pretty large. I wore the smaller size that I ordered (my usual size) and it was large in the chest and just kind of throughout. Also, it was hard to keep the crochet from catching on everything. Overall though I still loved it and felt good in it.
really into Ikat lately and the black & white makes it easy to put with anything else. i felt like the dress ran a tad too small and was kind of strangling me. loved the heavy cotton fabric.
nothing This sweatshirt is cute.  Can be worn for work or play.  It stretched out throughout the day which is why I gave it three stars.  I'm not sure I would rent again but if I did I'd size down.

This jacket is gorgeous.  I sized up due to my bust but the shoulders were huge.  The color is gorgeous, the fabric is smooth and fresh.  I would rent again but not size up for my bust.  The shoulders were hanging over, but the cut and fabric were still elegant.  It runs large.  IF you vary from a six to a ten in fitted dresses, do not size up for this jacket.

Perfect for Fall!  The jacket is adorable and perfect for a casual fall day/night out. Sleeves run a bit tight but be careful sizing up as the body of the jacket is trapeze-like and may fit wider than you'd like.
Lovely color and fabric Needed to size down on this dress, but it was still lovely.
Great weekend sweater!  Soft knit with interesting details at the neck. I ordered a medium.  It was very slouchy but not a bad look for the style.  You could definitely size down on this sweater.

Great dress for a fun night out! This is a fun, sexy dress for a night out. I am pear-shaped and usually shy away from dresses that fit snugly around the hips, but I'm so glad I read the reviews and went for it. The fabric is thick and stretchy and creates a smooth silhouette. I was worried the sheer cut-outs would be a bit much but the deep blue classes it up. My only fit complaint was that the hem of the sleeve was too tight on my forearms. Otherwise the dress (the larger of the two sizes I ordered) fit like a glove.

Gorgeous but runs large, hi-maintenance fit Let me start by saying this is an absolutely gorgeous dress. The colors are vibrant and the design is elegant and classy yet slightly edgy. I received loads of compliments on it at the wedding. The material hangs beautifully and I can see this being worn to events year around as well. I’m 5’4”, 32C and usually a size 2 and I barely fit in the 2R. This was already a backup dress and 0R was not available at that point. I was worried about the straps falling down during the event, which took away from my enjoyment of the event. I wouldn’t recommend renting this dress if you have a shorter torso or are shorter than 5’4” because the straps are not adjustable. Heels a must. If you do rent this dress, I recommend wearing pasties as even a nubra would show. Also the ribbon straps for hanging are at the top of the straps for some reason so I recommend some fashion tape to make them stay inside. Fashion tape may also be useful for the front to avoid gaping. I would rent again for the look not the fit.

Maybe if you're short If you're 5'7" or taller, this isn't a good choice.  I didn't end up wearing this one because it was too short in the stride and almost too short overall, even the Long.  I'm only 5'7" and am short-waisted, so this was disappointing.  Otherwise, the color is really pretty.  Also extremely low cut, but there was a snap in place to keep the girls from completely hanging out.
Great for larger bust, very flattering shape Shorter than I expected, but adorable.  Top is very stretchy, so it worked well with a big bust and wider waist.

Perfect Fit Absolutely loved this dress! It is very form fitting but without the super spandex feeling. I had so many compliments on the dress I lost count! Even the bride told me my dress was fantastic!
Wore for work and the weekend with both black and blue jeans Fits on the large size, sleeves are quite flared. Got a lot of compliments. The colours are really striking.
Runs small Cute jacket. As others have said, it runs small. I wish I had sized up to a medium. It was still very cute and great for casual outings.

Well - I was at the Tony's in NYC and that was what made it a great experience. I marked this as fitting true to size - but having a short waist and largish ribcage - it was quite tight around the middle.  Spanx helped.  I did get a lot of compliments on the dress.  The off shoulder straps weren't quite the same as in the picture.

Fun everyday top I've been trying to mix some basic tops into my unlimited choices and this was a great one to have in the closet.  I wore it multiple times.  It's super comfortable, looks great with capris or skinny jeans and moves well.

My sisters rehearsal dinner I loved this dress. It runs small on bottom so size up to your largest area since its fitted. I ordered the 0 and backup of the 2. Thank goodness for the backup, I might have needed a 4! I am 112lb 5'1".

Great fit, bright pop of color, simultaneously casual & former. I rented this dress for a celebrity charity event where style would range from casual to formal. This piece was a great in between and could've been dressed up more had I needed, with different shoes or accessories. I was glad for the backup size option because I ended up going smaller than my usual dress size. The process was simple and easy.

Unique, sexy, fun The fit was snug but very comfortable. I'm typically a medium but the large was perfect. I did not wear a bra with this and it was find. The low v-neck meant that a normal v-neck was not possible. I'm short and the length hit a couple inches above the knee. Perfect for me.

Great color. Meh dress. The color on this dress is it's best feature -- bright, flamingo pink. Almost day-glo. The styling is just okay, and it runs VERY large. I'm a solid 8 and I think the 4 would've been the best fit for me, though the 6 worked. The dress is a polyester crepe material, and unlined (which is a mistake for this fabric). The neckline and cold shoulders add a bit of visual interest, but otherwise the styling is not super flattering or even fun -- it's a bit too long for anyone under 5'8" and too full. There was also some weird pleating in the back that made the rear look unflattering. Overall, I would not strongly recommend for women with curves or petites.
Just glamorous!  I typically wear a size 4, I fit a size 2. Very flattering for my spare tire!

I got so many compliments on this gorgeous green dress! This dress was a show-stopper! The color was amazing in person! The sleeves were a bit tight on me, which was ultimately why I ended up wearing the large and not the medium. That seems to be pretty common with sequin dresses, though. I wore this to a work-related holiday party and felt like it was the perfect choice!

I rented this dress for my son's wedding. I received many compliments on the dress. Perfect! I am normally a 4 to 6 in dresses but ended up wearing an 8 (British 12) seemed to run small in the bust area. Very comfortable dress though!

Really pretty material and pattern. Fun and casual. This runs small and the material is not stretchy. I usually wear a 2 in stretchy material and a 4 in fabrics that don't give as much. However, in this style I went with the 2 because I thought the 4 would be too billowy. This looked cute while on but the shoulders were very tight so it loses the cold shoulder effect. I had to wear a long cardigan over it which looked cute anyways. Also, the slip dress could only be pulled over my head...there is no way to step into this dress. The skirt is very tight.

Unique Print Loved this dress! There are so many fun ways to accessorize this style. Best part, the bright holographic print which really made it stand out in a crowd! I had to size to up as Milly sizes typically run small for my body type. The size 4 fit perfectly and even had a slimming effect which was a plus!
Cute dress This dress looks better in person than in photos, however, it still wasn't the look I was going for for a wedding. It fit well, I just didn't like so much squareness up top.

The dress ended up being perfect for the weather.  I got a 4, and typically wear a 6, and it fit perfectly. I also had to get one of those stick-on bras because there was no way to hide a bra strap. I also had concerns originally about length, but after seeing another user's pictures, I rented it anyways and it definitely wasn't too short!

Absolutely stunning! I rec'd so many compliments on this dress all night long.  The dress fit as described by other reviewers which was very helpful.  I am 6'2 and the long was perfect.  I had on 3" heels.  I did use fashion tape to hold the top in place as I didn't wear a bra, I was sufficiently supported.  This was my first experience w/ RTR and I can't wait to do it again!  I will NEVER buy another dress.  THANKS!

Gorgeous color! Perfect for a fall wedding! Dress ran on the small side. The sleeves have absolutely no stretch to them so even though the dress for me I could not raise my hands over the head. That made it a bit hard to move around, especially dance. 
Overall I really like this dress just wish the lace sleeves would have had a stretchy material.

Great fit, color, and style!  I'm athletic built with broad shoulder and was nervous the cut would look bad since A-lines tend to look bad on me, but the neckline actually worked out great! The dress was a bit snug and I might've gone a size up, but everyone said the 6 looked good on me - which is my normal size. I would say if you like things painted on get your normal size, but if you like a looser fit definitely get a larger size. Also, the dress was made out of great material and hid any problem areas.

Loved the High-Low Hem...and RTR Customer Service!! I ordered a size 4 (my true size) and a size 2 as backup (based on other reviewers suggestions).  Unfortunately, RTR was unable to ship my backup size, but they MORE than made up for it by sending, not one, but two back up dresses!  Their customer service is beyond measure...I cannot say enough!!  I ended up wearing the original dress in the size they were able to send (the size 4), mainly because the backup dresses were lighter in color, and I decided I preferred a dark color for this event.  It definitely fit well enough and was workable.  I received compliments and my husband thought I looked great (most important!), so I can't complain.  Up close, it was a little looser in the midsection and underarm areas than I would prefer (still wishing I could have tried the size 2), but with a dark dress for an evening holiday event, I can't really say it was noticeable.  I paired with the Mave Lariat Necklace by Gorjana Accessories, which we absolutely LOVED, and gold heels.

It was a great color and I loved the neckline.   The fit was a little on the small side.  I'm so glad I got the 4, I fit in the 2 but it was skin tight.  It was a little tighter then I'd like around my butt.  I still wore it and was fine but a little less comfortable then I'd prefer.

What Copper Dreams Are Made Of This dress runs bigger! I was rocking a 14 week pregnant body and thought I needed extra room but this dress was still bigger. Definitely could size this according to pre-pregnant sizing. But it's a great dress and received a lot of compliments. I did not wear a bra and the length was good. It was a fall wedding. I would rent this again

Nice dress This was my number two option for a New years eve party.  I chose the other dress, to wear,  but this dress was beautiful. I loved the flow of the dress.   I just felt it was a bit chilly to wear a strapless gown in NY.

very cute!! i'm typically btwn 2 and 4, but usually a 6 in E&J because i don't like body con dresses, but the small in this was large. i love the style, very effortless comfort, but found the Small to look too much like a bag. the XS wouldve been perfect. love the pockets and color, very feminine. had to wear a strapless bra, reg bra straps would've shown. hem is a touch above my knee, very appropriate. very light dusty pink, great color for summer!!

Size up, AMAZING I received so many compliments on this dress, it is beautiful and classic. I did size up, I am typically a 0 and I got 6 because I was concerned about the arms. The 6 was big on me, realistically I could have worn a 2 or 4. Size up and you'll be happy!

Perfect for Black Tie Wedding If you are 5'7" or taller and are going to wear heels you must order the dress in Long.  With 3" heels this dress was the perfect length.  The 4L was more comfortable than the 2L with spanx.  I still have a little baby weight on in the mid section.  The top of the dress was snug....decided to go braless with pasties and it worked out fine. The material is pretty thick but I found it perfect for an outdoor wedding in 60°.  Only negative I found was zipping the back of the dress.  Pretty impossible to do it on your own.  Make sure you aren't getting dressed solo so someone can zip you up.  I had to run to my neighbors house for help LOL.

Lovely (once I found the right size). I received so many compliments on this shirt- it's so beautiful and springy. You definitely need to size down. I usually wear a small or even a medium in tops and had to go down to an XS. And it's still big. I did have some minor gapping between two of the buttons in the front, right around my chest area, but I'm willing to overlook it because of how great it otherwise was.

The dress was (enigmatically) simultaneously sexy and conservative. I got compliments all night! The weight of the fabric made this dress so easy to wear; it hid my tummy while revealing my figure. I could easily wear with a strapless bra, an essential for me. There's a slight shimmer to the fabric which made it even more special. I was also happy to find the length was just right even though I'm quite tall.

GORGEOUS dress, got lots of "best dress of the party" comments :) I'm short so this was a good length on me for my work holiday party. The sleeves and neck (couldn't zip it all the way up) were too long, but still looked great. It was really tight so i'm glad i sized up, curvier women would want to go 2 sizes up to get it over your hips to use the ladies room. My mom made me put tights on :D but I'm glad I did. Overall, loved this dress!

Amazing blue off shoulder shirt perfect for summer! Thin fabric so a strapless bra or bandeau is necessary, the straps stay perfectly in place so no need to tug or adjust, really a great staple to wear with white jeans or shorts. Tons of compliments.
The sparkle of the dress!! I love the sparkle & shine of this dress. Fits true to size.

My husband loved it! I think it fit a little large, as the 8 would have been better on me. It did cover the slight tummy I have these days. My husband absolutely loved it and said so several times! That being said, I don't know why (perhaps because it was a little big), but I felt like it was a little frumpy on me. It may have just been looking down and seeing all the ruffles (especially the one right at the stomach). But I got a lot of compliments and it was extremely comfortable and fun to wear!

Comfortable but too old for me. The dress was nice, and very comfortable.  It was really true to size.  However, I am 27 and I felt like I was wearing a dress for a 47 year old.  Very conservative.  Material was interesting though with the texture.

Pretty dress but wouldn't rent again I ended up having to get the 6R overnighted to me. The 4 was way too small in the chest area. I even had difficulty fitting into the 6 due to my bust. I didn't have any other options so I had to make it work. I did receive a lot of compliments and the dress was easy to dance in. I am 5'6" and wore 3 inch heels and the R length was perfect. I was concerned that I might need an L, in length, but luckily that was not the case. I would not rent this dress ever again but it was nice for a black tie wedding.

Sparkle! Wore this as a bridesmaid for a friends wedding and it was perfect!  Our group ranged from 00p - 12 and it fit all of us with no problems.  We took formal photos after the ceremony when the sun was perfectly at "golden hour" and the sparkle from the dress was stunning.  We all got compliments all night long.

Would rent again and again I rented this dress for a friends wedding and it was perfect. Many compliments, very comfortable, loved the pockets and the subtle cutout waist, and was able to dance all night! I normally wear a 4 but ended up wearing my backup size 2. However, if I had larger than a 34B bra size I think I would have stuck with the 4.
Loads of compliments I have a small frame and a larger chest so the extra material was a bit baggy, but overall I really loved this top.  It's such a cool piece for everyday CA occasions!  Boho chic

Classic style but... I get this classic black dress as a replacement. A RTR stylist picked this one for me. I liked it on the website and this dress was in my waitlist. The size was correct but the fabric has like a default on each side of the hips. It looks like the dress was too large but only on this part of the body. It looks weird, that is why I have decided to do not wear that dress. Overall, it should be a good choice if you have large hips. The top of the dress give a pretty look and should be sexy if you wear it without a bra.

n/a I rented this for a 70s themed party and loved the color and length.  I used fashion tape to secure the front, and it ended being fine.  The only thing that was a bit annoying were the snap buttons on the side.  We did a lot of dancing and some of the buttons kept opening.  Otherwise, it was a fabulous jumpsuit, and I received many compliments.
Red Valentino is just amazing!  I love love love all the Red Valentino dresses! Always get compliments while still being me- fun and serious!

Elegant Winter White in a Sea of LBDs I wore this to a cocktail attire holiday party. I got lots of compliments for wearing "winter white" (there was a snowstorm so it was even more appropriate). I usually wear a 0 but the 2 fit like a glove. I thought it was a bit short even on me (I do lean towards a bit more length on my 5 foot body). I was not able to wear spanks but control top hose worked well without showing below the hem. Wore a normal bra. I paired this dress with bright red pumps to make it more festive.

Love the black diamond shaped work around the neck and center area of the dress! :) The fit is loose, perfect for summer, easy to wear and carry! I loved this dress because of the pattern on the dress. The black work on the dress really stands out and when you wear this dress with bold black earrings, makes the dress look very elegant.

I wore this dress after work to my dance class with a pair of black tight slacks under it! :)

Elegant gown and fits true to size I did not actually wear this gown and chose another  Badgley Mischka dress (the Black Jennifer Popover Gown) over this one only because it was more appropriate for a formal Marine Corp Birthday Ball and was a bit more conservative. I would wear this dress. I would caution that it is form fitting and not "forgiving" around the stomach and waist area. I don't know if going up a size would be too big. It is a simple dress and nothing fussy about it so I would take the opportunity to add some great accessories to bedazzle it.

I wore this to a gala at my club.  It fit amazingly. The fabric and color are forgiving. The bottom flairs out, which makes it a great dancing dress. I would definitely recommend going down a size so it's a bit more form fitting. I wore it with simple jewelry (gold earring, necklace, and bracelets and a long pearl necklace) and the ruffle did the rest. So many compliments!
It fit really well and the color is lovely. The hem was way too long. Must wear with high, high heels.
Beautiful dress but a little too big. Beautiful dress but the bust area is way too big. Also, be ready to show some major cleavage because the neckline is really low. Otherwise a great dress.
Cute and comfortable. The boning inside is not very comfortable. Wore with a tee shirt underneath.

Rich color, nice style, runs a little large.  This dress is made of pretty thick material and it ties in back - so it's not the most comfortable if you will be sitting in a chair with a back for any length of time. It's very work appropriate. They style is a little different than the usual - and nice - but there is a lot of material and it wasn't my favorite dress ever. I like a little more body con look.

Head turner... I rented this for a wedding.  I ordered the small and medium.  I would have worn the medium because the length was a bit more appropriate for the evening wedding.  I would have worn the small if I wanted a more sexy, short look.  This dress is gorgeous and both came in excellent condition.  Unfortunately, I could not wear the dress beause the wedding was cancelled due to tahe flooding in Colorado.  I will definitely rent it again when the wedding is rescheduled.

The vibrant color and fun print were perfect for a black tie wedding at the Central Park Zoo! Overall I would highly recommend this dress. I'm a bit top-heavy, so I tend to gravitate towards this type of fit (cinched waist, cross chest), which offers nice coverage but still shows off curves -- and this dress was perfect for my body type! I ordered the 6L because the 6R was sold out, and it was definitely dragging a bit despite very high heels, so I just had to be mindful of that. For someone my height, I would recommend the Regular length. The color/print photographed beautifully!

Fun and funky Believe everyone when they say this runs big. I am 5'7 and weigh around 135 pounds and have serious hips and thighs. The XS fit and was even a tad baggy, the length was mid-thigh. I know the style is meant to be baggy but the sleeves were quite long and the shoulders, chest, waist, and hip areas were also quite big. I liked the fit but if you're looking for something fitted, this is not it. Otherwise, I wore this to a funky Burner party on a rainy summer day, with black Converse shoes, and felt great. Plus my boyfriend really liked it ;)

beautiful color! runs large i'm typically btwn a 2 and a 4 but with NHA KHANH i'm always a 2 and there is generally room to spare. This dress is incredibly comfortable and the color is vibrant. the front ends an inch or so above my knee and the back of the dress hits past my knee. i wore a regular bra with this dress. to create a waist i added a thick brown belt. i also wore nude high heels to dress it up a bit more, but this can easily be worn casually. the color really catches your eye, but the design is just fine. this dress isn't cut to blow anyone away, but i found it perfect for work and after work drinks. this is a dress i would actually want to own because i can see myself wearing it a lot of different ways without it being memorable enough for people to realize i'm wearing the same dress
Gorgeous dress. This dress was beautiful, accentuate curves nicely, however, it's very heavy and I had to constantly pull it up all night.

This dress is gorgeous in person but not for the faint of heart.  Very "va va voom" but tasteful! The dress is slim with some stretch.  If you have any belly, I would say go up a size so you don't get that pooch factor.  Otherwise, very flattering.  I got so many compliments!

Be brave and rent it!  All eyes will be on you! I never thought I'd be able to pull off a bodycon dress, but the sturdy yet forgiving material of the dress hugs your curves in all the right places.  I needed help zipping it up but once it's zipped, it was fine.  A super comfortable dress despite being so form fitting, and it made me LOVE my curves.  It hid and smoothed out other areas of my hips I was worried about.  Because of my pear shape - mainly due to small bust (32A) - the particular push-up bra I needed to wear to fill out the top of the dress actually poked out from underneath the dress straps, but I wore a cropped black cardigan with it anyway and I think most bras would work (if you need one).  I also wore spanx without any line issues.  Wore it on a night out at a speakeasy and won the admiration of the discerning hostess.  This dress will take confidence to try but you'll want to work it once you've got it on!
Party Perfect! This outfit was stylish and comfortable - the perfect combination for a bachelorette party at the beach.
Beautiful dress Received many compliments. I wish the outer skirt was a little tighter but overall a great dress.
Great Romper I would definitely size down, as this was a tad large on me for a Medium. Great Romper.
Didn't wear the dress. Way too big on me. I couldn't even wear it. I probably could have fit in a size 12. It ran very, very large. Otherwise, the fabric is nice and the dress is adorable.

Comfy and versatile Loved it! Fit is slightly loose and makes it easy and comfy to wear. The high side wasn't as high as the sample photo suggests so it was appropriate for my office. Would wear again!

Dancing! This dress is perfect for dancing!! It's such a pretty dress! I got so many compliments on it. The length was perfect - I have a walking boot on because I broke my foot, so I was wearing flats - if i hadn't had the boot on it would have been too long. The only thing I was disappointed in was the zipper. It took so many different people/trys to finally get it to zip! Plus it was just a little big in the shoulder and stomach - but I wouldn't have wanted it to be skin tight

Classy with a little sassy! I rented this dress for a summer garden wedding in the North Shore.  The cobalt color was versatile and looked great with both nude and black pumps, however I went with black for this occasion.  The higher neckline was perfect for pairing the dress with a statement necklace and simple earrings.  Everyone loved the business in the back, party in the front vibe of the dress with the midriff cutout and asymmetrical hemline - which was also great for dancing!
My only gripe about the dress was the midsection is a little tight.  I'm typically a size 2-4 in dresses, but could have potentially worn a size 6 and been more comfortable.   Other than that, I was very happy with this rental!

Dress is a showstopper! I absolutely love this dress!  I wore it on NYE to a black tie affair, and I received so many compliments. It is very elegant, but it is also sexy with the high slit.  It is extremely comfortable.   This dress fit me great for the most part, although it was a little snug in the bust area.  If you are busty...order a size up.

Bright (!) red for outdoor summer wedding
 I rented this dress for an outdoor wedding in North Carolina. The fabric is a gorgeous bright red and had good thickness, but wasn't too hot for a day that reached the mid-80's. I loved the open tie-back on the dress, although it made the bust area a little loose since the knot completes at the lower back. Overall this was a great, breezy dress!

Great Birthday Dress! This dress photographs beautifully.  I am 5'8, 150lbs, hourglass shape but I think this dress could fit just about any body type, the sparkles and the thick material is VERY forgiving and detracts from any flaw you think you might have ;P   I wore a large it fit great, I didn't even try on the Medium, the dress was comfortable, not scratchy at all.  Overall, would HIGHLY recommend for a fun night out!
Beautiful color & intriguing hemline Wish I could have worn this...it was just a little too snug thru the hips for comfort

Fits Amazingly well Very very high quality material and it is lined as well. The fabric has some stretch but fits snugly. Around the abdomen it is not overly tight. The design is subtle and very spring. Wore it to a work function and it was still appropriate. Lovely dress!!

Amazing Jumpsuit! I love a good jumpsuit and I was worried this one was going to fit weird because of the top but it was perfect! It is classy with a bit of a WOW factor because of the off the shoulder top. Perfect for a red carpet look:) Thanks RTR

So glad I picked "just in case" options.  I originally rented Rebecca Minkoff Navy Across the Lines Dress in Size 2 with Size 0 as my back up.  The Size 0 was not available so they sent this dress.  I am SO happy that I chose it and that they sent it.  This was more in line with the occasion I was renting the dress for… my mother’s 70th birthday party.  I normally were Size 2 &4... Taking into consideration all the reviews, I order Size 4 as my main size and then Size 6 as my back up.  I fit in the Size 4, but opted to wear the Size 6 to be comfortable after eating and moving around.  I received so many compliments on how I looked in this dress.  Loved that they all said I looked the same as I did in High School & College!  :-)  I would definitely Size up 1 size from what you typically wear and go up 2 sizes as your backup.

Sexy without being too revealing. Great for winter too. Great dress. The length, fit, and netted sleeves made it sexy for an evening with by boyfriend, without being too revealing or inappropriate for dinner in a nice restaurant. This is the kind of dress that could look cheap or tacky if it wasn't well-made, which it is. The material is thick and the neckline is high, so it felt appropriate for the weather (cold and rainy). I did have to wear a size up than I normally do. It is fitted, so if you have some curves you don't want to completely reveal, I would recommend sizing up. It still fit well and didn't seem oversized. I wore with fashion tape rather than a strapless and that worked better, I think.

One of many dresses that Rent the Runway sent for my Vegas week-end, when my order was delayed. This is a beautiful dress -- well made, classy and gorgeous.  It was a bit downplayed for Vegas, so I chose not to wear it.  I think it would be great for a daytime wedding or other formal day time affair.  The length is classy.

Compliment after compliment! Beautiful blouse! It seems like it will be see through, but it really isn't. I love Equipment blouses and normally the Large is good on me, I like a lot of room in my tops. This one however feels more like an XL, like I can almost wear it as a dress. Super long to tuck into my jeans, but I made it work. Worn with Dark jeans cuffed, a thin nude belt, and nude peep toe Tory Burch wedges = great outfit!

The Perfect Jumpsuit This was my first time ever wearing a jumpsuit so I was a little nervous but it turned out to be a great experience! I fell in love with this the second I put it on. It was so flattering and classy. I was not overly excited about the slits in the legs at first but they actually looked great once I had them on. I wore for an outdoor wedding and it was 100 degrees. The light material kept me cool. The bodice was very form fitting and stayed up very well. I absolutely loved this jumpsuit and I would rent it again. I received SO many compliments on it!

Everyone loved the dress on me! The dress is gorgeous and every thing fit perfectly except for the length. I thought that by renting a regular length I would be fine with my 4 inch heels. It was still very long on me. We pinned up the bottom a bit so I wasn't stepping on it and didn't need to carry it around all night. I wish the length had fit me better because everything else was so perfect and I got complimented on the dress the entire night

Perfect black, short cocktail dress! I was lucky enough to be the first person to wear this dress, as it came with the tags still on! First off, it runs VERY small. I have a petite frame up top (32D), and I normally order size 0 or 2 in tops at most stores. I did some research before ordering since there were no reviews, and I read that when ordering Elizabeth & James, you should order a size up. I decided to order size 2 - size 4 was my backup, but so glad I ordered the backup! Also note that it is short - I included extra full length photos from when I first tried it on. I liked the length, though. Overall, very flattering dress. I received lots of compliments!

Elegance in the front, drama in the back! I rented this for my husband's gala benefit dinner and dance. I usually wear color but decided to go with black this year, and this dress was a great choice.  It's simple, but the fit and back detail make for something special.  The fabric has a nice weight, and I was comfortable dancing all night.  There is no zipper, so I had to step into the gown from the top.  I didn't wear a bra because of the back, but the dress held everything in (and up!) nicely!  I loved it.
Classy, yet trendy! Loved the jacket - wore it to a work meeting and felt polished, yet still fun and trendy. Loved the back slit, was a great conversation starter. :)
Liked it fitting looser so wore 10 Beautiful color and lace fabric fun dress.

The dress color sold me Great dress. Got more than 5 compliments on the color and style. No stretch to the dress so I suggest renting your normal size and one size up. If you are uncomfortable showing a little cleavage this dress is NOT for you.
Dress was sexy without  exposing too much Dress fits like a glove...perfect length with 3 inch heels...very comfortable and  stylish

Runs very large, size down I like the pattern and the style, but this will not look like the picture on the model if you order your normal size. The fit is very loose and baggy. I was able to wear it belted to nip it in a bit, but otherwise it was so baggy it was unwearable. Size down for sure.

Wore this to a pre-screening dinner at Sundance. I dressed it down w/ a short jean jacket & Fluevogs Fit snugly but well. I loved the skirt - just enough 'poof' but light. Made me feel a bit of early 80's spunk - like Madonna's Lucky Star video. I wore black, funky heels from John Fluevog, along with a faded, cropped jean jacket when I got cold.  Most everyone else was in jeans and t-shirts, a few of us 'dressed up,' however I loved it and felt great. It's great getting "dressed for dinner."

This dress made me feel comfortable, sultry and bold. I wore if to my wedding rehearsal and dinner.  Sleeves were long enough but tight. I didn't realize the dress was backless, so last minute had to get some pasties. It might be worth looking into other options. I wore this dress with geometric black tights and black leather heels. Lovely dress.

Sexy sparkle! I rented this for going out in Miami and I loved the low back and the sequins that make you stand out! Fit great, was the perfect "mini" length, although a warning about the design: there is a zipper at the bottom of this dress and it can accidentally ride up in the night to make it more revealing than it should be.
The dress was very comfortable and unique (received a lot of compliments).  Dress runs one size smaller. I am usually a size 4 and ordered a size 6.

Wore it for a wedding. ordered 0 and 2. Wore 2. I carry my weight right where the fitted waist is on this dress. The 0 fit, but felt tight. The 2 gave me more space.  I got several compliments on the dress. Dresses arrived on time and the whole process was easy!

Awesome dress This dress was perfect... conservative, yet showed off the girls quite nicely without being vulgar, and I loved the sparkle!  My only criticism would be that the skirt was a little tight when sitting and there was no slit in it to help with getting in and out of the car.  I would wear it again if I had an event to wear it to!

I have rented quite a few times and this was one of my most favorite dresses. The gown is quite form fitting and so you need to know that, it is a bit stiff but the color is just gorgeous. I wore it to a ball in June, but I could imagine it would be spectacular at a Christmas or Holiday event.

Surprised at how much I loved it I wore this dress twice in one weekend-- once to a work event with a blazer over it, (to tame down the open back) and then once to a party by itself.  SO many complements. numerous people said my butt looked great, which is a first for me.  Just enough shine without being too glittery/ blingy, and fits AMAZINGLY well.  Covers all the right places. Note: I freaked out when I took it out of the bag because the dress looked TINY-- don't panic, it just hangs that way on the hanger!

cute dress, went a size up wore this dress to a bridal shower in the winter. cute fit, fabric was really soft and stretchy. Only received the large, so not sure how the medium would fit. a nice dress with tights for the colder months.
Gorgeous fabric weight! Fit was too small for a standard size 6--really wish the size charts weren't just "true to size" because literally every company uses different measurements for every size.
Great dress! Wore it for my bridal shower. Arrived on time, fit a little big so I went with the smaller size. Received many compliments on the dress. Was very pleased!

Gorgeous, fitted, felt sexy and sophisticated This is a slim fit dress with no give in the fabric. I'm a size 2 in the bust but a size 6 in the hips, and I wore the 4. It was a little loose on top and super tight in the hips. There was a roll in the lining where it was pulled too tight. Wore it anyway, loved it, but grateful I didn't need to move much in it.
Love the love sleeves and low back Comfortable fit, glitzy dress without being too formal. Lined well enough that no bra is needed.
Love this dress! I would definitely rent this dress again. It fit perfectly and I loved the feel and weight of it.
a little large but very pretty This dress was a little large on the top and loose around the waist (not complaining about that). It is very cute a-line. Highly recommend.
Holiday work party  It was a cute dress, but there are pockets in the underneath part, which stuck out awkwardly.

Love the material and length is perfect! Fit is small, especially if you're more busty. The chest area sticks out a lot and has lines like it doesn't fit.  I'm 5'6 and the petite was great for not having tI wear heels too high!

Backyard Country Wedding The purple of this dress was much more vibrant than it appeared on the site, but that worked beautifully for the outdoor wedding we attended. Be warned: this dress is VERY short. I ended up wearing the large slip with the medium lace overlay to make the dress appear longer. At 5'6", I was unable to bend over or sit down without adjusting the dress. I would not recommend this dress for taller gals.
Not for tall women. This is absolutely adorable, but with the length of my torso it simply didn't work for me.  Sad I wasn't able to wear this because I think it is a great outfit!

Got lots of compliments but I was still comfortable I rented this dress for an evening wedding at a hotel near downtown Houston.  The day it was to be shipped I asked for my back up size to be a size larger instead of a size smaller than I normally wear because reviews about it being tight on busty women scared me as I'm a D cup. When I tried on the dress it was large everywhere; my bust, waist, and you could sometimes see my bra because it was so big. I HATE belting things but I HAD to belt this dress or I would've looked like my waist didn't exist. 
NOW did I like the dress, YES. It's gorgeous! I got lots of compliments and I felt super girly and feminine in it. It wasn't too short or tight or uncomfortable. I was able to dance, eat and drink to my hearts desire with no problems. Also my boyfriend liked it and said I looked pretty. I had no problems with the zippers or hooks on the dress, easy to put on and take off. The fabric is thick and has this somewhat quilted pattern sewn into it, which I didn't expect but was fine. It can also photograph shiny which I'm not a huge fan of, but it's not going to ruin my day or anything. 
I would urge you to order a size down as your back up and have a cute belt on standby. I would rent it again but in a size 8 instead of a 10.

Perfect bridesmaid dress for a blush-themed wedding I was nervous about renting a dress for my brother's wedding because if it didn't fit I'd be in a bind, but luckily this dress was true to size and fit my petite frame. It was very long so I opted for 5" wedges, which were more comfortable than heels anyway. The dress was very comfortable and the open back is the perfect little something extra. I received compliments on the dress all night.

Super cute! 
 Loved it.  It was very cute.  I wore it with flip flops because the pockets dressed it down.  Spent the night walking around NYC and it  was perfect.

I didn't end up wearing it I liked this dress and it fit well on me, it just turned out not to fit the occasion I was looking for a dress for.   The colors were beautiful, but I'm not entirely sure how flattering they were to my skin tone (part white/part Asian).
Customer service was great:  Somehow an item I had sent back didn't get scanned in properly, but RTR was nice enough to send this out quickly.

Sexy, short dress I opted to not wear a bra.  The dress is tight enough that you don't need one but I didn't care enough to buy a backless.

The dress was short and sexy and I got a lot of compliments.  The material was much thicker than I expected,

Photographs really well When I first tried it on I was disappointed. I felt like it didn't give me much of a shape or that it wasn't flattering with both a high neckline and back... but it was actually pretty cute. I loved the way it looked in photos and once my hair and makeup were done, it was perfect for NYE. I'm a size 4 in dresses so I almost rented the small and backup medium, but I ordered the small and backup XS. I ended up wearing the XS because I liked the length and color better; it fit perfectly.
I absolutely loved this dress & received so many compliments on it! The fit was perfect.

Total. Knockout. To be honest, I was SUPER nervous about renting this jumpsuit. I have never rented/worn one, but I wanted to really bring it at this wedding of people I consider to be very fashionable. So I took a leap of faith (sort of, I also rented a backup dress that I ended up wearing to the rehearsal dinner, haha!) and rented it. 
PROS: I have never gotten so many compliments on an outfit from men. I mean it, everyone, ladies and gents alike, was giving me mad props and compliments. I was frequently told it was "on point" - which it was ;). The color is so incredibly gorgeous and rich in person. You can accessorize it with just about anything - I went with less is more. It made tearing up the dance floor such fun since I didn't have to worry about accidentally flashing anything. The fabric was just stretchy enough to be comfortable and form-fitting in the right places without being clingy. The length was about an 1" shorter than I would have preferred, but it still worked well with heels. Going to the bathroom was totally doable alone.
CONS: This thing came wrinkled as a pug. I should have taken a picture. I pretty much gave it a wrinkle-release bath and everything fell out just fine, but just be prepared for that. Also, where the fabric creases when you sit, will wrinkle slightly throughout the night, but nothing too noticeable. 
SIZING: If you have a moderate to long torso, size up. Do not worry about being busty, the back is open and will stretch to fit in most cases. I wore the MR. Although it was a little loose in the waist, It fit perfectly everywhere else. I got a lot of comments that it fit like a glove. The SR on the other hand, was way too short in the torso.

If you are on the fence and scouring reviews looking for a jumpsuit that you can feel confident about renting like I was, the look no further. Take the leap. Give this one a try! You will not regret it!
Comfortable and sexy This dress was SO comfortable & made me feel very comfortable/sexy.  I felt it ran a LITTLE large but overall i LOVED wearing this dress for my bachelorette =)

Ultra flattering & high quality, a no-brainer Although I wore a size 10 in this dress, I think I looked more like a size 4. It is very form-fitting but the thick material sucks everything into place and made my body look amazing. I typically wear a size 8 and to be honest I could have squeezed into the 8; however, the 10 was more comfortable. Would especially recommend for my large-chested friends, as the top was very roomy. This dress is classy & sexy, without being revealing.  The only downside was that I was pulling the dress up throughout the night; it does slide down throughout the night, as most strapless dresses tend to do.

Stylist Review  I love the details on the dress! All of the lace is so intricate and elegant , which is perfect for an after work event! Something that's great about this dress is that you can wear a standard bra with it.  This dress is also really comfortable and versatile!
Beautiful and comfortable  I wore this for a black tie wedding. It runs true to size. The long length was perfect for me in 3 inch heels. I received so many compliments.

Love, love, love this dress! Theia is one of my favorite brands. I received compliments all night! I wear a 38D and ended up having to get body tape to hold it up and it was still a tad big,but I made it work. Perfect length for me (5'9"), I wore flats to and from the event with no problems.

I ordered this as one of my Unlimited items to wear on a recent trip. Although this looked stylish on the women pictured it looked like a tent on me! Even belted, there is just too much fabric. I ended up not wearing this piece it at all.

This dress if simple and gorgeous. In my opinion, the pictures don't do this dress justice. The deep V is really flattering without being too much for an event like a wedding. The material was nice and heavy and the dress was very flattering, so no spanx necessary. The dress does run quite large. I'm usually always a 16 and I wore the 14 and thought that was even a little roomy. I wore this to a wedding and got so many compliments on it.

I love the detail in this dress, it's color and fit! This dress is far brighter in person than it appears. The cut and fit is very much like every other Shoshana dress I've rented so I was very pleased with the way it flattered my body. The back detail is adorable and this would be perfect for a wedding... maybe even a bridesmaid dress!

Beautiful dress, but I couldn't wear it. I had my eye on this one for a long time so I ordered two sizes. Unfortunately, I had gained weight and the hip area was very unforgiving. It was definitely stunning - just not on me.

This dress feels a little more formal with its fabric, but is still young and flirty. This dress is pretty and appropriate for a holiday party, upscale date, and more.  The fabric is a little heavier than most fuller skirts would be, but otherwise I definitely loved how small it made my waist look.

Great fit and fun dress I didn't actually wear it out because it's more formal than it looked in the photos. The material is also very heavy and didn't feel like it would be the best for mid 80 weather and humid. But I do like this dress a lot and would get it for new year's or some some other formal event not in the summer. The cut is very flattering. I really like this dress.
I still have it for a few days and trying to find a formal indoor event to attend.

Classy Black Gown This dress was so cute! I'm normally an 8/10 in dresses, and was worried about the 10 being too small, based off Trina Turk's sizing. This dress runs large, in my opinion. I wore the 8, and it was a tad roomy in the bust area, I could've worn a 6! Perfect for a black tie wedding!
Amazing luminaries across healthcare and politics! I loved it, it was super comfortable and easy to run around in (as the VP for a non-profit who is often wearing many hats).
Such a fun skirt for dancing! Got so many compliments I'd suggest going a size down. Other than that, it's the perfect dress!

Beautiful and very flattering! This dress did a great job of hiding my lower half's lumps and bumps while showing off my upper half -- specifically, my rack. It's definitely a dress for a special occasion! I received TONS of compliments and felt beautiful and comfortable all night -- with the help of some fashion tape and stick-on bring-em-ups in the bust.  It's daring, cool and classy all at once! The 10R wasn't available at the last minute, so I went with the long and had to wear GIANT shoes. Just be aware, if you go for the long -- it's looong.

Knock-out Dress This dress has been on my radar for awhile...but it is always sold out. Plan ahead if you want to rent it. I took all other RTR reviewers' advice and sized up one size. The 8 fit perfectly and was supportive without a bra (I am a 36c).  Compliments will be flowing all night if you rent this one. Make sure you have a fresh air-brushed tan. Minimal jewelry/accessories and nude heels round out a classy look. This dress is sexy!!
Beautiful dress. Too tight around bust The 10 was too tight around my bust. The 12 fit my bust but too big around torso.
Team RTR Review I love the girly touches of the trim on this dress. The trapeze shape is comfortable in the middle and hips but may run a little small for bustier girls.

It was a beautiful wedding for a truly in love couple. Couldn't have asked for a better weekend. The dress was just perfect! And it was my second option initially ;). I am 5'1, so it fell much longer on me than the RTR model pics. But it wasn't a big deal. The sleeves have a pretty cool tight fitting inner loop that helps to keep sleeves from falling down constantly and being annoying. The pockets are awesome —
super helpful, and I love when designers consider this. Design is beautiful, and pretty damn accurate to the model pic. Overall, I was receiving compliments all night, and I'd recommend this dress to anyone :). Thanks RTR!

Quality dress This dress, as usual for this designer, runs small.  I wore the two and it fit fine, but the A-Line skirt helped.  I don't know if it's my mom belly or what, but the bottom of my ribs suck out and this dress just wasn't super flattering on me.  Oh well.  It was a nice dress - kind of basic - but it looks as pictured and was fun to wear.

Rent the runway saved my event! I bought a dress and it didn't arrive (and actually still hasn't arrived yet) but I rented this dress because it was the closest to the one I had purchased, and wound up being so much happier than I had anticipated. The fabric had enough stretch but not too much to look baggy. Definitely a night- and life-saver
Girly and Fun I didn't end up wearing this because it was too tight in the chest area, but I absolutely loved it! I will definitely be ordering it in the next size up for a future date night!

Beautiful but had to return I tried this dress on in an actual RTR store. It was fabulous on me in the store. I ordered it online along with another black ruffled dress. The red dress didn't fit as well as the one I tried on in the store. It seemed bigger and was overwhelming me. I"m 5'1 and usually am a 6 or 8 but in the store I tried on a 12 and it was so comfortable and looked amazing.  Sadly I had to return.

An amazing Bachelorette Party dress! As most have said, this dress runs very large. I normally wear a 4/6 and the extra small in this dress fit perfectly. Hugged curves in all the right places, and was able to wear a normal bra. I would recommend this dress to anyone looking to show off and stand out from the crowd! My fiance' wanted to know if I could buy it to keep :)

I wore this for my bridal shower!  I loved it!!  Very flattering and I got so many compliments!! Runs small --> Size 1 size up for sure, and maybe even 2 sizes up, which is what I did, but all in all great dress!!  RTR exceeded my expectations

Great Dress, lots of compliments. Great dress, lots of compliments! I'm 5'9" and could have used a bit more length even though I ordered the L size. It is a very tight-fitting dress, I decided to go up one size from my regular size just so it would feel a little more comfortable.

Beautiful, bright summer color! I rented this dress for my birthday weekend in NYC.  The dress is fitted around the waistband but then pouches out underneath.  Some of the photos that night I looked like I had a baby bump!  I wouldn't recommend this dress for anyone who does squats or any kind of weight lifting.  I normally wear a size 4, but had to go up to the size 6.  The size 4 fit perfectly around the waist but was too tight around the thighs.  Overall the dress worked for a night on the town, but I probably wouldn't rent it again because of the way the bottom fit.

Perfect dress for a black tie optional wedding. This is a great dress. I got so many complements in it and felt great all night! Like other reviewers it is two things, heavier than it looks and very fitted. If you are curvy this fits like a glove. I got an 8 and 10 and ultimately wore the 10. The lace is a little itchy at first, but I got used to it. The other thing I noticed was that in the image of the model wearing it, it looks more lined than it is. The top is a sweetheart with a plunging neckline in the front and a unlined low back. I wore a backless sticky bra in it and that was perfect. The underskirt comes to about mid-thigh and then the lace hits mid-knee. Just a little skin showing and the ruffle in the back makes this classic sheath a little more modern. 

For an outdoor formal summer event, this was a great dress. Highly recommend.

Perfect dress! I wore this dress to chaperone a Senior Prom.  It was Perfect!  I originally ordered the size 4 to wear and also had the 2 sent with it. While I could have worn the 4, I had to go down a size and the 2 fit perfectly.  The 4 was a little to large in the chest area.  The length of the dress was appropriate.  It was short enough to be cute but long enough to be appropriate.  The pockets were the best part. I could store my chapstick and cell phone inside and you could not even tell the dress had pockets. I would definitely rent this exact dress again.
Pretty but runs small I rented this as a second style and wound up going with a jumpsuit instead. This is a pretty dress, but it does run small. I was drawn to its simple elegance.
Flattering pattern Tight in the chest and hips, I'd recommend ordering a size up if you have boobs and butt.
True to size and fun to wear This dress fit perfectly and was so fun to wear.  I'd chose something similar if I had another such occasion.

I wore this for my Tiffany and Co Bridal Shower, and it was the perfect shade of blue! This dress runs a bit large (it's also a looser fit), so I actually had to call RTR the day I got them so they could send me a size 2. The dress is super comfortable and has a bit of stretch to it, which helped across the bust. I loved this dress!

absolutely beautiful! THis was my back up dress, and while I didn't end up wearing it to the wedding I attended, I will be renting it again for the next one! It was so flattering, and stylish, and pretty, but fit and felt like a tee shirt dress- amping up the comfort. I adore it!

I felt stunning  The fit was amazing! I wore this dress for a wedding and I received so many compliments. I didn't feel like I had to hold anything in because it bunches up in all the right places. The length of the 10L was perfect since I love skyscraper heels, I also requested a 12L but that was just extremely long. I was not expecting a tail on the dress but I was able to move around fine once I put on my heels.
LOVED IT! I LOVED this dress. It was comfortable, flattering, and hott! I sized down, per reviews, and it fit perfectly. I didn't want to take it off!
Beautiful dress & color! Perfect for any special event! The waist was a little small but everything else was a good fit.

This dress is so glamorous!  Classy with a little bit of sexy- perfect for a party! Have to have a back less strap less bra. Tight fitted through the skirt but stretchy and forgiving fabric. I loved it!
I wore this during the day for a fun day with the girls. fit perfect!

beautiful statement coat for work Runs very large, I'm between a 4 and 6 typically, and the 4 was still a bit boxy on me.  The woven fabric is prone to pulls, so it looks a bit worn, but is still in very good condition.  Presents well, I received lots of compliments.

Loved this dress - felt great in it and pretty comfortable, as well The dress was gorgeous. I rented sizes 4 & 6 for a classy wedding and the 4 fit but was way too form-fitting and provocative. I ended up wearing the 6 and it was much more reasonable for the occasion. I was hoping to wear a bra with the dress after reading reviews that others did not have an issue; however, I tried on several bras with the dress and they all showed. I ended up wearing cups that stick to inside of the dress. I could have gone without a bra also and that would have worked okay. Overall, I loved the dress!
This dress was very cute and perfect for a night out. It was too short for me.  I could've worn because it was too loose in the hips but the 4 would've been too short.

Lots of compliments This was the first time I wore something with such a deep plunge so I felt pretty daring. Between that and sparkling all over, it made quite a statement and I received many compliments from strangers. I opted for adhesive bra cups but I'm sure there are other options that would work, maybe with some creative pinning, since the dress has actual straps. The length was okay since I was wearing low heels, but if you're tall and plan to wear high heels, probably look for a long length. I'm generally between a 14 and 16 and this fit perfectly in 14. I would definitely rent this again, or one of the many similar colors/cuts from Badgley Mischka.
It was my anniversary and Valentine's Day I loved it!  The picture does not do this jumpsuit justice it is so beautiful as the first one I've ever worn and I love it!

Great dress but wide fit! This dress is great! I LOVE the cut. Very flattering, especially if you are pear / apple shaped because the bottom portion of this dress is very loose. However, the size run is waay off. I wear a 6 99% of the time, but I could have definitely worn a 4 (or maybe even a 2?!). I would say definitely go down 1 size, maybe go down 2 sizes if you do not have a large bust. The fabric is thick and beautiful, great for fall. I wore this to work twice - even with it being a little large - because I loved the look and fit so much. Great work LBD.
wore it to a girls dinner. fit as expected. can dress up or dress down depending on occasion

It was fun to rent a dress! I wish my backup had been a size smaller rather than bigger as the 4 was a little big on me.  I'm small on top and this dress was too big on my top.  But the dress is very forgiving and I was still able to wear it.  I did receive many compliments on it!
The dress is very comfortable and easy to move around in The material is very stretchy but hugs your body. If you are conscious about every inch of curves being shown, this isn't the dress for you!

Gorgeous fabric! Pretty color! I didn't end up wearing because I didn't feel as comfortable as I wanted to in it. It's very long which makes it hard to dance in. If I needed it for a different event (shower/dinner party) would definitely have worn.

Interesting color, flattering material, felt great in it all night So this is a little outside of what I would typically order as my *perfect silhouette*, but I weirdly loved it. Material was a thick stretchy something that gave you a nice shape without causing awkward bumps and bulges (would probably look even better on someone curvier), and color was a little darker and very unique... not bland at all like I kind of expected. Per other reviews, definitely size up one size, and plan on wearing a no-show thong or something along those lines. Also I struggled with shoes... I was planning on wearing black heels and they looked terribleeeee, and my metallic ones didn't look great either... i would probably recommend nude or tan
Beautiful  So many compliments and very bodycon - flatters the figure.  Perfect color! Very long!  Wore 4 in shoes still very long!

Beautiful gown, great fit! I got compliments all night. Dress is very fitted, but comfortable.  I found it to be short - fitting more like a petite - which worked for me because i wore flipflops for most of the event.  Dress arrived worn/stretched in the chest - definitely needed a large chest to fill out.  Some boning was sticking out of the fabric - but RTR made it right with me. Very happy with customer service.

Perfect dress for engagement photos!  Dress fits snug around waist (not too tight but definitely snug). Dress is long and should be worn with 3in.+ heels. So many compliments and glad I went with this dress!

Decent dress to see The Book of Mormon I rented this dress because my fiance and I were visiting NYC to see The Book of Mormon. While the play was awesome, this dress unfortunately was not. I'm short and petite so I always expect dresses to be too long but that wasn't the problem with this dress. I read the reviews and knew it would run long since that's the style - No problem. The problem was that it was so loose everywhere else. I know I'm petite but I've rented several items from RTR and don't usually have problems because I read the reviews and choose my dresses wisely but this was a bit of a disappointment. It was very loose in the bust (I'm a 32C) and even more loose in the waist. In order to make it a bit more form fitting I wore a thick belt with it which is the only thing that saved this from not looking like I was wearing a nightgown.
perfect casual top! slightly short but very well made!

Incredible Dress... Pictures don't do it justice! I loved this dress... wish I could have kept it. I wore it for an upscale outdoor, summer wedding.  The pictures really don't do it justice.... You will feel incredible in this dress and it tucks in all the right places. Be sure that you have a good no show bra. I will rent this one again.

I wore the size 0 to a black tie wedding in July. The bride stopped me to say she loved the dress! The dress fits like a glove, i went with the smaller size. Runs a bit long but I wore my "date me" shoes and all was well. Very comfortable and sexy. I got so many compliments during the evening. Not heavy at all. I would most definitely rent again from RTR.

Loved the dress! I rented this dress twice!  Runs a little large. I am 5' 9". I didn't wear heels the first time so went with the R which was great. Wore heels the second time and the L was perfect! I love this dress so much!
Perfect shift for almost any event XS fit me great so it definitely runs big. Nice thick material and super fashionable and versatile style- loved it.
gorgeous and flirty sleeves.  I was not thrilled with the fit. Wore 0 instead of a typical 2, as 2 had a lot of material in stomach area. Size 0 shoulders a bit snug.

Perfect dress! I wore this for my rehearsal dinner as I really didn't want to wear a white dress (plus, I love pink). It is so cute and so flattering - although it definitely showed that I ate too much at dinner :(. Would rent again!

I wore this to my cousin's wedding and felt really good the entire time. This is an awesome dress! I really liked it and got a lot of compliments. It does run a bit large and you have to be careful of side boob depending on your bra, but the lace and color were beautiful and the overall fit was really nice. I would say I have an average to thin neck and it was almost a little tight around there, so if you are thicker in that area, you might want to be careful. The fit of the body was very flattering and comfortable. I wore it with tan wedges and pretty simple hair and make up.

Wonderful dress, it was tasteful and still stood out like a dream. I got endless compliments. The red was perfect, a very true red. I saw on other reviews that many said the bust area was too big, but as a small B I wore a size 2 and it fit just fine. The skirt if a full circle skirt, so a lot of spinning on the dance floor aha, but it was so beautiful. One of my the best dresses I've ever worn. You can tell it's quality as well, the fabric was thick and structured. Also, IT HAS POCKETS. I loved this dress, it made my whole evening.

Gorgeous dress, just enough sass Being a pear, the cut of this dress accentuated my small waist and chest without being obnoxious, while hiding my larger hips and thighs.  The dress was comfortable; I was able to breathe, eat, dance, etc. The color was beautiful.  Not too flashy, nor too conservative.  As many reviewers mentioned, the pockets are a nice bonus.

super comfortable!  I didn't take a picture of this dress, which I now regret, but this dress is fabulous! It fits very well, and isn't snug. I wore it for a birthday dinner and got lots of compliments. I'm 5'8" and didn't have any issues with the height of the slit. Would definitely recommend renting!

Did not fit. Watch out if you have a full bust (DD or greater) - the body material does not have any stretch and the chest area is not generous.  I could not get this zipped, although I had no issue with other styles by this designer in smaller sizes

I looked better than the model - HA. I loved this daring look - only in VEGAS.
Got a bit itchy towards the end of the night, but totally worth it.
Beautiful color and style! Very happy with this dress.  Wore it to a party and I was comfortable all night with the fit.  Perfect for an end of summer event.

Great twist on the LBD!  I wore this to a law school cocktail party.  Pros: This mini dress is a true mini, even at 5'0.  I have a hard time with length and most dresses are usually too long on me.  Cons: There are signs of wear, by way of pilling on the black pattern material.  Overall: Great twist on the LBD, has a nice snug fit that kept me feeling thin throughout the night, and thick material perfect for cooler fall weather.

Flirty, fun romper I absolutely love this romper - the color and fabric are to die for. However I do find that it runs a little small, especially if you have a long torso or hips - the shorts were just a tad too short and riding up in the back. Someone had also tacked the straps to make them shorter with thread - even when I undid the tacking it was still too short in the torso. So if you have hips, I'd recommend sizing up!
Great dress. Love this dress. I normally wear a 00 and the 0 fit perfectly. I received tons of compliments and would definitely rent again!

This. Dress. Is. Amazing. (So long as you have double stick tape. :) )  This dress is great, really really great. There is an eyelet about 1/3 of the way up so you don't HAVE to have the plunging neckline, though I opted to have it open (it was an Oscars party, so it worked). I did put a bit of double stick tape so that I didn't fall out during the evening. The only other comment is that the slit is quite high and in the middle, so just beware when standing so you don't do a Britany Spears. That all being said, it is beautiful and I got 1,000 compliments and felt WONDERFUL in it. Full marks!!
Night with friends This is a great everyday dress.  Wear with wedges or flats, you can't go wrong.  The neckline is perfect, not too "showy".  Very comfortable for an evening out in Naples, Fl.

I got engaged in this dress! Overall this dress was a great fit! I thought it'd be super tight, but it fit great. The sleeves were a little snug, but I have bigger arms so I expected that. So glad this was the dress I was wearing when my boyfriend proposed! I will definitely be renting it again!

Perfect Spring Cocktail Dress This dress was perfect for a cool spring cocktail reception. I received so many compliments. The dress is even lovelier in person. I echo what previous reviews state about the arms being very tight, so order a size up if you are concerned. Overall, a great dress for a great evening.

Hard to pick just one moment! I felt great in the dress and got plenty of compliments.  This dress was great -- snug, but comfortable, and super flattering. I wore it for my birthday and got lots of compliments. Good for petites/shorter ladies. Would definitely recommend it. Got the Dannijo Aubrey earrings sent to me as a stylist surprise and they worked beautifully.

Perfect dress for a fall wedding. This dress is very form fitting, i would absolutely size up. I originally was going to wear the 2 which fit my body better but i think since it was tight it formed folds in the material around the rib cage area and i thought after dinner and cake it would be safer to wear the 4. the dress had a more of a purple hue than the pic online which i ended up looking better on my skin tone. I wore emerald green/gold chandelier earrings which went perfect with the wine/purple tone. Wedding was in October up north by the water so i opted for a faux fur grey jacket which went perfectly with the dress. I removed one star because both dresses arrived with the zipper pull missing. I didnt think it was a big deal until i noticed the zipper at the neck kept zipping down. The zipper pull keeps the zipper in place, and both dresses came without them. That was annoying because my favorite part of the dress was the halter neck and throughout the evening my bf was zipping up the neck of my dress, which was pointless because it almost immediately came down so the collar wasn't as fitted as it should have been. Other than that received many compliments and felt pretty in the dress.
Professional! Wore this to a job interview and felt really comfortable but dressy. The long skirt is perfect balance of flowy but work appropriate. I paired with heels and a nice necklace.

Pretty green dress I received this one with my main pick. I ordered a 12 regular and a 14 regular. The 12 size was too tight and perfect length. The 14 was right fit but too short. I ended up wearing the 14th and wearing flats. I really liked the dress however, I waned it 1-2inches longer. ALSO, the sequins were a little itchy under the arms but got many complements through out the night. Was enough room to dance!

Such a FUN Dress! I loved this dress. It is very very pretty and I received many compliments. I was sad to return it.
The dress is a very different color than it appears on the website. It is dark gray with cream colored flowers.
The dress fits snugger than other size 6 dresses I've worn, there is NO give in this dress. However it was comfortable to wear all evening.
The neckline and shoulders of the dress would not lay flat. I had to continually adjust them all evening.

This dress is amazing!  Loved it! It is very unique and I received a lot of compliments on it. I'm glad I listened to the reviews and sized up because it definitely runs small. This was my first RTR experience and I was extremely pleased! Already have another dress on order. :)

Gorgeous dress fit for an indoor fall wedding. This dress was amazing! I wore a floor length dress for a semi-formal wedding because I injured myself and didn't want to draw attention to my hobbling around too much. It flowed beautifully and the straps on the back rested perfectly. The dress definitely ran small though, so be aware of that. I got tons of compliments throughout the evening and felt so beautiful.
Perfect for a gala!!! I will rent this again if needed :) Fits nicely, but too snug and there is a nice lining to keep your figure looking perfect.

Lovely!  This dress is prettier once on. The colors are beautiful and the fabric is very light. I definitely recommend wearing a slip because it is very see-through. I went have dinner with my family, there was plenty of daylight and we were outside. I took it for vacation and forgot my slip, so I wore shorts underneath, but I tried no to separate my legs too much while standing because it shows your legs pretty well underneath the dress. Also, It would look better without a bra or a nubra because the back opens a little. I wore a regular nude bra and it showed the band a little bit in the back. Despite those little details, I enjoyed wearing it. I am about 5'6" and wore this dress with red flats. It was a bit long, but nothing too bad. Again, I was on vacation and I didn't really have many choices, but it was perfect for a family dinner and pictures!!

I didn't get to wear this one.... Rented this for a country music concert. It came without the belt which rent the runway warned me about. They had me pick out something else in case this didn't work. This ran very big and made me look like a painter. Sadly I didn't wear.
It fit perfectly! I got a ton of compliments.  It was perfect for my winter graduation!

Partial cape is fully fantastic! I rented this dress to wear for New Year's Eve.  It was a lot of fun to have a partial cape and the fabric flows very well on this dress.  It does run small as I normally wear a 2 but I didn't want it clinging to my hips in the front so I wore the size 4.  Probably because I was in the larger size the straps that keep a piece on the hanger kept coming out of the dress at the chest and shoulder.  That is why I gave it 4 stars.

Lilac Lacey Perfection I rented this dress for a winter wedding and it was stunning. I received compliments from just about everyone I ran in to that evening. It was certainly form fitting and I noticed snags in a few places presumably from previous orders, but nothing too noticeable. The zipper is a tricky one! It took two people to help me work up. I notice the zipper had a tendency to catch on both sizes as well so it must just be the fabric. LOVE THE LENGTH and quarter sleeves.

Fun, comfortable and just formal enough for husband's graduation! The fit was perfect! I normally wear a size 2 and ordered a small. Also, the dress was SUPER comfortable (had to wear it from 2pm to basically midnight) and received a lot of compliments on it. Would definitely recommend.

I wore this for a birthday party, my Double Sweet Sixteen, and it was the perfect princess dress! I went to the flagship store to try on dresses so I knew that this was the size that would fit me. It was tight around the bodice, which is important because I'm pretty flat chested, and long enough to work with my very long legs. The fabric is very heavy, almost like wearing a blanket, but since it's open in front it's not too hot. I loved how the back moved behind me like a train. I wanted to be a pretty princess for my themed birthday party and this dress was absolutely perfect. Everyone at the party loved it and I know I'll treasure the photos.

Must have bigger chest to fill it out! I had high hopes for this, but even with strategically placed cutlets, I could not fill the bust out and the side boob was not appropriate for anything outside of late night Vegas. I didn't have anything else to wear so I taped as best that I could and kept a wrap around my shoulders to mitigate full on flashing. If I was standing very still and not talking with my arms at all, I was okay. But I truly shouldn't have worn it. The rest of it fit beautifully and pretty true to size. A girlfriend wore this same piece to a party the week before (she's significantly more endowed than I am) and it looked AMAZING. Great garment, well made, etc.. just not for smaller chested girls!
I feel very comfortable, elegant and sexy mama.. It was a perfect fit. I have a big bust and it looked amazing and super comfortable... Got a ton of compliments!

Top 3 favorite dress I've ever worn This dress is gorgeous, comfortable and fits amazing. It had just a little stretch to it which made it feel great. The material is super cool, totally different! I can't say how much I loved this dress enough.
Very flattering! FAB dress- very flattering!
Great flowy dress, but not too dressy, flattering on comfy at the same time It rums large so I wore a small long with flat sandals and it fit perfectly. I'm 5.7 and 140 lbs

This dress was so cute and I got a ton of compliments all night! Definitely runs big, would opt for the smaller size as your 2nd choice. Usually I wear a size 6, i ended up wearing the 44 and could have even gone smaller. Fabric is really stretchy- but it's thick fabric so even though it's stretchy it doesn't cling weird or anything like that. I am only 5" 2' and usually find the dressed on here to be WAYYYY to Long esp compared to the picture but this one fit well, it wasnt super short but also didn't hit the knees. I also loved the cut, it hug tight to my bust/waist but then poof'd out allowing me to eat and drink as much as I want without the need for any spanx! Would definitely rent this one again!

Very Bright, Very Tight. hehe I got it for my unlimited order. I am 145lbs, 5'9" and Dcup. I usually wear a 4 or 6, the 4 was too tight! I needed maybe the 6. I didn't even zip it up. The color is MUCH brighter than the photos. VERY BRIGHT.
It was a great dress. It fit perfectly and got a lot of compliments.  I am a 32DDD and 5'2, 110 lbs and it fit perfectly without looking slutty or trashy. Great dress. Very classy but also sexy.

Perfect for everyday and occasions  This dress is so easy to wear. It lays beautifully and can be dressed up or down. I wore it multiple times and got tons of compliments. One of my favorite pieces I've ordered (also hides a growing baby bump-17 weeks-really well)

Beautiful, comfortable dress I typically wear a 12/14 on top and a 14/16 on bottom, but only received the 16 of this dress, as a backup for one I chose that was unavailable. It was beautifully cut and very comfortable, but the top ran extremely large. I can imagine it would be great for those with a larger chest, but I had to safety pin the sides in about 2 inches on either side. In the end, it worked well and was super fun to dance in. Would recommend to those whose bust/hip measurements are more proportionate than mine!

Perfectly paired with the Tory Burch pink cardigan This dress was very demure when paired with the Tory Burch pink Simone cardigan for work.  It was comfortable all day.  I didn't receive the usual compliments as when I wear other rentals to work, but sometimes understated is perfect.

Love this dress! Very classy and sexy w/o showing too much. Love the black lace atop purple liner. I usually wear size 4 (40) & although I said "runs small," perhaps it's better to say that it is form fitted. It looked terrific.
Runs small Very pretty in person but runs small. I am taller and the back was very short.

This is a great dress! It's difficult to tell from the other pics, but the fabric is a mid-weight with a bit of texture to it.  It's perfect for autumn, but I think it would be a bit heavy for spring and summer.  I've rented it twice now, and I always receive rave reviews.  It's flattering and easy to wear.  I wore a size smaller than my usual size.
