nice fit, high quality loved this sweater for everyday, work, or even going out on a cold night when you want to be comfy but also cute. fit true to size. loved the high/low detail which made it a little dressier. high quality fabric - very warm so keep this in mind.

the wedding wasn't very fun Like the other reviews said, the arms are too small. I  fit in the 8 just fine if it weren't for the arms. I wore the 10 so I could dance comfortably. It was a little large but I couldn't life my arms above my head in the 8. This dress is beautiful and I got tons of compliments. The pockets are awesome and it's a tasteful length especially for me since I am taller.

Another great rental! I'm 5'2", 110 and B cup, athletic build.  The OP fit perfectly with 3 1/2" heels. I did wear an adhesive bra. A fuller cup, or younger person may feel more comfortable going without, but I felt it was necessary to wear something. The bottom is heavy but not hot or uncomfortable at all. This may have been my favorite rental so far.  Started receiving compliments as soon as I stepped out of the hotel elevator from the front desk staff and they continued throughout the night. Thanks RTR!

Loved this dress so much that I wish I could have kept it!  The fit was great, I read the reviews and saw that it ran a little small so I ordered a size up and it was perfect. Classic dress that was very comfortable and flattering.

LOVED IT!` I wore this for my one year wedding anniversary to The Setai Hotel Sunday Brunch. It's a snazzy hotel, so I wanted something cute but not formal and appropriate for a Sunday brunch. I paired it with my nude red bottom heels and it was perfect. It was super comfortable and the material was really nice. I didn't want to return it, and I actually found it for sale on the Kate Spade website (on sale for $190!) I wear a size 12, but ordered a 14 as a backup, and the 12 was perfect, in fact I think I might have been able to wear a 10 to be honest. It's a bit 'tricky' to take off since the buttons only go down to the waist, but other than that it was perfect. RTR also has it in black and I'm thinking of renting it for NYE. Absolutely recommend!
Comfortable and nice for work Does run large and the style is a bit on the baggy size. But the way it falls makes it flattering. I liked it for work but probably won't rent again.
Such an easy process!  A little tight in the tummy, but comfortable in the larger size. Delivery/return was super easy!

This dress was comfortable and formal. The fabric was fun and the gold made it special. the length and hip fit perfectly. I would say the dress is fairly true to size, but since i am small busted was a bit big on top. It look great but since the dress was a bit big the eye hook on the back of the keyhole kept unhooking. Other than that I would wear this dress again in a hear beat.

Ordered this for my bridal shower I didn't end up wearing this because it was way too small. I am usually a size 6, but I had trouble zipping up the 6 in this dress. It's a cute dress- the material is thick and the lines are sort of a frayed fabric but in the end I should have ordered a bigger size.

Great red for a holiday party! The color and style of the dress was really fun! I felt like it hugged my waist in all the wrong places though and gave the illusion of "a gut". It was also a little snug at the hips and kept riding up (advice is to wear tights).
Too big  I'm a 32c and ordered a size 2. Is was too dig in chest and arms. Also did not love the shoulder pads.  I ended up just sending back and not wearing it.

Beautiful, Elegant and Great Dress to Dance in This dress is a beautiful blue with a slight teal tint. the lace is beautiful and delicate. It does not itch nor is it tight anywhere! I sized down and was able to wear dress without a bra (36D) as the arm holes are pretty large. Dress hits just below the knees and I enjoyed twirling with my two year old while dancing. Great dress, will definitely order again. 

Can't wait to try the rust color!

Felt very glamorous wearing this dress!  Tons of compliments!  Fit was true to size.  Little tight in the waist, but it was fine.  The leg opening is very tight with no give, so I had to take small steps.   I was able to dance fine, tho.

I wore this to a black tie optional wedding and received a ton of compliments on the dress!  Condition of the dress was excellent, both the one I wore and the backup had tags still on! I'm 5'8", 140 lbs, 32C, and the 6R was just slightly too big, I unfortunately ordered my backup dress in an 8, but I think the 4 would've been perfect. I wore flats and the dress was the perfect length, and if I were in tall heels I think it would've been to short.  There was some gapping in the bust, but easily solved with a little fashion tape. I really loved the shape and the back of the dress, very flattering. Would definitely rent again for a formal event.

This dress is a SHOW STOPPER. I got so many compliments on this dress, I loved it! I'm almost always a size 4, but I had read the previous reviews from girls who said the dress ran small because of the bodice so I ordered a size 6/8. I DEFINITELY agree with the previous reviews since I wore the size 8 and it was still pretty snug (which was fine because I didn't need to worry about it falling down since it's strapless)
Very cute, great for a Summer wedding! Great fit, perfect for a Summer wedding, fits true to size.
Good transition work to weekend This top is much nicer in person. It looks frumpy in the model picture. It is fairly casual but can be worn to work or weekend day.

Stylist Review  Such a pretty dress. However, it does run very small and has no stretch.  The make of the dress is very straight, so if you are curvy, you will feel that the dress is tighter in the hips. I suggest sizing up!  I am usually a size 0, but I wore this size US 2 and it was still a little tight. A standard bra works with this dress, but I did not wear one.

Wore for an industry awards event -- felt like the belle of the ball I am usually a size 4, but sometimes need to go bigger in the chest area -- I thought I might need the 6, but the 4 fit like a glove. The silhouette of this dress was perfect for my body time, and the longer back gave it an extra formal edge. I got compliments all night, and continue to get compliments from photos. I never want to buy a dress again -- RTR is amazing.

Beautiful dress. Classy and sexy at the same time.  I range between a size 2-4. I had to wear the 2 because the 4 was definitely too large. This dress would compliment a woman that has some shape. I’m pretty straight bodied, so even the smaller size was a little loose around my hips. Regardless, I received compliments all night in the dress. It was fun and sexy.

Amazing dress!!! While this dress is amazing, the photos do not do it justice. The color is so amazing in person. It flatters all figures. However the one draw back [why I did not give 5/5 stars] is that it is very difficult to find a bra that does not show because the neckline is so low. I highly recommend investing in bridal tape to use with the dress before your event. Other than that, it is a great dress.

Wore for my birthday and felt fantastic in it! I wore this for a birthday brunch then to a wine festival during the day. It was easy to dress down - I paired with a wide brim hat, strappy block sandals and a denim jacket. It does run large, on average I'm a medium but wore a small and still had some room. The cut, the print, it's all gorgeous! The keyhole cut in the top is more revealing than I had expected so be aware if that would make you uncomfortable.

So many compliments! I wore this dress for a senior dinner and received so many compliments.  I loved this dress!  The only negatives of this dress (as expressed in previous reviews) are that the sequins rub your arms and the dress lining kept showing at the bottom of the dress.  As beautiful as this dress was, I didn't care about those things.

This was my first dress rental so I was a little concerned about renting a dress I hadn't seen in person and the sizing/fit.  In the end, all these worries were for nothing!  I just reviewed the photos that other people had posted - this gives a pretty good idea of how the dress really looks - and I looked for photos of people wearing the same size I would wear.  The free second size option makes the size/fit worry go away.   Loved this experience, and will definitely be renting again in the future!!
Beautiful structuring, wore this for my sisters rehearsal dinner! Fit like a glove, wasn't too short with heels and the color, details and structure made it perfect for a formal event.

Not my favorite, a little frumpy but pretty floral print! I rented another similar style Erin Featherson dress last month and loved it so I decided to try this out when my original request couldn't be filled. I was disappointed that this dress, although seemed to be the same cut was much larger than the teal one.
Beach party ready! Comfortable, cute, true to size!
Artsy and sexy! The skirt was great because you could adjust based on the amount of skin you wanted to show (be it an inch or several). Really fun and unique pattern - great if you want to stand out!

Waited all summer to rent it and finally got it after labor day I probably wore this out of season, but I had my eye on it all summer and my size was NEVER in stock (on unlimited) until after labor day. I wear either a 0, 2 or 4 depending on the dress, so I went with the 4 becaues others had mentioned it runs small. The 4 fit me perfectly and the best part was not having to wear a bra. It was super comfortable and flattering. The material was a bit faded because of lots of use, and it does wrinkle easily, so be sure to bring a steamer if you're traveling with it. Otherwise, it's a great dress and I'm bummed I didn't get the chance to wear it over the summer!

Sparkly & Fun! This dress was so much fun to wear!! I'm usually a 2 but had a baby 4 months ago. I got this as my back up dress and only size 6 was available but I figured I'd order it since it was only my back up and I had a few post-baby pounds left over. (I thought the 6 would be big but the dress runs small and was very form fitting. I wore Spanxx.)   I wound up returning my other dress and wearing this one. Perfect for a formal wedding because the sequin are subtle and the cut out in the back is tasteful (I'm usually super conservative so this was fun and adventurous to wear. I felt great!) I was able to wear a strapless bra with it (the first strapless bra I tried peeked out the back so try on multiple ones before you give up.) I wore bronze peep toe shoes & very minimal jewelry. The sequin did not irritate my arms like some users said. The slip does show on the bottom a little but I didn't mind. Overall, great dress if you want to step out of your comfort zone & have a little fun!

Classy and flattering! Loved! This was my first RTR experience, which I rented for a family wedding in San Diego. I actually went to a RTR store in Chicago and tried on an Elizabeth and James dress to get an idea of their sizing. I'm usually a 6-8 depending on the style but opted for an 8 in this dress. It arrived on time and fit like a glove! I got many compliments throughout the event. The neckline is so unique and accentuates shoulders, and the flare in the skirt was flattering and fun. I'd highly recommend!

very thin fabric I wore this to work and expected it to be a much thicker fabric based on the photos but it's not thick at all. The buttoned pocket flaps on the front of the dress flew up when I walked and that got annoying by the end of the day. I wore it with tights and I liked it overall but I probably wouldn't rent it again.

Perfect dress that made me feel girly and sexy! I originally thought I would wear this dress to a wedding, but when I tried it on it showed a little too much cleavage, so I thought it would be better for date night.  Dress fit like a glove and has some stretch to it - very breathable.  The open back is very sexy and you can wear a bra -  it won't show.
I absolutely loved this dress and would rent again for another occasion!

This dress makes you feel sexy and look like a million bucks!  All the girls in our party wanted to know all about rent the runway after this one. I love love love this dress, It was perfect for our trip to Vegas for a Bachelorette party, it is a little conservative on top, but the sexiness on the bottom between the super short length and scalloped hem really made my legs look amazing.  The dress has some stretch which was great.  It was a little hot for Labor Day weekend in Vegas, but it doesn't really matter what you wear it'll be hot. I would rent it again.
Great but big I should have gotten this size and smaller one, not larger one. Shoulders had too much room and I was constantly fidgeting. Waist down was fine.

n/a When people say this dress runs small it is NO JOKE. I normally wear a zero and I couldn't even half way zip up the 2. I think I probably would've need a 6 and this is coming from someone with narrow hips, hardly any butt and a small chest.

The color was fabulous! Truly unique dress. The top fits tight. Even though the fabric was thick, I wanted to wear a bra and had to size up to do that. The fabric needs a steaming so be sure you have time to steam day-of. I would never have picked this dress if not for the other reviews and also because I could rent it - not buy! It was a stunner and I highly recommend for a formal affair or formal wedding. If you are tall, make sure you get the long. I'm 5'10" and with 2.5-3" heels it was perfect length (I didn't want it touching the floor so yes, there is a bit of space but so worth it when walking or getting up out of a chair).

sexy and glam i didn't end up wearing the dress as it was much more formal then the event required.  i will rent this dress in the future for a cocktail party as it fit gorgeously and was very flattering.  i have a few extra pounds i am working to lose but still felt sexy in this dress as the fabric sucks you in and conceals and extra lumps.  i would say to size up as it is fitted.  i generally wear a 2/4 (more on the 4 side) and the medium fit perfect.

Elegant and old Hollywood glamorous. This dress was perfect for the wedding venue - Langham in Pasadena.  It was elegant and ornate, but not over the top which is what I love about it most.  The neckline was not too flattering on broad shoulders which is what I have, but overall, the dress was a hit and too gorgeous to pass up even so.

It was classy and young without being revealing. Perfect for a family wedding! I tried on the 2 first and it fit like a glove so I didn't even try on the 4.  I'm usually between a 4 and a 6, but I've recently started running again. I would still say this dress runs on the small side. The 2 did feel a little tight and uncomfortable right after dinner, but it was soon forgotten once I hit the dance floor. It was so easy to dance in and was fuss free. Loved this dress! I received so many compliments!

Beautiful color The XS fit perfectly on top (I'm small-chested), but was too tight on the butt and hips, so I had to go with the S, which was a little loose on the top, but fit perfectly on the bottom (I have narrow hips and thighs).  If I got the XS,  I wouldn't have been able to sit or move.  So definitely size up!  With a sticky bra you're golden.  I felt classy and sexy at the same time.  Definitely a good choice!

Wore to work and felt feminine and sharp.  Topped with leather jacket outside.  Easy to wear! Nice drape, movement in material.  Feels feminine and fun but the simple black lines keep it conservative.

Beautiful, sexy dress. It runs a bit small.  If you have a large bust, don't rent it!  It doesn't have a ton of room and is certainly meant for small chested women.  The cut out was a smidge larger than I expected so I needed to make sure I didn't slump throughout the evening.  The cut out regardless though is in a good spot so if you are confident in your body, you will be happy. Gorgeous dress, very nice material and got tons of compliments from strangers.

Wore this on my bachelorette weekend and will definitely buy it when it when RTR sells it! Fit perfectly. Length was short (i'm 5'1") but easy to dance in and thick material hides tummy imperfections.

It was gorgeous... I wore it as my exit gown for my wedding. Very glittery and dramatic The fabric has enough stretch so as a small person who usually wears a size 2, the 0 had enough give and tapered the body better than the size 2. So glad RTR comes with a back-up size!

Stunning This designer runs super small in the bust and rib cage, and true to size everywhere else, once I got the dress zip it fit like a glove. It is beautiful and elegant, the bow is a little floppy, but fun.

Great dress for casual wedding! As others have stated this dress runs slightly large. They were out of a size 10 so I went ahead with the size 8 and am so glad I did. The size 10 would have been entirely too large. It was long enough not to feel exposed and was super comfortable to dance in all night. Great choice!
Good, but not great.  Armholes a little small, skirt a bit see through.   Wore it once and sent it back.
Senior Prom The back was gorgeous and the dress fell beautifully without gathering anywhere but also showing off shape
Versatile jacket Fits TTS, typical Vince look - slightly sporty, classic, cool. Good color, goes with everything. Worn with sweatshirt, dress, and jeans!

Stunning, beautiful, perfection.  Seriously. This dress is so beautiful.  I wish I could afford to own it!  I wore it for my son's baptism and it just looked amazing.  The color, the detail, the flattering & demure fit.  This dress is a total 10/10, five stars, two thumbs up, etc.
STUNNING! This was a showstopper plain and simple

Perfect for almost any season The dress was great -- I had rented the mint green version previously and found that one to be slightly more forgiving and comfortable, but the navy version is perfect for spring through fall. It is flattering, but the material is more structured and less stretchy than the mint version. Because of this, I did have to size up from my regular size. Love the length, and it is a very classy dress for a wedding. I received lots of compliments, and I had no problem dancing the night away! I chose to wear a strapless bra with it, but you'd probably be fine with a nude regular bra. I did also wear Spanx to smooth everything out since it is pretty fitted.

Soo easy to rent! Wore this for a masquerade ball - will definitely use this service again! This dress fit pretty true to size, however I wore the next size up because I wanted a looser fit overall, especially around my gut! It was very comfortable and I loved the lace and sequin detail. It was not itchy under my arms, which I was worried about from the other reviews. I felt like the belle of the ball! My sisters both rented as well and we all looked AWESOME!

Classic black dress with a unique twist! I read the reviews, so I sized down for this dress. The material was heavy, but I didn't overheat. I loved the texturing on the fabric! I wore it to a wedding that ha the ceremony in the afternoon and reception in the evening, and it transitioned nicely with nude heels. The lace on the top is really pretty! I'd definitely rent again.
Even better in person!  I rented this for a work event and it fit like a glove. It was sophisticated and the peplum gave it such a fun twist. Lots of compliments with this one and will rent again!
Wore as a cape since it was a little too big.  The leather was so soft, I will likely order a smaller size the next time.
The color and fabric is amazing! You'll stand out in any crowd! Lost count of the compliments Flattering fit, no special bra needed BUT the fabric is a bit heavy

Perfect dress for fall wedding! This dress was the perfect color for a beginning of fall wedding in New England. The cut was demure, but the exposed zipper and shoulder cuts made it a little sexy and trendy. The bust was a bit tight, but not too bad. I'm 5'10" and the length was perfect.  Added a gold necklace and some gold stackable bracelets and looked great! Highly recommended.
so many compliments The fit is absolutely amazing, my strapless bra didn't show, and I received so many compliments.  LOVE

Wanted to Keep It!!! Absolutely LOVED this dress. It's a more vibrant color than it looks in the photo - hard to describe - but more aqua-colored than forest green, which is really pretty. The chest/top area is quite fitted, which worked perfectly for me, but would probably not work well on a larger-chested girl. The skirt is a bit more flowy and not fitted on your hips. Very flattering! The arms were a bit loose/baggy for me, but length was perfect (and I often have an issue with things being too short). Was the absolute perfect dress for a more formal party! Got TONS of compliments.

A wonderful casual dress The dress is a thicker knit as mentioned in previous reviews. very lovely pattern but it would be nice if it was a little more fitted. I wouldn't wear it to anything dressier than a casual/work event.
LOVED THIS DRESS  SO AMAZING. Was super stretchy. Wasn't too long or too short and made my body look slimmer. 10000/10 would wear again!

Beautiful Showstopper  This dress is very beautiful but cut a bit strange. As other reviewers stated the waist is very tight and I have a tiny waist.  I was much more comfortable in the size 6 but sue to my height the fabric bunched up between the waist and the neck so I had to go with the size 4.  The silver collar necklace I rented made the dress and the fact that it was not built in some how well major design mishap.  The back is see through but not so noticeable that you cant wear a bra. I received lots of compliments but would not rent it again based on the cut and it being comfortable.
Very cute dress. This dress is very short and I'm only 4"11!
great top,  loved this top.  I could have worn the size 6 - I received a ton of compliments.   You just need a cami underneath or a solid bandeau

Unexpected print I wore this for a backyard brunch we hosted at our house. It was very hot outside, and this dress was quite breezy and comfortable. This dress is much cuter on than in the model photos. It does need a belt to look put together, otherwise it seems large and shapeless. I wore a thin tan belt with tan sandals and it looked great. The armholes are a little large and my bra could occasionally be seen. Very minimal jewelry is needed due to the boldness of the dress. The colors and print are a bit unexpected on such a simple silhouette. I am a 36D with an hourglass shape and the medium was still slightly baggy on me. If you have a smaller bust, you may want to size down. I normally wouldn't buy something like this, but the Unlimited has really helped me to open up to new styles. My husband complimented me a ton while I had it on. I would rent again.

Beautiful Color I absolutely love the color pink and this dress was beautiful however it runs small. I ordered the size 2 and 4 and the 4 barely fit. I had to suck in to get it zipped up. I thought I was going to have to wear a blazer to hide the back but thankfully it zipped up. Order a size up or it will be too small.
Great flowy top for work Fits large - I ordered a size down after reading reviews
Super stylish Got tons of compliments on this skirt. Definitely runs small on the hips, so I'm glad I sized up.

Cute dress worn to work I needed a dress I could wear to work and then to a casual birthday dinner.  This fit the bill.  I ordered the small and a medium as a back up and wore the small.   I was worried it wouldn't be long enough for work but it was just right.  It landed just a few inches above my knee (I'm 5'5").   The only issue I had is the arm holes are a little big.  I ended up being more concerned with showing any side boob.  Maybe I should have gone with the XS as a back up?  Either way, it was super cute and I received a lot of complements.

Elegant and Comfortable! I absolutely loved this dress! I wore this to a work conference and it was comfortable for the entire day! The sleeves make this dress pop and the forest green color is much prettier in person. It fits true to size as well.
Beautiful dress- but too tight up top  Wish I could've worn it.  It's beautiful but I'm a size 36C and it wasn't going to zip up.  No stretch but beautiful if you've got the frame for it.
Lots of compliments fit great  Great fit, easy to dance in and the cape...,, show stealer!!!

So obsessed - rented 2x in 2 weeks! Perfect for springtime. Queued this in my Unlimited to wear to to work and then a Peking Opera preview - loved it so much, wore it *again* the following week for a gala benefit. (Normally, I wear dress once to party/event and once to office if not on same day). If you have unlimited, pull this for your spring events. It's a knockout.
One small tip: it is very sheer - no bra and only spanx recommended.

My dad telling me I looked like I was about to walk the red carpet. I rented this for my senior prom. I stumbled across this dress by accident on Rent the Runway and it was definitly not something I would have picked at first; I'm not a big sparkles person. But I'm happy to say this dress was an absolute stunner! The colors were the best feature; in some lights it looked pinkish gold, and in others a more silvery grey. The only downside was that I have a rather large bust and I absolutely had to wear a bra with this. The deep v-neck was a bit of a challenge so I had to use fashion tape to keep from looking X-rated. It definitly runs large! I got sizes 4 and 6 and even the 4 was a little large in the shoulders. Definitly get a long if you're wearing high heels. I had on 5 inch heels and the dress hit the floor perfectly. If it's a sophisticated, elegant and chic look you're going for, this dress is the perfect choice!!

CHEAP, EASY, AWESOME! Girls, I hope to never buy another expensive dress again. I rented this dress for my step-son's wedding: it really only cost $35, it was shipped to the venue, looked great. How awesome that RtR lets you get two sizes just in case--I sometimes wear a M but needed the L for my larger hips. Great website. I really enjoyed reading the reviews and seeing pictures of real women wearing the dresses. Enjoy!
Comfortable dress for vacation! It's lightweight and worked great for dinner on the beach.  It's designed to be loose and flowy, but it definitely runs a little large. I would suggest sizing down.

Great quality, many compliments The dress is perfect for spring weather as it is a thick fabric, but still a short dress. I wore this for work followed by a dinner in the city. I would say it runs on the smaller (and short!) side. It was just long enough to wear to work, but it was definitely just on the edge of being too short. The fabric has virtually no stretch, and I found it plenty roomy in the body but snug around the hips (it has pockets which also added to the snugness around the waist). Since it's a shift, and not fitted, I think I should have sized up to allow for a looser fit and longer length.
Love the look. Runs big, but it is supposed to as it is oversized.  Love the back...looks great with leggings.

A Classic This simple classic black dress has a sexy sassy cut and fit. It fits very fitted but the fabric is thick, stretchy and forgiving. It smooths out all the imperfect spots. I was able to wear a regular strapless bra but if you are smaller chested, you can probably get away with no bra because the fabric is so thick. I thought it was a little short for my liking so if you are taller then 5'6" and like to wear higher shoes, then go with the Long. I don't usually like my shoes to show but it turned out well because i didn't have to lift the dress going up stairs and dancing. The picture shows how my shoes showed slightly with 3 inch heals.

Beautiful fitting dress! It's hard to tell in the photo but this dress is a beautiful mid-shade pink.  I paired it with teal as my accessory color and it looked great!  I most often wear size 6 but this dress hugs, so my curvy hips didn't fit well into the six at all, glad the 8 worked out. I would suggest going one size up.  There were tiny grey stains all over the dress (hence the 4 stars), which I noticed while ironing, but they weren't noticeable to anyone else. Overall, I was satisfied with my choice, very flattering.

This gown is super cute in person, a little long for me since i'm 5'2. But i loved it. The dress was really cool and comfy, great for casual date or work. It was past my knees being 5'2 but I didn't mind it. was really cute and flattering being hour glass. Would rent again.

Sexy twist to a LBD I was not able to wear this dress after trying it on. The dress was beautiful and unique but I was not comfortable with the length. I was worried I would be flashing my under garments to the world when I moved around. If you are under 5'9" this dress would work for you.
Such a comfortable and flattering dress.  Add a great necklace and this dress is a winner.

The sexiness, the respectfulness,  as well as the comfort of this dress.   This runs small.  I am a size 8, the medium was unattractively too tight.  The large fit beautifully.  I received compliments all night long!

The perfect wedding dress! This dress was absolutely perfect! Nearly 1 year later and I still receive compliments on this dress. The fit was a little larger than I expected. I am typically a size 2 or 4 but the size 4 was entirely too big. While the size 2 fit, I feel as though the 0 would've fit like a glove. Overall, I continue to be in love with this dress and the silhouette was stunning!
Gorgeous dress but runs small gorgeous dress very thick and no need for a bra but runs very small. I am always a 2/4 and wore a 6. Recommend sizing up!

I got SOOOO many people that came up to me throughout the night saying how much they loved my dress The top was a little too loose. There needs to be some type of bra support  I'm a DD & this dress was not bra friendly so I had to wear bra tape, but because the dress was so big on top the tape kept showing, had to readjust throughout the night.

perfect! Wore this to a work event. Never wore a red dress before and was trying to be a little adventurous. 
I'm 5'5 and wore heals and it was the perfect length. I wore my hair down with beach waves no necklace and a nude wedge. Got compliments all night long. Loveeed this dress. (ps. I'm a 34 c and got away with not wearing a bra - bonus in my book! )

Sequins! Wore this for a bachelorette party where we all were wearing sequined dresses.  The dress I requested wasn't available so this is what I was sent.  I was glad this was a little bigger on me because it made it more comfortable for a long night.  Since it wasn't the original dress I ordered I didn't have a sticky bra so I ended up wear a black long bra with a low back.  This made the sheer sides just look black but it looked fine and I was a lot more comfortable.

Comfy and twirlable Definitely an offwhite vs. white dress (my fiancee in the second pic is wearing stark white). However, super comfortable, flattering, and fun to flaunt on the dance floor. Fabric is good quality and not flimsy, so I wore for an outdoor party and didn't mind when the weather turned chilly. Would recommend!
It's cute and different. Casual and comfy. Fit great, the sleeves are very long and the thumb holes are a cut touch. Great Fall turtleneck however it is Lightweight.

Simple with a little something extra Fit like a dream. Loved this top because it's so well made and incredibly flattering. I think I love Suno in general but this is kind of a wardrobe staple with a bit of fun with the front ruffle thingie. Def a re-rent. :)
Wore this to a concert and the print and fit was great. Runs large, but it might be the more modern fit. I like the color very much. Can be dress up or down.

Beautiful dress, great fit! After going down a size the dress fit almost perfectly. The back is entirely too low for a  traditional strapless bra and due to the non-stretch lace I couldn't move my arms higher than shoulder height but I would still rent this dress again. Looks better in person!

super bright dress! The dress is comfy and easy to wear with a regular bra. It is very very bright, florescent even. I wore it to an outdoor desert wedding and it was perfect for that. The material is thick so maybe not the greatest for hot climates but it is short and sleeveless so I was fine. It is pretty short - I am between 5'2-5'3 and it was a couple of inches above my knees.

Rented this for an baby shower - event was slightly dressy at a popular restaurant. Definitely runs LONG.  I think the XS would have been perfect.  Size down if you're in doubt and prepare to wear heels with this one if you're short to average height for your dress size.
*LOVE*  Probably would have exchanged for an XS if I were to do it again.

Eye catching red dress I received so many compliments on this dress. The red is very eye catching. I typically wear a 4 and I had to wear a 6, so it runs a little small. The best part, it has pockets! Overall, I really loved this dress. The only negative is that the fabric isn't super giving, so when I sat down it was a little constricting at the waist, but that was honestly a minor issue.
Didn't wear. Beautiful dress but too large in the chest/shoulders, fit the rest of my body very well. Not a good dress for small chested woman.

Perfect for baby shower! I loved the fit of this dress and received so many compliments during my son's baby shower! Even though I'm petite at 5'1" it fell about an inch over my knee. At 29 weeks pregnant, it fit great across my belly and was very comfortable. I would definitely wear again!

A great find for a first rental I loved the dress length, pockets, and color of the dress. The bust area was a little tight but not uncomfortable. A good rent for a first timer as I was nervous that it wouldn't fit or look right. I'm looking forward to my next rental.

Very comfortable dress that I could boogy in all night long. The dress fit great, a little tight around the waist though. I would definitely recommend to ladies wanting a dress to dance and move around in. Size up if anything! Otherwise runs close to true size.

Didn't wear this dress.
 The fit is extremely tight!!

Different, but flattering. As others have said, this does run large and the arm holes are big. I didn't find that to be problematic. I rented this to be a bridesmaid in my brother's wedding, where we were told to wear "fall colors". This fit the bill perfectly. It's not a color or style that I would normally wear, but I liked it a lot. I tried it with a belt, but everyone said it looked more elegant without, so I let it just hang. It was comfortable enough to wear all day and night, and let me indulge in a fun up-do so that the neckline would show. A strapless bra was necessary (annoying) but it was a fun dress that got a lot of compliments.

Cute - a little large if you're petite I got compliments and it was comfortable, except if you're petite or have a small frame it runs a little large.  Felt like it hung on me instead of being form-fitting.

I wore this dress to a summer wedding and loved it.  The color was gorgeous in person and in photos. Fit-definitely size up, especially if you have a more athletic body.
Pros-no need for a bra due to thick material, color and cut are gorgeous
Cons-none

The sisterhood of the traveling dress...looks amazing on every body type! This dress was very special. It was form fitting, flattering, sexy, but not too showy. The cut outs on the side were discreet, but added so much. The elastic to the straps made the dress comfortable but also provides support to the gals too. The only accessory I wore, which the dress paired amazingly with, was neon pink bridesmaid sunglasses. Will absolutely rent again!

Pretty dress for a formal wedding. This dress was perfect for a wedding, as it was very pretty but also comfortable and easy to wear.  I have small shoulders so the bra strap attachments were great.  The fit for me wasn't perfect, as it was a bit too big in the top (my bra showed a tiny bit because the front was too low), but I think I'm the only one who noticed, and it was certainly unrestrictive!  It would be ideal for someone with a slightly larger ribcage or cup size.  I'm a cyclist and have huge quads, so it was snug through my hips, but the lace layer made it less revealing/fine for the wedding, and the material is stretchy so it was still easy to move.  The length was great.  I received many compliments, it was fun to wear.

I felt amazing in this dress. The material for this dress was sturdy and stretchy which made its wear super comfortable.  The only con was that the zipper continuously shifted to the right side so I was constantly fixing it.  Otherwise, I would order again.

Warm, classic coat, excellent quality I was surprised by the excellent quality of this coat. The fabric is very comfortable and warm. It is a bit large for me but not due to sizing (I sized up due to availability) but still looks great. I really like wearing it open.

Fun dress for a date night!  Wore this dress on a date night with my husband. It has a fun fit, but does run small.I normally wear a four and ended up wearing the six. The slit does go high when sitting down, so just be aware. Overall  a really fun dress that made me feel pretty! The opening is at the perfect height.

Cocktail wedding in Southern California in October  SUCH a great dress. Fun spin on the LBD with the cut-out shoulder and ruffle sleeve. Received so many compliments about it being classy but sexy. Comfy stretch material.

Classy and elegant There are a ton of options on RTR, but I've already rented this dress twice!  The fit on this dress is spot-on for shorter/petite girls and I have gotten compliments on it each time.  Note: the arms on the dress are a little tight, so I'd order a size up as your backup dress.

mermaid cut emphasizes all the right curves! The fit of this dress is very flattering - it has a mermaid cut while emphasizes all the right areas. Lots of complements all night, however it is a bit plain so be sure to wear statement earrings or a fun purse.

Super flattering and felt amazing wearing this dress! The quality and fabric of this dress were amazing and it was so comfortable.  The fabric is stretchy yet holds it's shape well so it allows for imperfections and curves and doesn't attract every fuzz and hair.  The dress was a little shorter than I expected but I have long legs, however, since it was cold when I wore it I paired it with black tights and high heel black booties.

Pink and gold w/ beautiful lace This dress is much more pink in person than pictures show.  The gold lace overlay is beautiful and makes the entire dress look rose gold.  I ordered the 2R and 4R as a back-up (the fit guide says to size up for back-up size) but the 2R was a little big.  It looked pretty loose when I tried it on so I added a super padded bra w/ straps tucked in and made sure to stand up straight all night.  I loved how the lace was a little longer in the back.

Amazing bright color and pleating details Love this dress - would highly recommend! Has an amazing bright color and the pleats in the back are a wonderful detail. Also love the large gold zipper. Really heavy beautiful fabric, well lined, and fits on easily. Does run large so I would recommend true to size if you're very curvy, but likely most should size down.

Great color, super comfortable, conservative but sexy Picked this pretty last minute and wasn't as excited about it, but when I tried it on and when I wore it to a friend's wedding, I received a million compliments. It was really comfortable, while also being the perfect cross between sexy and conservative. It definitely runs large - I typically wear a 2 or a 4 (more towards a 4), but both of those sizes were huge. The 0 was even a little big in the stomach, so just make sure you account for that.

Too low to go... I love wrap dresses!  This dress, as with other DVF wrap dresses, however, is cut too low for work.  You may can wear a cami underneath, but it was so fitted up top that I didn't want to add a layer, so I didn't wear it.  Color was nice though!

Tons of compliments on a beautiful dress This dress fit wonderfully and I did not stop getting compliments all night. It was a little heavier than I'd expected and the fabric of the dress wasn't super comfortable, but the slip took care of that everywhere but my legs. It's so pretty, though, which more than made up for it.

Unbeatable print! Ended-up wearing the 8, even though I'm typically a 10/small 12 in dresses lately. 32FF chest fell out the sides a little bit, but certainly far better than I anticipated. Didn't think I could wear a bra with this, so went without the first night I wore it, but was able to wear my strapless without issue the second. This crop top is surprisingly forgiving if you're not totally a crop top-kinda gal (like me!) Paired with the matching skirt while out to dinner, then with a long, billowy black maxi skirt the next day for a casual lunch.  The material is pleasantly dense; was fine for late spring in Charleston, but I'd be a little nervous for summer wear in a humid locale. 

The print is really just to die for!!!  I've rented a lot on here through Unlimited and for formal events, but this is the first outfit I'm *seriously* considering purchasing!

Seemingly simple, yet elegant dress! This is the perfect sporty, yet chic dress for a fall wedding in Newport, RI (the attire was black tie optional). The geranium color was very appropriate for the occasion and was a nice alternative to the traditional black. I wore a backless bra to accommodate the tasteful cut outs the dress offered. My height falls between a regular and long length dress and probably could have gotten away with the 2L backup size I ordered. But I opted for the 4R in an effort to wear shorter heels. I rarely wear a size 4 and was reluctant about the 4R. That said, the  dress runs particularly small, and it fit great. Between the size, dress length and material, I was comfortable all night long.

Dress was a showstopper. Got compliments all night. Dress was extremely comfortable and flattering. It shows a lot of your back for a sexy look. I didn't wear a bra and the dress looked great on me (34DD). Dress felt somewhat loose; I probably could have worn the size 2, but it was out of stock. The shimmery bottom half is really pretty, and the length balances out the sexy top nicely.

Perfect fit - arm tightness was fine - showstopper! The dress was form fitting but a little stretchy at the same time. Came to me with the inside liner damaged - very noticeable fraying to me, but likely no one else (at back of gown). Wore without bra and inside top had built in support that was adequate. Photographed beautifully, and was a wonderful choice. I have a very pronounced pear shape (large bottom) and a fairly small top, and this gown fit very well.
Cute Didn't fit my usual size, will rent I size up next time.

Ive never in my life had an occasion to wear a gown like this. I felt like a million dollars It was very long for me so I bought super high heels with a platform sole. This really helped. Other than that it was very comfortable to wear.
Let's go, Mets! I'll wear it to CitiField tomorrow evening.  Forgiving fabric.  Bright orange. Fun.

Wore this beauty to our school's Centennial Gala! I'm typically a size eight, and when ordering, RtR suggested going down a size for the back-up dress- I would suggest the opposite! The 8R fit like a glove once I had the right shapewear underneath, but the 6R would have been way too small. All in all, this dress was a beauty, right to the floor with three inch heels and very flattering and forgiving in all the right places.

Beautiful color that pops! Beautiful dress! I usually wear an 18 dress but ordered up a size after reviewing others comments. The 20W fit but it was super short on my, coming up about mid thigh. I went with the second size of a 22. It was a little big on me in the waste but the length was perfect, hitting about 2-3 inches above the knee. I received so many compliments on the color.

The dress made me feel like a movie star, and everyone told me that as well.   It was a little short, but I liked that, as I didn't want to be tripping on it or tear it.  It was very comfortable and great for dancing.  I loved the back.  It is very form fitting, so it took me a second to get used to wearing something so tight and long.  But I loved the back and felt that it was very appropriate for a church wedding.

Great print and flattering fit I wore this dress to a summer wedding and received many compliments. The fit of the dress is very flattering, especially around the stomach and hips. It was a little looser around the waist than I would have preferred but it was generally fitting enough that I didn't mind too much. I have a small bust, but this dress managed to give me some cleavage, too. I would definitely wear it again!

Wore these to a wedding and community even on the same evening with glittery platform pumps. Fit me snug but not uncomfortably at high waist. I'm only 5 feet tall so these grazed the very back of my 4" heels almost to the floor. I sized up one size from my usual size 6. Beautiful  fabric. the pale stripe is almost but not quite silvery in color not white.

STYLIST REVIEW I love love love this top!!! This is perfect for a weekend trip! This does run small, so I recommend sizing up. This works best for A to C cups since it is fitted. There is a zipper up the back. You can definitely wear this with a standard bra, and keep in mind that this fabric has no stretch. Pair this with a choker!
Lovely! Fit was true to size. Material was amazing. The fit was perfect. Loved that it looked great dressed up and with jeans. I'll be holding on to this one for a bit longer!
It was so much fun to dress up for a night out in Vegas! The dress was so comfy! It fit a bit big, which wasn't the worst thing in the Vegas heat! I would certainly rent again!

Super SHORT!!!! Rented the 8 - fit perfect but I'm 5'9" & this was waaay too short for Work & honestly I wouldn't wear this out, I'd feel very uncomfortable as it's so short!  Bummed cause it's a super cute dress!

Gorgeous! I wore this dress for my summer bridal shower and absolutely loved it. I have broad swimmer shoulders and found the 4 to be a bit tight, so I went up to the size 6. The length was perfect, not too short.  I received so many compliments and multiple said I looked like a bride. Beautiful dress!

Perfect dress for a barn wedding in the country! I was pretty concerned about sizing for this dress since everyone commented how large it runs. I ended up wearing a XS which is ridiculous since I'm normally around an 8. Definitely size way down. The dress was super comfortable, easy to wear and flattering. Don't plan to wear a regular bra though - the arm holes are way to big. Definitely was sad to send this dress back - sorry for the dark photo.

Gorgeous color, very forgiving, classy, but heavy material dress.  Great dress for the religious wedding I was attending where I had to be very modestly dressed. Color was amazing and dress was very forgiving in all the right places. Open back was great too although I could not show it.
Great NYC outfit for a night out! This ran SO big! I had to pin both sides in and wear a jacket, BUT i made it work and it looked amazing. It is a cotton like material making it super comfortable!

Too small This was a beautiful dress.  It wasn't my first choice but was recommended by a very helpful associate and overnighted to me due to my original order being delayed by a storm.  I'm not sure how it would have looked once I got it on but I couldn't get it past my shoulders.  Thankfully I had another dress to wear for the event.

Perfect in everyway!! Everything about this dress and the rental was perfect. I will be using this service in the future for sure! Was so easy and the dress was truly the best dress I've ever worn! So thrilled I found "Rent The Runway"!

Beautifully appropriate. Ordered the 4 and 6, should have tried the 8. The 6 fit but I'm small in the bust/arms--would have liked more room in the waist. Loved the detail--pretty and sexy yet completely appropriate. Definitely recommend.

The event was a black tie holiday party for my boyfriend's company.  I am 5'3 and ordered a 4P and a 6P (back-up). I ended up wearing the 6P. The 4P fit, but was a little snug. The 6P fit, but was a little loose. I opted for the 6P for comfort.  The dress was the perfect length for my height. It did not drag, nor did anyone step on it. The train still gave a small dramatic affect without looking too long either. I received several compliments and would recommend to someone. I feel this dress would fit many different body shapes. I would rent this again.
Works for casual workplace when transitioning from Fall to Winter Loose in the chest, but fun and got lots of compliments!

Great dress!  Comfortable and trendy--pockets are a plus! This dress is great, very trendy.  It's more navy than it looks in the pictures.  It was a little small in the bust for me (I'm a 34C) so I went up from an 8 to a 10.

Beautiful dress for a bridal shower. Received lots of compliments.  I wore this dress for my bridal shower and it was very pretty! I'm usually a 4, sometimes a 6 pending the brand because of my bust and opted for the 6 based on other renters' reviews. The tulle and the fabric looked great and, other than a small spot of dirt on the neckline that I was able to mostly clean off with a towel and water and scuffs on the zipper, the dress was in good condition. I'm a 34 D and the bust was really tight, so I didn't wear a bra. If you're bigger busted like I am you're going to be squished on top, but I wasn't uncomfortable. It's a shorter dress, but since I'm petite it was the right length and hit me a few inches above my knee. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because of the tight bust. Also dress doesn't have any stretch so I recommend either ordering a size up or getting a back up size just in case.
The Naked Dress This could definitely be called "The Naked Dress"! Fits like a second skin, very sexy, very flattering. If you're a confident woman, this is your dress!

I think the color was unique, which made it so no one else had the same dress at the wedding. I wish that I had gotten a 12 because it was a little tight in the hips, but overall I was satisfied with the dress.

LOVED, LOVED, LOVED this dress! One of my favorite rentals and so flattering!  This is one of the most flattering dresses I've ever worn! The fabric and cut is amazingly high quality - It made me feel like the dress was made for me. One of my favorite RTR rentals so far. Fashion forward without feeling too out there. I DEFINITELY recommend this for any night event - party, date night, Vegas, bachelorette, you name it! 

The dress works very well with no bra, since the fabric is thick and well constructed.

The sparkles were amazing! Amazing new years eve dress! Got so many compliments all night. Fit runs a little large - ordered both the small and medium, medium was much longer not the right style for NYE, so I wore the small. Dress itself is lined, some discomfort with the sequins in the arm, but not much. One caveat is dress gets VERY hot, in retrospect maybe not best choice for dancing all night. But besides that I loved it!

The dress arrived in great condition- and on time! I ordered two styles for my event.  I am a true szie 4 and the other style fit perfectly- this one a little big.  I would order a size down and your regular size.  I couldn't wear it because it was too big.

Bachelorette Party Win! Worn for a bachelorette party where the bride-to-be wore white (pictured, also in a RTR), and everyone else wore black. The dress was beautiful! I wore a smaller size than I would normally wear. The area under the arms was slightly irritating because of the sequins, but not terrible. Loved wearing this dress!
black tie wedding strong 'scuba' material fit snug and flattering, this wedding was 8 months ago and I'm still thinking fondly about this dress! loved wearing it
Fun Birthday!  This was very body con. I wore a size 10 when I am usually a 6 in most dresses. It was very flattering and really sucked everything in. Definitely shows every curve!!

Great night on the town dress! The top was a little tight, but I am broad chested.  The length was great though, making it comfortable to wear all night through a bachelorette party without worrying what was showing.  Not one I would rent again but definitely a fun dress!

Very Sexy, RUNS SMALL! I wore this dress for a date with my now ex (we were together 7 years and I though he was going to propose so I rented a dress... then he didn't and things fell apart from there...). It was super comfortable and I looked amazing it it. I was REALLY tight along the midsection. Size up and you'll be fine. I do wish I had gotten a medium :)
super warm and soft but wide and boxy I wear a 4 in a coat, rented the small, it was too big, way too wide.  I wore it anyway because it is a beautiful coat, very warm and soft.

RTR Team Review Everything about this Alexis top screams fashion, the bell sleeve details and wrap around closure specifically. Please be advised that at first, I was unsure of how to wrap and close the ties, however, there is a slight slit inside the shirt that one of the ties will go through in order to allow for a secure closure. The fabric itself is also on the thicker side, but nothing that I am opposed to. I wore this top on St. Patricks day in NYC and received tons of compliments.

Great for work and going out Like most Equipment items, this one runs big. I normally would wear a Small, but I know that Equipment fits me best in XS. I wore this to work with a black blazer. It was a little bit on the sheer side, but that could be solved with tights if you were worried about that. I'm 5'6" and this was almost knee length on me.
Color & fit was amazing! 10/10 for this dress! Fit like a glove.  Beautiful color and incredible fit.  Got tons of compliments and felt great all night.
Rented this for a big day at work and loved it! Looks amazing, fits like spanks. Only con, it was very tight on the top.

Simplistic, classy & eloquent! I wore this dress for my small wedding ceremony & it was perfect! 
I wore a size 6L, but could have gotten away with the 4L (I had ordered both.) I found the dress to fit true to size in which I am normally a 4L but the waistline was just a bit too snug and I wanted to be able to move freely and drink and be merry my wedding day! Otherwise, the dress sizes were pretty much identical. 
The length was also perfect. I am 5'8 and the length gave me just enough in which to wear kitten heels yet still have the 'flowy' gown feel of a classic wedding gown. 
I'm a large busted female (32DD) and the girls had plenty of room in this dress!

RTR Team Review Rented this style for a party, did not wear. Found it to be tight and restricting in the shoulders and hips--probably better suited to a straight-silhouetted woman. Lace looks very pretty. Felt like it ran a bit small for a size 6.

Shows off the shoulders My favorite part of the dress is the beautiful color.  It is a snug shift, if in doubt order up.  I found that the hips fit fine, but was tight through the rib cage and bust (and this is from a B cup!)  Overall loved it.

Low cut..great color This dress would be perfect for someone with an hourglass figure. I ordered an 18W and a 20W and wore the 20W. I would say I'm normally an 16W or 18W. I almost feel like this dressed isn't sized as a W and that they were just regular sizes (personal opinion). The waist of this dress is small compared to the straps and skirt of the dress. I'm 5'4 and the length was fine, but I ran into problem with the straps. They were kind of loose, and since this dress is so low cut you want the straps to be fitted. There was also gapping under the arms. I was able to pin the straps and make it work. I used fashion tape and wore a low cut sticky bra from victoria's secret to help hold my boobs up. I got a lot of compliments and overall the dress worked well. However, just be aware the waist is going to be really small.

would love if it had loved me back! This dress is so fun! I rented it as a back up for my wedding reception, a party dress for dancing in case my heavy purchased gown got uncomfortable BUT unfortunately the fit just wasn't right on both the 4 or 6. The skirt underneath is super tight and has no give but then up top it fit perfectly. I felt that if I went bigger for the bottom then the top would be too big. Would be great on straight and narrow body types.
I rented this dress for a formal event and the compliments were countless...thank you RTR. The material was different and the fit was a little tight but not unbearable. The pockets were impressive.
Wore to work as well as a concert. Loved it! Got many compliments. Things to note: 3/4 length sleeves and a bit of a crop fit (sits above waist).
Good for work Wore it to work.  Fit was a bit big but comfortable and flattering.

The dress fit like a glove and was a beautiful color for a fall wedding! The dress fit very snug, but was flattering on me. I got a ton of compliments on my dress which boosted my confidence since the dress runs small. I highly recommend wearing this dress to a fall wedding! I will definitely rent (or buy) this dress again!

Perfect for a December holiday party in San Francisco I wanted something classic, sexy and tasteful for the boyfriend's big holiday party at his new tech job. This dress was perfect! Loved the thick material and long sleeves so a jacket wasn't needed. The cutouts were enough to make the dress edgy and unique -- yes the cutouts mean you have to be careful about bra choice, but my nude demi cut with clear straps were very well hidden. The only pitfall was I am always a size small at 5'7'' and 140lbs, but the small was sooo form fitting that it created rolls and wrinkles I didn't think existed on my body. BUT thank goodness I got a size bigger too, because the medium fit beautifully and I had no fitting issues all night. The sleeves seemed long at first so I tried rolling them, but they actually looked better left long and I didn't notice it once the night started. I would totally buy this dress if I had a few hundred dollars to throw down.

One Year Anniversary Dinner Date I wore this for my one year anniversary. It was really cute and flattering. The sleeves and chest were a little big, but I think it was just because I wore a medium because they didn't have a small. I would definitely recommend it.
super cute! Wore this for a RD and got many compliments!

Great fit - perfect for a work event or something that requires biz casual. I loved this dress. It was very flattering and was perfect for a Christening. I wouldn't recommend for a wedding as it's more so for business casual events. I'd definitely rent again though. You can wear it with our without tights, so it' a good year round dress!

Gorgeous pattern! Loved the pattern/fabric on this dress!! Gorgeous! The fit is loose, I probably could have sized down, but it still looked really nice & polished on. I was hesitant to rent because it's hot here right now and the dress looks more suited for fall, however the fabric is light and you can easily roll the sleeves and leave the top unbuttoned for a more summery look.

Runs big.  Couldn't wear it. This dress is pretty but it runs big.  I'm 5'7", 115 lbs and a 34C bra.  I ordered a 0 and it swam on me.  The top gaped and I was worried I would flash someone if I wore it.  The fabric is good for winter as it's heavier.
nice shirt.... Tight across chest....but maybe I have a larger chest than a size 6 would normally have? Going up a size would probably be too big.

This was a fantastic dress all around, wore to an all white-dress wedding. Felt like a princess! This gorgeous, elegant dress was perfect for my 5'9" 118ish (+/-5 pounds) in the size 2 and comfortable enough that I wore it for at least 8 hours without complaint. It's glam but not too showy or too sexy. The knee length was perfect even on my tall-ish frame. I wore it to a gorgeous and very strict all white-dress wedding and I am still blushing from the ridiculous amounts of compliments I received. It certainly photographs well! Wish I could have kept it. I'd get married in it myself. The black lace lines on it provided great subtle detail, especially at the sheer neck, so that the dress stood out just a little from the pack but not so much that it broke the white-dress code. The fit was body hugging enough to be flattering but not so much that I was bursting from the seams or unable to move about. I was concerned at first that the back slit was too high up, but, as it turns out, those extra inches came in handy for easy movement and there was no "exposure" issue. I wasn't at all awkward sitting down - and - big bonus: I didn't have to yank the dress down at the waist all night like with many other form fitting sheath dresses - even when dancing. I did see some signs of wear in the lace itself but I wouldn't let that stop me from renting it. A+++ 
*I had the size 4 for back up, but didn't need it. The size 4 did not seem to give extra length but did have noticeable room in the bosom and rump, for those on the fence about sizing.

Sophisticated and fun!  The perfect dress for the Dada-themed gala I wore it to. Very comfortable and lightweight.  Fit perfectly everywhere, but was a little too long to wear without heels (I am 5'7").  Plenty of stretch and flow to hit the dance floor!

RTR Team Member. Stunning red dress from Jay Godrey! Looking to stand out? This is the dress for you. Running a bit small, we recommend going one size up for backup. With no stretch in the fabric and a tighter fit in the bust, this dress is better for smaller cup sizes. The midsection is fitted to show off your curves, but it is still comfortable. If you’re curvier, you may want to consider sizing up due to the fitted hip area. One thing that I love about this dress is the strapless feature; however you would have to wear strapless bra for this look. At 26” from the shoulder to hem, this dress is super mini. This dress is stunning and perfect for weddings and holidays. It would look best with heels and accessories.
All day long people kept walking up and giving me compliments! The dress runs at least one size large.  I would have loved the six, but c'est la vie! It was cute despite a slightly loose fit.

I got so many comments on this dress.  It was perfect for a outdoor summer wedding.  This dress was perfect for the outdoor wedding I was attending.  The color was really bold and the pattern looked great.  I decided to wear the smaller size, and once I got it over my hips it fit perfect.  The dress is really fun and flirty, and is great for dancing.  Would wear it again!

comfortable and put together, soft pockets Both sizes (s & m) fit almost exactly the same, I seriously tried each a million times. The medium had a little extra pooch in the tummy the legs looked higher quality (to me), but the pooch made me to choose the small. I wore a tank underneath and an oversized sweater and tan worker boots.  I wish I had worker boots with the heel, would of given it a cute edgy feel. I really liked this look, and glad I waited to rent both the medium and small.

This dress is magical. This dress is amazing! Absolutely gorgeous. So many awesome comments! I really didn't want to send it back. Almost cried a little. This dress is versatile and could easily be worn to so many events. My normal size is an 8, but thanks to most of the reviews I read, I opted to get the 6 as my backup. Both fit great, but the 6 was a little more comfortable. Even though the dress is lined, it was light enough to wear on a 90F+ day in August to a wedding, while still providing ample coverage. I wore the dress with flat sandals and the length was just enough to graze the ground and not be an issue. I paired the dress with a long gold necklace and a teal/aqua enamel bangle.

Bold, stunning color and fabric. Odd top. I loved wearing this, but I did a lot of "work" to get it to fit on top. Other have mentioned pinning, and let's say I did a bit more. It's very blousy, to the point of feeling like a different size on top. Just way too long in the torso, even for a taller lady than me. So I made some adjustments and then it was a nice fit. 
The waist is tight, which I knew would happen having worn this shape from Badgley Mischka before. But it works. The color is gorgeous, and the chiffon fabric moves wonderfully. I'm wearing a chiffon bolero thingy bc I didn't want to show my arms, and it helped to hide the work I'd done to make it fit :)

I'm short, but with 3 inch heels the 14R hit the floor nicely. I think the 14P wasn't available!

Elegant and classy gown! A must try! This gown was perfect and I will definitely consider renting in another color. The lining is slightly fitted but just the right amount. I had the 14W as a backup only because a 16 was unavailable. 14W was too big in the bust area but the 14R is perfect. I am usually between a size 12 and 14 and this was a perfect fit!
Received SO many compliments on this dress!  Dress fit like a glove. I think everyone I came in contact with at the wedding told me I looked hot!

Stunning color, perfect fabric, versatile neckline, and comfortable!  I am a pear shape (0 chest, 2 waist, 8 hips) and ordered a small because I thought the XS might be too small for my hips. I think I could have gone with an XS instead of S but the S worked out fine for me (even though it looked a little big). This dress is a mid-weight material but is perfect for summer. I wore this dress 3 times- once with a large statement necklace and 5" heels with the neckline unbuttoned, once with the neckline buttoned all the way up paired with a vintage gold belt, and once as you see here with flat sandals and minimum accessories. The color is eye-catching, the dress is easy and comfortable to move in, the neckline is very versatile, and the open back is unique and cooling in the summer.

Wore this to my friend's bachelorette party in Atlantic City! This dress was so fun. Girls and guys loved it, especially the low back. It is the perfect party dress to dance all night in and look a little flashy. Don't worry, I didn't overshadow the bride-to-be. The fit was easy- I didn't have to wear a bra and you don't need accessories, so just throw on the dress and some heels and you are good to go!

I wore this for my brother's rehearsal dinner.  It was a smash hit!  The colors were beautiful and the fabric lovely.  I am 5'10" and 150 lbs and completely lacking curves.  I am rather self conscious about my stomach though so I opted for the size 10 instead of the size 8.  While this was a more comfortable fit in the belly area, it did end up being loose in the chest area so I found myself doing a little bit of pulling the dress up throughout the evening.

Great dress! Loved it. I rented this dress for a cocktail wedding. It worked out great for the event. The dress has plenty of stretch to it and it is figure flattering. I will say that the dress is double lined but still thin. I would be careful with your choice of undergarments because it is so thin... seamless underwear or spanks would be your best bet. I rented the medium size and large as a back up. I went with the medium and felt very comfortable. I am 5'3 and the dress still came to knee length on me.

This was for the second night of my bachelorette party. We went to dinner and out to a show! This fit runs small - especially in the waist area. But I felt very comfortable in it. It was a super fun dress to wear. The sequins can rub up against your inner arms which isn't super comfortable. Otherwise, this  dress would be great for a bachelorette or even a New Years party!

Deep red dress. High quality material. I ordered a much larger size for 35 week pregnancy bump. This made the top part just a little too large as the sleeves kept falling down. I probably should have used some fashion tape. Overall, I enjoyed this piece and received many compliments. It was a deeper red than I was expecting.

Fancies up jeans perfectly! I wore this to Thanksgiving dinner with just jeans and simple heels and it was so cute. The fabric is so forgiving (especially after a Thanksgiving meal) and the top easily stays off the shoulders without continually pulling them down.

I received many compliments on the dress. The pattern and neck line set it apart. The dress was comfortable, but a bit too large in the mid-section. I used a black ribbon belt to create more of a blouson look -- no one suspected that it was separate from the dress.
I have never received so many compliments. The size 12 was tight at the waist.  The 14 was much better.  The dress was comfortable and beautiful.  I would highly recommend it.

Loved this blouse I loved pretty much everything about this blouse, other than the fact that the top button continually came unbuttoned.  I wore it with black pants for a conservative event.  Then I wore it  to a casino with distressed jeans and tall boots, and it made for a very fun and "lucky" outfit!
Bachelorette party The straps were very long.  I recommend pinning the straps so the bust isn't too revealing.  This dress looked great on me, and I loved how it complemented my pear-shaped body!

Great Color and detail This jacket is perfect.  It's a neutral color that goes with everything.  Has great details... zippers, pockets, and belt which make it more than just a regular leather jacket.  It's snug, but that's the way it's meant to be worn.  I felt it fit very true to size.  I would have love to kept it longer, but the weather got much too cold!

Red Carpet Ready! I love love LOVED this dress! It's definitely form fitting and has very little stretch. I would maybe recommend ordering a size up. I ordered a 2 and had to shimmy my way in to get it on. I was a little nervous with it being so low cut in the front. It's definitely not one you can wear a bra with and that was the one area where the dress was a little big, but the sequins helped hide that.
Dress is very pretty, great and fun work dress.  Fits true to size, made well, good qualify fabric. Not too short for work. A fun dress for work and going out after too.

This was the PERFECT dress for my holiday party! I ordered this dress for not one, but two holiday parties. My boyfriend's was a more of a black tie event, whereas mine was more casual. Thankfully this dress worked for both! I would definitely recommend sizing down. I am always on the fence of a 6/8 in dresses, and ended up wearing the 6. I have a larger bust (34DD) and the top was still a bit big, I might have been able to do the size 4. The color is beautiful, as is the thick fabric. I didn't even need to wear a bra (which as any women knows is a huge plus).

swimwear? no, of course not! but, i was SWIMMING in this dress. its beautiful for sure, but even the extra small was too big. i couldn't wear this dress. i even tried using a belt to help with the excess space/fabric around the mid-section, but it was still too big. my suggestion, don't rent this dress if you are smaller than a size 8. i did not take a photo as it was just too ridiculous looking.

Very Unique I rented 2 dresses for my birthday dress, and didn't end up wearing this one. You can't wear a bra with it, so being bigger chested I felt a bit like I was "hanging loose" a bit too much. You couldn't tell, but I didn't feel supported. The open back really made this dress pop. I would've had to wear my spanx if I were to wear this, as without it you can see a slight "pudge" from the side view!

Conservative but Still Kinda Sexy I rented this dress for a girl's night out. I said that the dress runs small, but it may just not be right for an hourglass figure. I had plenty of room on top, but it was super tight in the hips and tummy area. I wore spanx and made it work, but I think this would be more suited for less-curvy gals. With all that being said, it is conservative in length and covers the chest area, but the cutouts give it a little something sexy. I had to wear a strapless bra because bra straps directly align with the cutouts on the back.
Runs large Lovely dress, but thick material and runs large.

Simply amazing! I wore this for our small Catholic Wedding. I am 6' 1" tall, so it didn't fit perfectly, but I still enjoyed wearing the dress. The 8 was tight in my hips, but the 10 was too big.  The length was perfect. It was a beautiful dress, though it was starting to show a bit of wear.

Just the look I wanted! I wore it to a dinner with Vice President Joe Biden.  I felt chic, elegant and yet comfortable. It feels like a tuxedo. I had my 3.5 year old as well, so comfort was important. The 12R (I ordered 14R too) was somewhat large. The straps made it hang too long and the crouch was hanging long as well. I pulled it up and tacked it down which made it fit perfectly. I'm top heavy so I wore a strapless bra which was perfect. It was fully lined, great quality. The fabric was somewhat heavy but perfect for early May in Michigan.

Everyone was very complimentary. It flowed very nicely around my shape.  It was super tight around the neck, size 18 fit around my shoulders but was super loose around my middle. Would have preferred to have the size 16 but it wasn't available. The size 14 was very tight around the shoulders but fit great around the middle.

Great dress for a dressy, but not formal, fall wedding; very classy with an open, stylish back. This dress ran a bit large.  I typically wear a Size 2, but to be on the safe side, I ordered a Size 2 and 4.  I wish I had ordered the Size 0, so that the dress would have fit more closely to the contours of my body.  It's a very classy dress, and I received several compliments, especially about the open (but not overly risque) back.  The opening in the back scoops too low to wear even a strapless bra; as a 34B, that wasn't an issue for me, but those with a larger bust might want to consider how to incorporate extra support.

this dress! The dress is beautiful, flowwy and perfect for a formal summer event! I love the colors of it and it photographs very well. I paired the dress with nude strappy heels, a maroon clutch and dangle gold earrings. My only complaint was that this dress was very loose on top and fell off my shoulders--definitely try it on before purchasing.

this dress was perfect for an african safari themed wedding!  I wore the size 8L in this dress. It fit perfectly and was incredibly flattering.  I wore about 4 inch heels with the dress and the bottom of the dress just grazed the floor! Would rent this dress again in a heart beat!

Perfect for a semi-formal affair with just the right about of sexiness! Wore this dress for my son's Junior ROTC Military Ball. Attire was semi-formal. DEFINITELY a perfect choice for a mom who doesn't want to be sexy and look respectable, yet still wants a bit of an "edge". Received a lot of compliments. Accessories were easy with the color and silhouette. Because of the cut and flow, I could have easily gone with a 0 (I'm 5'7" and 125 lbs), but the backup size I ordered was a 4. I am very small-chested with a wide ribcage (36AA) and have a long torso, so this was perfect, as I did not have to wear a bra - the bandeau across the chest is thickly lined. Comfortable and the perfect length. All around, a very flattering dress.

Great dress for a wedding!  Loved this dress! The color is divine and the cut is great: decent amount of cleavage, not too tight under the arms, and the cutout in the back got lots of compliments. Definitely size down for your backup- I ended up wearing the 2 instead of my usual 4 and it was still pretty loose around the waist. That ended up being just fine after dinner & dancing! Front length was just above the knee on me (5'6"). Beautiful and appropriate dress for a fall/winter wedding.
Cute Color is beautiful. I received a lot of compliments...

Clover Canyon FTW again Love Clover Canyon, I can't get enough of these neoprene dresses.  Fit me beautifully every time.  Sucks you in, but I would stay away from this style dress if you have more rolls than you feel comfortable showing off.

Want compliments? Rent this dress! Overall great dress,comfortable and easy to move in. Be wary you busty, wide rib-caged ladies- it can get a little snug around the point your rib cage is at its widest/fullest part of your bust. With some good Spanx (I have a short torso and was able to pull mine up over my 36 DDD bust so it doubled as a bra and felt totally supported) and a buddy to help squeeze and zip you in, this dress is a dream!

A wonderful dress for a fall wedding guest! This is a great dress for dancing and sitting at a formal event without having to worry about preserving your modesty (especially after a few drinks!). It's comfortable and chic, and as many other reviews noted, it runs quite large. I'm a 34A, 5'6", 125 pounds with a pear-shaped figure and found that the XS fit just a tad large. If you're petite, I imagine this dress might run too big for you! It was perfect for the occasion and was a great first RTR rental.

This dress looked amazing and hid the flaws of a pear shape This dress was awesome! I'm 5'3 and it came down to the lower part of my knee. While the lace covers the cleavage, I would have felt it a bit risque for some family situations.

Fun dress! This was a very fun dress to wear to a party.  I received a lot of compliments and loved the design.  The one criticism I have is that the material was thick and may be too much for hot weather, but I was indoors and didn't have that problem.
Beautiful color- photographs flawlessly. Gorgeous green color. I wore this gown to incorporate a pop of color into our engagement photos and it was absolutely perfect! Fit was true to size.

A REAL Headturner! The dress runs very small. The size worn was 2 sizes larger than I would normally wear. The fit is snug and flattering on an hourglass figure. A received two sizes, 42R and 44R. The 42R had an opaque black lining in the front of the top of the dress. The 44R did not. It was completely sheer. On the day of the event, I wore a black bandeau underneath the dress. I received soooo many compliments on this dress!

Great quality, color and fit I wore this dress to a charity function after work. It is adorable! I'm 5'2 and it was long enough to wear to work but short enough to be a little dressier for the function. The color is lovely and the material is thick, so it's very comfortable. The hem on the dress came undone, but I was able to fix it with some fashion tape and all was well. Perfect neckline for a statement necklace. Would definitely rent again.

Pretty in pink I originally rented this dress for a NYC rooftop party. I had to leave before it came in so I didn't get to wear it. I wore it the next day for my wedding anniversary instead. It's a very pretty dress. I found it to be very snug in the middle section, otherwise, it was a great fit. I didn't wear heels because only the regular length was available and I'm on the tall side. I would give this dress another try at a later date.
