Beautiful Dress for a Beautiful Wedding I LOVED this dress and received so many compliments! It is very classy/elegant and you can definitely dance in it too. The under fabric has a tiny stretch to it - I have a curvy athletic build so it was a little tight in the hips/butt area but it wasn't a problem. The only complaint I have is the under fabric wouldn't lay flat so it made it look scrunchy/too tight but it didn't bother me. The pink kind of has a beige undertone - very pretty! Overall, the dress is a winner!! Totally recommend it!  

My profile wouldn't update with all my dimensions but I am a 32DD and the size 4 still fit perfectly. I didn't order another size to try on.
Adorable dress!  Very flattering and comfortable. A size smaller would have been perfect.  It's the perfect spring time dress.

Fundraiser I didn't care for the sheer material of the skirt and the peplum waist made my hips look bigger than actual.  I did not wear the dress and was happy that I rented an alternate style.  The top is low cut as many reviewers noted, showing more cleavage than I preferred.

Rented for an awards ceremony. Received many compliments on the dress! I really liked this dress. The little cutout wasn't a problem for me- I just folded my bra cup down and it was fine. I didn't have to wear spanx with this dress either, which I loved. The neckline was fun and perfect for an evening/work event.

Classy, figure flattering, and beautiful I normally wear a size 2 in dresses, but the 2 was very tight in the bust and hip area. I am 5'8" and 130 lbs, and the size 4L fit nicely. It was just a tad long, but didn't quite touch the ground in 3 inch heels, so I was able to pull it off. The top was a tad big (I'm size 34B), but was easily fixed with a safety pin. I wore to a business event at a very classy hotel and felt like a million bucks. I really didn't want to return this and wish I owned it for any event where I want to feel long, slim, and lovely. Highly recommend!

Besides my wedding gown, this is the most gorgeous gown I've ever worn. To say that I felt like a queen would be an understatement. I ADORE this gown. The 14 fit perfectly, but wouldn't allow me to wear heels (I was attending a ball so heels were a must) so I had to wear the 16L. It wasn't a big deal, but it didn't fit quite a well on my body but since it was just a little big no one besides me could tell. I have a large chest (38K) and this gown made them look SO GOOD. It held them in to place the right way so I didn't need a bra which was a shock! This gown does have a plunging neckline so unless you're willing to have them on full display like I did, you may want to reconsider ordering the gown. It was so flattering and covered my problem areas in such a lovely way. It made my arms look smaller and showed off my hour figured perfectly on the top. The bottom was perfect for waltzing the night away. LOVE LOVE LOVE!

This dress made me feel beautiful. First time I've worn heels with a gown that was long enough! Tight bodice with ribbing that kept the shape and made me stand/sit straight. Great flow in the hips/legs and high quality fabric. Beautiful color.
N/A Beautiful. Can't wear bra. Was too small to zip up, so I will rent again to try in a size 6.

This is a great outfit, get a couple sizes though. I wore this to a NYE cocktail party. The fit is a bit strange. I'm petite and curvy. The leg portion of this jumper was a little bit long, but looked fine with my 4" heels. This is where it gets strange, the bodice is like a corset that runs one size smaller than the rest of the outfit. Where the bodice joins the pants, it really didn't hang right on me there, there seemed to be a ton of extra material there and on the hips that sags, creating almost a "front butt look". Strange, I know... I ended up putting on some Spanx, sucking it in, and squeezing into the 0 bc the 2 was not a good look. Also, be sure to take a friend to the bathroom with you, bc it's nearly impossible to zip by yourself every time you need to potty.... All that being said, I got a ton of complements, and danced the night away comfortably in it.

I got so many compliments on this dress at a luncheon. This dress would work for day or night. The print is gorgeous! It fits like a glove. I found it snug around the bust and waist, so if you have broad shoulders or a large bust, you may need to size up. But, the hips are very roomy.

Stylist Review Great shirt to wear to the office! There is no stretch to this fabric and the shirt does run small so I would size up in this. There is comfortable room in the bust and it works well with any bust size. The fit is straight throughout. The ruffle detail really adds to the shirt!

Very classy and elegant dress! Looks great in pictures! I wore this to my bridal shower. I am usually a size 8, but I am pretty busty. I tried on the 8, and it fit. However, it was a little too short and too tight for the occasion. RTR ended up sending me a 10 that I wore and it looked Beautiful!

Cute - Typical Kate Spade Dress This was a cute dress. I wore it to work with black tights and black flats. Like almost EVERY Kate Spade Dress I rent, the zipper was tough to get up. It fit great, although tighter than a 14 usually fits me (I'm in between 12 and 14). It hugged the waist, creating a waist on me, but was also tighter fitted below the waist, emphasizing my love handles. the arms were a good fit. Not too tight on me. The materials was thicker, so I would call it more a fall, winter, spring dress. It was cute, however, nothing that special about it. I would probably not rent again.
Loved it! This was great for my engagement party. The peplum is so flattering! The dress runs very small - make sure to rent a size up.

Adorable rent for Vacay! I will definitely rent this again this summer.  While it runs a little big on me, I am also very narrow in the shoulders, but would still not size down because of the length.  I am a mom of boys and 5'8", so the super short style doesn't do it for me.  The elastic waist allow you to pull it down and wear on your hips or on your natural waist.  I wore it down on my hips to give me the length.  The only reason I didn't give this 5 stars was because the elastic around the shoulders seems to get very loose and was falling down.  Mine arrived with tags, so this was brand new.  I think you just need to really adjust the tie at the top to help make the fit a little tighter around the shoulders.  Wish I would have snapped a picture of this cute number!

Very comfortable, flattering, and unique dress. This is by far the most comfortable formal dress I've worn. It is very figure hugging, but the fabric has some give, so it is comfortable. Use spanx or other shapeware to avoid underwear lines. I was able to wear a black bra. For reference, in the two try-on photos, I'm barefoot (5'10"), in the photo with my husband, I'm wearing 3" heels. There is a slight train on the dress, so that helped with the length, but would have preferred 2" or kitten heels. The dress would occasionally ride up a little in the hips area; sizing up might have helped, but it wasn't a big deal. Very warm dress, perfect for a cold air-conditioned ballroom, or winter.

Too small this time I rented the same dress in the blue color for a wedding and it was STUNNING.  I rented the same size (M) in the pink for another event and this time it was waaaaay too small.  I'm a normal size 8.  Perhaps the blue was stretched out?  Whatever the case, this one had to go back.  Might have been appropriate for a bachelorette party, but not a fundraiser!

Rented for a summer party - but not a perfect fit This was a beautiful light pink/blush-toned dress, and contrasted with my lightly tanned skin well. However, I'm small-busted, and the ruffles on the front kind of overwhelmed my bust area + the cut of the neckline created this awkward illusion that my shoulders were wider than usual, so altogether it made the top half of my body look really... flat/wide. The dress fabric was light and draped beautifully though, so I could see this being really pretty on someone with the right body type. Sizing ran slightly large in the body, but the neck straps fit tightly in both of the sizes I got (0/2).

LOVE  Modern, stylish, interesting, flattering, sophicicated
Soo many compliments!

Loved it! Great first RTR experience The dress was more blue than I expected from other pictures, but it was still beautiful! Extremely comfortable, warm, and great to dance in for a winter function. Wear spandex underneath though because the nude fabric rides up. It's a little low on the boobs but fashion tape saved the day! Can't wait to rent again!!

Fun design and beautiful fabric! I wore this to a charity gala dinner and got so many compliments. Especially love the way the straps cut in a bit in the front, really showed off my shoulders, and the uneven hem was such a fun touch. I wore strappy silvery/gold heels and they looked very cool with the kind of spacey pattern on the fabric. I have a small chest and the top fit very well (just wore a normal strapless bra). Overall very comfortable, both to sit in AND for dancing.

This dress was so beautiful on and I received so many compliments! This dress runs small! I normally wear a 0/00 but ordered the 2R with a 4R backup because the 0R was not available. I'm SO thankful I ordered a backup size! I couldn't zip the 2R! The sides are sheer which isn't really noticeable in the stock photos but it's definitely visible in photos with a flash.
Loved this dress! Beautiful dress. Runs a little big so order your size then down one. Compliments all night!

Really beautiful dress perfect for any wedding-related event! This dress was exactly what I wanted for my bridal shower. The lace is an ivory color (which I preferred over most of the dresses I found which were bright white). There is a little bit of shimmer in the lace that's a nice touch. The keyhole back was the selling point for me and it was definitely a unique detail. The dress does run very tight in the hips. I'm usually a size 6 and the backup size 8 I ordered was a bit snug in the hips but was perfect everywhere else. I'd definitely recommend one to two sizes up from what you normally get. Despite that, the dress was comfortable and lovely. I got lots of compliments and a perfect initial reaction from everyone: "Oh my gosh, you look like a bride!"

Tunic This is real short and more like a tunic.  I actually did not get to wear this because there was a warped zipper issue but just from putting it on I knew I would not wear this alone.  I am 5'3 and it looked as short on me as it does the RTR model in the product photo.  Definitely size up.  My zipper was probably messed up because someone ordered their size but struggled to get it on.  Other than that the shape is very boxy so I feel like you should love your legs if you are going to wear this because it will be the only part of your body you show off (and your arms unless you wear a cardi).  And if you plan to wear a long sleeve under it maybe go 2 sizes larger.  the color is gorgeous and the texture design at the bust is awesome.

STYLIST REVIEW !!!! Classy length with just the right amount of cleavage to make it sexy. This dress was nothing shy of perfect. Having a fuller bust, it's hard to find dresses that gives cleavage but still remains tasteful. This style was amazing! Wearing a size 8, should have sized down because you can not wear a standard or strapless bra. The best recommendation for a bra would be the nu-bra. The dress is a perfect length for any heel height, I paired them with a 3 inch nude heel and it looked amazing. Because of the lace I would suggest a simple necklace and a pair of statement earrings to really make the dress pop. Perfect for bridal showers, graduations, or a date night! The different events that this dress would be perfect for are truly endless!

Sparkly & Comfy I really liked this dress - it was perfect for an NYE dinner. Sparkly/shiny but not over the top. Fit very comfortable around my curves and I felt relaxed in it while eating/drinking/dancing. The length on the size 2 was perfect even for my height (4'11 - usually dresses are a little too long). My only complaint is that the dress is starting to wear from use, you can tell with some of the sequins becoming loose/strings hanging out of the dress, and it will EASILY snag on loose jewelry so watch out! All in all, it was a great value and worked out well for me.

This dress was really pretty. Loved the layers.  Right now I can typically wear a size 14 or 16 dress depending on the designer. This dress, I chose to go with the bigger size just to be safe. The dress fit everywhere except for the bottom portion. It was tight and so the lining underneath rode up a bit and did not lie flat. I'm a curvy mama, 39 years old at 195 lbs currently, 5'8" and 38 DD. I just want other girls my size and frame to know just to be a little aware if you've got booty and hips- this dress may not lie too flat- so size up.
I rented this to wear to a work event. I really wanted to like this item but, unfortunately, the overall fit was large and unflattering.

Wore this to my bridal shower and felt amazing! This jumpsuit is amazing! I usually stay away from jumpsuits because I am apple shaped,  but this jumpsuit is different. It fits so well and is so flattering. I felt so good in it. It does run big, so I went with the smaller back-up size I had. I received so many compliments and wish I could have kept it!
Loved it so much I bought it afterwards!! Its one of those classic, curve-hugging dresses you can wear anywhere. GORGEOUS color. Runs small so order the size up from your usual.

Odd fit This is absolutely gorgeous, but the fit was a little off for my body. It ran way too large in the chest although I wear a 34C, and it was incredibly too tight across my hips. I typically wear an 8 in dresses, and the 10 barely zipped. Ended up replacing it with another dress for my event last minute. Gorgeous dress, but just not for my body type.

Dazzler!! This was an amazing dress that definitely stood out at my senior ball.  The dress was a little big and definitely too long for what a 6R usually is.  I wore heels and still had to use hemming tape.  Loved the dress though, and got a lot of complements!!

I don't have a picture; however this was SO flattering! I don't have a picture; however this was SO flattering! I would totally purchase this if I could. I am typically a size 8. So I was surprised that the back up size fit me better! I received a TON of compliments.
Nice but a little big Nice material and design but for size 0 and 5'2 was too big. Length was fine, just was not flattering for petite figures

Small - size up and it will be great! I absolutely loved this dress and rented a small and extra small. I could not even zip the small. Next time I needed to rent a dress I went for the medium because it was just so cute! Couldn't be happier with how it turned out the second time around!

Very happy that I used Rent the Runway for my event.  Very easy process, will do it again! The dress was great.  I used the reviews to help me determine the sizing.  I ordered a 6, which I usually wear and the 8.  I wore the 8, a little more breathing room.  I had many compliments on the dress and my husband wished I had bought it so I could wear it again.  Everything was exactly like the picture on line.  Can't wait for my next event to rent another dress.
It was a snug fit but I felt very slim in it. Beautiful cut. It's a great length on anyone. It runs small but hold you in nicely. I needed help getting it zipped but once I was in, I was fine.

Lovely dress for taller people This is a lovely dress for someone a few inches taller, and perhaps a bit bigger in the bust. While the lace and color are both beautiful, I had to tape the top down to stay flat on my chest, and the dress, waist down, was a bit too rectangular to flatter my height.
Colors Loved the dress. The length was just a little too long.

Fit perfect, received compliments all night!  This was a back up after my original choice had a quality issue. The customer service was great and overnighted this back up.  At 5'0 I was hesitant to rent a long gown, but this dress came was available in my size in a petite. the length was absolutely perfect with 3-4" heels and it fit in the chest stomach with plenty of room to move. Highly recommend for petite ladies!
Outside, casual wedding! Such a flattering, fun dress! Got so many compliments. I loved how flowy and comfortable it was, and the pattern is so pretty. I wish I could buy this!

Gorgeous dress for a formal evening! The dress is absolutely stunning and perfectly flattering! My major concern with this dress (and any dress) was the length. At 5'11 finding a long enough dress is difficult. Paired with a short, 1.5" heel, this dress was just barely long enough. The zipper was tough to do up, but a friend was able to help me get it up. Once it was on, I was concerned about the sequins bothering me, but it wasn't an issue. The dress was a little warm, but not too warm. I felt incredible in this gorgeous dress, and people were complimenting me all night! It was such a treat to wear.

PERFECT DRESS FOR A SUMMER WEDDING! I have been eyeing this dress for a very long time and was hoping to be able to wear it for an event at some point. Luckily, my time came last weekend at a wedding in Seven Springs, PA. The dress is light weight, comfortable and sexy but conservative at the same time. I was able to eat, drink and dance all night. The dress photographs beautifully and I received multiple compliments throughout the night. I definitely recommend this dress and I hope you love it as much as I did. I was sad to have to return it.

Love the colors! This dress was perfect for a night out with the girls! I am 6'3 and it was a great length on me without being too short. It runs a little small and is a bit low cut. But still super flattering! I had fun wearing it! Received many compliments on the colors.

I rented this for a 70s/disco party my husband threw for my 50th birthday (tell me I don't look it!) This dress runs large for size, but true to length for size. I'm small in the bust and wide in the hips . . .  and after reading other reviewsI got both the SXR and SR. The SXR was too tight in the hips -- but even still was too big on top, making it evident it was designed for someone with a lot more upstairs than me (and I'm not talking brains here).  I wore the SR and pinned up the halter with tiny gold safety pins to make it shorter by about 3/4" to avoid it sagging (a common problem for me). It's also *very* low cut - a problem I solved with a little broach my mom wore in the 70s (tho on her lapel -- she'd faint if she saw my implementation). (I discovered after the party there is a hook & eye near the base of the V-neck. Frankly, my solution looked better on me anyway. So there.) But even with all this -- WOW! Did this dress hit the mark!! I had a "costume change" into this dress at the halfway mark of the party . . . and my fantasy of being a big shiny, happy disco ball came true! :D  This was my first TRT experience. And. It. Rocked.
Rented for a sail boat ride Loved the material and the style, however it was too tight around the upper ribcage for me

Such an elegant dress! This dress made me feel amazing! The fit was very flattering and the color was perfect for a summer wedding. I received compliments on it all night. It does run a bit small and I had ordered the 6R as my backup (but couldn't wear it due to damages on the dress upon receiving it) but all in all the fit and fabric were so flattering that I felt comfortable wearing my normal size. The length was perfect: I'm 5'4" and wore 3 inch heels.
My favorite top I rented this on the unlimited membership and have worn it multiple times. I always get compliments and feel it is the perfect spring/summer top!
Very cute jacket Its a very cute jacket but a bit big with a boxy feel.  Should have gone down a size.
. Dress runs a size or two large, so get your backup a size smaller. The dress is a great red color and got lots of compliments. Thick forgiving fabric without being too hot.
Wore to Work Very cute dress, and received many compliments.  It was tight across the shoulders.

Fun Dress was a little tight (I ordered a 6 and an 8 and was sent a 6 and a 10). I went with the 6 which was great but a little restrictive on the dance floor. Other than that I loved the dress! It looked great in photos and was perfect for a summer wedding.

Great fit, a little too short! This dress was so comfortable. It was a great fit in that it was stretchy and hug right to you. However, because of the stretch, it would slide up as you walked. I am 5'11" and it didn't reach the floor. I wore short heels for a black tie optional wedding. It was also pretty good for the heat of Houston in the summer - until we got to the dance floor and it did not breathe whatsoever. Wish it was a little longer, but overall, pleased with my Unlimited rental!

Perfect for a hot day! I rented this for a Memorial Day weekend trip to Austin. It was about 90 degrees or more while I was there, so I really needed an outfit that would make me feel comfortable in the heat while touring around. This dress was just what I was looking for. I love the pattern and the lightweight fabric--although for that reason, it's not a good dress for a windy place! The bust had a lot of room in it (I am a 36DDD and did not have a problem with the buttons). As a whole, the dress runs large. Would rent again.
This runs large and is not flattering This was HUGE! I am a busty person (28E), but the XXS swallowed me whole and made me look pretty large.

Gorgeous in Green This dress fit true to size. I received compliments all night long from friends to strangers. One thing I didn't anticipate was due to the strap placement high on the shoulders/neck, the straps felt tight when I sat down for long periods of time. Even when I pulled the dress up to ease the strap tension prior to sitting, the straps felt tight. That being said, it wouldn't stop me from renting this dress again. It was a beautiful dress!

Pretty dress I am 5'8 and ordered the long.  In 2 inch heels it was a little too long.  There are 2 layers - the first was a little snug but not unreasonably.  The second (outer) was perfect.  I ended up wearing another choice but I would definitely order this again but in a 6 regular.

I rented this dress for my formal holiday work party. This dress is very comfortable and breathable as its material is stretchy.  At first glance on the hanger it has a sort of costume look which I was a bit nervous about.   Then when i put it on along with the open back, the sequin shimmered and brightened the white making it sexy.  I got a M size but ended up going with the back up L because of the length.   With the open back and a little midsection chubbiness, I went to target and bought a few options of spanx and stick on bras to see what would work and returned what didn't.  I wore a high waist bikini spanx that didn't show and yes ladies stick on bras do stay on even when dancing all night. lol.      I had so many compliments and felt like a million bucks.   This dress was a win!

Outstanding (literally!) coral: not for wallflowers I wore this perky little number to a late summer wedding, and the color was truly outstanding - it's a day-glo coral, so don't be afraid to stand out. The open back with bow is tastefully flirty, and the pleats create an hourglass flare for you whether you're naturally curvy or not. Two notes: 1) the fabric is heavy and doesn't breathe very well,  and 2) if you don't wear a bra or fill out the front fully, you'll have some pointy business at the top of the chest seams (see photo)

This dress was beautiful but too big! The dress has little wires inside to keep the shape of the dress, but the wires poked out of the material and scratched me all night! It was such a pretty dress but also, the bust runs very large. I even wore a padded strapless bra and couldnt fill it all up! And I wear a 34D!

Perfect dress for a summer wedding on an island in Upstate NY Everyone has said it before me and it's true, this dress has no give and you should order a size up for your backup - I ended up wearing the larger size. I have a full bust and was able to wear a full bra with nude straps so it hardly showed. It's so cute so I was able to ignore that it really does put emphasis on your tummy area. I'm not sure why it's only when I wear RTR dresses, but I got compliments from strangers! Color combo is adorable. Looks more comfortable than it really is.

You'll get a zillion compliments.  I loved this dress. Everyone else seemed to as well! Only sizing issue I found was that the top is a bit snug if you have a larger chest. If an extra size is available, definitely go your typical size + one size up just to be safe!

Gorgeous and flattering dress! I rented this dress for an engagement shoot. It hugs and flatters very well. I was worried about the mesh section on the side, but it isn't too noticeable if you wear a nude toned bra. Overall, super happy with the rental!

This dress is beautiful! The subtle ombre and sequins are tasteful but gorgeous. The fit was pretty generous - I thought a twelve might not fit me, but it fit like a glove. This dress is a little bit low cut, be advised. The sequins can rub a little bit, but I wore this dress to a dance and was comfortable the entire time.

I was headed to a nightclub in Vegas. Nuff said! So I said it runs small as I don't generally need to buy clothes in an XL (granted, I rarely buy designer clothing).  It was a great fit though and my body looked awesome. You could totally go braless if you don't have a plunging one, but it looked way better with it!.  I loved that I felt so sexy, but I actually ended up with some minor scratches on my arm from the sequins.  All in all, a great dress for an event where you want to look really hot!

Great for a hot summer day I wore this to a birthday party that was on the water. I wore it off the shoulder, am normally a size 2 or 4 and the size fit well. It was little short, but I would definitely rent again.

I wore this to an outdoor wedding in the fall. The color of this dress is what sold me. A rich, vibrant emerald green. I ordered a 4 and 6 based on other reviews and unfortunately had to get an 8 overnighted to me. Customer service was helpful and friendly. I felt great in this dress. Comfortable for eating and dancing. Like many other reviewers I chose not to wear a bra due to the built in bodice, which offered enough support. This dress was a nice change from my usual color palette of dresses. Probably wouldn't rent again but am happy with the rental.

Beautiful dress.  Got lots of compliments.  Great color.  Perfect for a Florida wedding. I thought this dress would be stretchy, but it was not at all stretchy.  The 6 and the 8 both fit, but the 6 was very tight around my collarbone, so I switched to the 8 and was comfy.

Great colors and movement! I rented this skirt to wear out to dinner in Costa Rica.  For the occasion, it was perfect.  It was a little bit tight in the waist since there is no give, but, the fabric was beautiful.  It was also a little bit long for me and I am 5'6".

Everyday but cute and interesting outfit! This was a really cute dress, and perfect for a casual day at work. It's a little big - I could probably have worn one size down - but then it would have been really short. As it is, it's just on the cusp of appropriate for work. Really comfy, flattering when tied, and fun. Loved this piece!

Great summer dress for vacation in Croatia.  Runs a little large. I usually wear a small but could have worn xsmall. It is cut large in arms and a bit revealing in that area. Overall, great dress for travelling and summer.
Very flattering!! Fit like a glove and was really comfortable! The length was very classy, and the material hugged my body nicely. Sexy and sophisticated!

The event was a party for 15 years at the magazine I work for and it was fabulous! I was super nervous about renting a dress because I have never rented before but I read the reviews on this one and they were spot on. I ordered the medium and small for a back-up and actually could have worn the small but it was too short. The dress was comfortable, in GREAT shape, and I got many compliments on it. It traveled with me to my party and it didn't wrinkle at all in my suitcase. I did have to be careful about bending over due to it's length. I also wore a strapless bra with clear straps attached and that was a perfect solution- no worrying about my bra slipping! I would highly recommend this dress and get a size smaller than you think you need.

Pretty & Fun  I had originally rented a completely different dress but neither size I ordered was available to be sent to me.  Instead, RTR sent me three dresses, two dresses in 1 size and then the 3rd dress in 2 sizes.  This dress was better for the occasion (wedding) but was only sent in a size 12.  It was a little large on me but not noticeable to anyone else. 

I liked the dress much better in person than I did in the photo - the fabric was very comfortable and the fit was flattering.
Very flowy and pretty. I liked this top, didn't love it - it was a little too flowy for me, I just wish it was a bit more form fitting. By the fabric was pretty.

Beautiful Dress, but not for me. I ordered this dress in an 8P and a 10 R.  The 10 was not available and the 8P was too small for me.  I have a larger chest and the dress did not accommodate for it.  There was no stretch or give in the dress at all.  The 10 would have been a better fit.
Gorgeous color. A little overwhelming for petites. Great quality and the cobalt is beautiful. It was a little too overwhelming on my frame though (I normally wear size 00).

A little different but the sum of the parts is stunning I wasn't 100% sure about this dress but I'm so glad I tried it.  It was my birthday dress, and I wore it out for dinner and drinks with my husband.  It was easy to wear even in the summer heat because of all the mesh - I never felt too warm.  I also felt covered when in all reality my midriff and back were bare.  The skirt was a little structured because of the white piping and that made it stand out a little further than I'd have liked but it wasn't anything I couldn't deal with.  Lots of compliments!
It was my rehearsal dinner. I wore this to my rehearsal dinner and it just wasn't very flattering. If it wasn't such a crazy time, I probably would have tried to exchange it, but it was fine.

Didn't end up wearing This is a gorgeous dress and I would love to wear it, but I would probably need to order a size down. My normal size fit well in the chest, but the stomach had a lot of extra material that would not sit well.

this dress was so comfortable, i had recently had a baby and still had weight to lose and felt great loose up top, fell without being tight around the belly, so many compliments, it was on the longer side even with heels but i had some tall ones so no problem with tripping. had to pin the middle v neck cut as it was too loose with a regular bra. would rent it again in a heartbeat. at the time i weight more when i wore it.

Fit perfectly and was comfortable. Sexy and classy. Perfect for the NYE party I went to.  I'm 5'1" and the XS fell about 2 inches above my knee. Arms had a little extra length but not much, I actually preferred it this way. Fits close to body.
Gorgeous dress and color but SO small!!! I went a size up and it was still super snug. The fabric made it flattering despite the size. I would order, but order up
Love the length, very flattering Dress would ride up as I walked, but otherwise a great and comfortable fit.
Great wedding and great dress! Dress fit me slightly small, so I sized up! It's extremely flattering, and I would recommend it to anyone!

I rented this dress for my bridal shower & was happy overall. Beautiful color, gorgeous dress! I was a bit panicked when I first tried it on because it seemed SO short, but the stylist at the Manhattan store assured me this was just due to the tulle and the dress actually wasn't that short. I still wore pantyhose, since I wouldn't have felt comfortable otherwise! I didn't feel like I couldn't comfortably move around/bend down in it. Other than that, It was a gorgeous dress!! A beautiful blue/gray color that photographs well  & the neutral colored tulle at the bottom is very flattering and fun. I wore a belt with it to go with my "tea party hat" but I'm not sure I would have otherwise. Great dress!

Great fit, very beautiful detailing on the dress Thick material - use a stick on or strapless bra. Pair with basic heels - did black Louboutin heels and a clutch. Would look better on someone that has really toned shoulders/arms.

This dress is even more exquisite in person than in the pictures. Absolutely lovely dress!  I received so many compliments on this one.  The fabric and cut makes you feel quite regal.  I ended up going with a size smaller than I normally wear.  I also had to use a little fashion tape to secure the sides below the arms -worked perfectly.  It can be a little tricky to put on and you may need someone to help you with the zipper.  Overall, great choice for an elegant evening affair!

Golden Goddess but........... I rented the dress for a daytime wedding.  It is very sexy and very tasteful.  The dress runs extremely small.  Don't let the W on the larger sizes fool you, they still run small.  I usually wear a Misses size 16.  I ordered the 16W & 18W. That was a mistake.  The 16W was way too tight, the 18W was better and I wore that to the wedding.  A size 20 would have been perfect.  If you are considering renting this dress, expect to go up 2 sizes. I made due with a pair of Spanxs and I did not wear pantyhose.  The range of motion on the arms are limited because it was a little snug on me.  I live alone and could not manage to zip it all the way up.  I received assistance from a friend.  The 4 hanger loops in the dress are short and will come up everytime you move.  You will need to use a safety pin to keep them in place. Lastly the lining has a habit of peeking through the bottom.  All in all, a very pretty dress.  You will look amazing but it's a bit of a pain to wear.

warm, comfortable, and perfect for a chilly date night I wore this out to dinner and drinks and it was the perfect dress for the occasion. I just moved to a colder climate and this was kept me pretty warm, plus it was flattering on my figure. I had to fold over the top part a few times, but I expected that. It is a thicker material, which was a big plus for me.

Revealing, but comfortable Runs large. It's stretchy and it actually was still wearable and comfortable except for the shoulder straps. I'm 36D size 10/12 and this dress was way too revealing for a dinner/going out night Vegas. High slit was fun. Honestly, if I owned this dress, there is a way to tighten these straps by like 3 inches (safety pins? Rtr alterations?) It would've been a fun dress.

super comfy and elegant dress! I wore this dress to formal and it was super comfortable! The only major problem I would say it that it rode up a little and the zipper was on the side so it would bunch up and make my hips look weird. I am normally a size 4-sih but for this dress I went with the 2. Also, the dress went down rarely low on my thighs. The material is spandex-y so it's super flattering! I would definitely rent the dress again!

I felt gorgeous in this dress, it was perfect for an evening wedding. I rented the 16 with the 14 as back up. I am short and curvy so I ordered way up so it wouldn't be too tight/uncomfortable. I didn't notice that big of a difference with the sizing of the 14/16 so I went with the 16. It fit well, the bust was a little tight but the arms had a lot of room. It came below my knee but that was okay- still had room to dance. The color is way brighter in person and it really helps you to stand out in a sea of black that is usually in weddings/ special events. 
I recommend this dress.

Great dress- large top so size down! I loved this dress, and I wish it had fit just a little more snug. The waist fit well, but the top was loose which made me feel a little self conscious all night. The skirt was great with a fun pattern and some structure so it didn't cling- and the pockets were an added bonus. Probably would have rented a size down if I did it again!

Loved the color of this dress! This was actually my backup dress for a gala (the first one fit oddly).  I thought the dress fit great on the top, but since I'm on the shorter side, ran long.  I ended up belting it to shorten the length, and that worked out perfectly.  Overall, a solid dress!

Classy dress for an evening wedding. People are not kidding when they say it's tight/runs small.  I almost always fit perfectly in a size 8, but with this dress I had to size up.  The 8 did fit, very tight, but it would have been too uncomfortable to wear all night.  The 10 fit me how an 8 normally would.  That said, the dress was very classy and comfortably, but still sexy.  The length is more on the conservative side, so it was great for dancing.  Overall, this dress was perfect for a spring, evening wedding.  Just remember to size up for your backup dress!

I got SO many compliments on this dress - I wish I could keep it! This dress is very well made. The fabric is thick enough to hide any lines and I didn't need to wear a bra with it. Either size would have worked but I was more comfortable in the 4 when I was sitting down.  I'm 5'4'' and the length was perfect with 3'' heels.

Stylist Review! This dress is so fun and retro! I love the 50's style of this dress and how it hugs your curves. I wore a size 8 (46) and I normally wear a size 10. This was a little tight on me, but the largest size is a size 8 so I would recommend getting a size up as your back up! Its very fitted at the waist but there is comfortable room throughout the midsection. Curvier women should consider sizing up for full hips. This can be worn with any standard bra, which is great for women with a fuller chest! I wear a 36D and there was comfortable room at the bust - great for any cup size! This dress would be great to wear to work, or even a 50's theme party! Pair it with black strappy sandals for a chic look!

Spring Fun! This top is a great texture...airy but well-made. It looks great with jeans and would also pair well with a skirt and some espadrilles. All the colors bring out whatever natural hue you have, without being too kitschy. Loved it.
nice tights but it was too small Awesome outfit but the tank is really thin and the pants were too tight.   I'm normally a 12-14

Very tight. Very plum. This dress was not my first choice. My original dress came back damaged from the previous renter, and this was a last-minute replacement. I have worn Elizabeth and James before, so I thought I was safe on the size. I was WRONG. I normally wear a 2, but I have to go up to a 6 in E&J. In the case of this dress, I should have gotten an 8. It is SO TIGHT. It looked pretty sexy when I first put it on (see photo), but by the end of the wedding (after I ate a meal and drank some wine), I looked and felt like a stuffed sausage. Beautiful, classy dress, but I do not understand why it runs so small. Go TWO to THREE sizes up on this one.
This is a beautiful statement jacket! This item runs large.  I wish it was available in an xxs.

Comfortable, classy & sexy! The fit was spot on. I could have worn the 6, but went with the 8 for more room to walk/dance. Worn with nude heels. A bit clingy to the middle section (my problem area), but the overall fit was fantastic. I wore this to an outdoor evening wedding ceremony, received compliments all evening. I felt confident and comfortable, The shimmer/sparkle is incredible and the back is stunning!

Beautiful dress but VERY small! Very fitted from chest to hips! The zipper is very poor quality. I ordered both one and two sizes higher than my usual, per the other reviews that said it was very small. Unfortunately the zipper on the larger size was broken and couldn’t be worn. It is a 2 person job to get you zipped up! Once I was in it though, it looked great! I got many compliments all night! I wouldn’t recommend if you don’t like tight dresses, or showing off your curves. Otherwise it is a showstopper!

Loved the color of this dress, it's perfect for spring! I wore this dress to a wedding and received lots of compliments. It's fitted and the fabric is stretchy. I am 5'4 and 118 lbs and I wore a size 2.
Loved this dress! Got so many compliments on the lace! Would rent again! Did not ride or rise up at all. Lace was a little tight on the arms
Loved it, very glamorous, great fit, seems to have some leeway to the fit. Has some leeway for the fit as it is stretchy.
got so many compliments! really fit well, stretchy.  could be a bit longer, runs short

It was a beautiful and elegant wedding, the dress fit perfect with the occasion. It fit true size in the hips but a little big in the top, anyway I used a strapless bra with a filled cup and it worked and I was very comfortable in the dress. Definitely I will rent again and recommend it widely.

Not needed back-up I rented this as a back-up to my original gown. I'm glad my original choice worked perfectly. The fit on this was a bit tight in the shoulder/sleeve area. The color was also not right for me.

Team RTR Review I loved this skirt - it was perfect for work with a tee but could easily be worn more formally with a heels and a blouse. The waist had little give so I recommend sizing up higher than your normal size if this is a problem area for you. Otherwise there was much room in the hips and the length was just right!
Vegas dress --Perfect! I wore this dress to Vegas, absolutely gorgeous. Perfect size. I'm normally a medium, or sometimes even a large, but the small fit absolutely perfect.

This dress was absolutely amazing and worked well for the occasion !! I was a bit worried about using this service since i'd read some bad reviews online but i decided to take the plunge and give it a go. First of all i received it promptly (next day delivery) . I loved the fact that they send you that back up size.
It was well packaged upon arrival and clean. I loved the quality of the dress - it was just thick enough so you don't have those underwear lines printing through and the fit was just right . This dress shows quite a bit of side boobage and there is no way to wear a bra (mind you that i'm small around the bust so this may not be very comfortable on some one with a fuller bust). I loved the slit in the front to show off cute shoes !

My only issue was that the strap was becoming loose from the dress (the threading that was holding the strap to the front bodice) but customer service was excellent on their part ! They offered me a partial reimbursement and was very polite . The rep (Kayla T) even gave me some advice as to how to keep it intact with out damaging the fabric since i did not have time to do an exchange . 

This is a perfect way to wear a jaw dropping dress and make a memorable appearance without breaking the bank for a dress you may only wear once in your life . 

i would definitely recommend this business :)

This dress was absolutely stunning. I usually wear a 4 but I wore a 6 so it runs a little small.  I felt so glamorous in this dress. It was for a very formal occasion and it was just perfect. Fantastic choice!
Loved this dress. Fit was great.  The material pulled you in no spanx required however it was a little on the heavy side but that didn't stop me from dancing. Everyone loved my dress.
Shape of the dress is fab. Overall good fit. Could have done a size down bc material stretches. Fit was great. Material is thin so it stretches a little. I will definitely rent again.
Did not wear as I ended up wearing the Jill Stuart red cherry dress instead.  Good stretch would have been comfortable to wear for any occasion, ran slightly big IMO.

Great night Overall RTR experience was great.  Color and comfort of the dress are definitely the best attributes.  I would normally have preferred to wear something a bit more flattering and form fitting but in this dress I was able to eat and drink well all night without feeling self conscious about my "belly" showing.
Felt great! Great dress!  Only 5'6 and the dress was pretty short!
Wore it to a 1920s themed party and it was perfect! Runs on the larger size. Traditionally wear an 8 but went with the back-up 6. Easy to wear with a racer back bra. Perfect length.

I rented this for a black tie wedding in manhattan. All in all, it is a beautiful dress, not perfect The size definitely runs large. I usually wear a 12L but I fit into the 10L perfectly. The length was just right. I am 5'8" and wore flats and it exactly brushed the floor. My one major complaint was that the sequins really bothered my arms. I should have thought of this, but, I had never worn so many sequins for such a long period of time. The constant brushing against the sequins leaves your arms very raw and red. Also, the V-neck in the front was very low, mine happened to come in with a minor stitch in the front which helped with coverage. This was my second choice, my first was a similar Badgley Mischka which wasn't long enough in a 12R. I was happy that I had a new dress to wear but  was not completely satisfied with comfort and fit.
Amazing color! Such a fun dress to wear! You will definitely stand out in a crowd. Great pop of color!

Comfy but runs large! This sweater arrived new with tags (which I was EXTRA jazzed about) and was just as pictured/expected. The sweater is super comfy and has a fun scalloped hem on the bottom. I will say that this runs pretty large and fairly boxy. I definitely could have sized down to a S.

Love this dress, would definitely rent again!  The material itself is somewhat thicker than I would have wanted for a summer party but I received many compliments which made it worth it! I love anything with a belt at the waist and this didn't disappoint.  Sliming while still being relaxed.

Stunning! The dress fit perfectly and was a show-stopper for sure. Everything was comfortable and it photographed beautifully! I even rented the necklace to really make a statement. I was sad to send everything back! Definitely a Cinderella moment.
THE perfect birthday dress!   I wore it for my birthday. Made me look slim and fancy. Hid my spare tire of a tummy.

Decent but informal  I was disappointed in the fabric of the dress. It was more casual than I would have liked for an evening wedding. I would recommend this dress for a daytime event. I have a larger chest and the dress gave it nice coverage without being too revealing which i liked.

Gorgeous, high end dress! I rented this dress for NYE and loved it. The dress fits snug so you feel sexy but not so tight that it cannot be worn to a nicer event. I was worried the dress would be hot or heavy, but it wasn't at all! The long sleeves were my favorite part!

Beautiful color I'm typically a medium with JOA, but with their shift dresses I would suggest sizing down! The small fit me perfectly in this dress. The color was beautiful and I loved the high neckline. So many compliments on the color! I'm 5'6" and felt very comfortable with the length wearing wedges. Contemplating buying.
Cute dress This dress was very comfortable. I don't know that it was he most flattering, but it's great as a sundress for walking around.
Very nice dress I would recommend to get a size smaller then regular size. Very narrow in the arm but a very nice dress

Stylist Review! This is a great, versatile top for summer! Cobalt is a standout in person, and the open back adds an edge. It runs true to size, and is very comfortable at the midsection. The bust is fitted, so I recommend this top for A to C cup sizes.  Due to the criss-cross open back, a nubra bra would be needed or you can go bra-less.  This top would look great with white shorts or skinny jeans and a statement necklace to complete your look!

The perfect dress! This dress was a back-up to a back-up, and I was really just looking for "average" by that point. The stylists were SO helpful during the whole ordeal and got me two different dresses in just under 24 hours so I had plenty of time before the party. This dress had promise, but when I put it on, it was absolutely stunning! I probably could have gone a size down, but to be honest was excited about having lots of room for eating and drinking. The dress stayed bouncy and flirty and everyone loved it. I will rent this one again!

Perfect rehearsal dinner dress I wore this for my rehearsal dinner and it was absolutely gorgeous. I saw the all white version of this dress at BHDLN which cost $800. I loved this black/white version for 1/8 of the cost! It was about ankle length on me since i'm only 5'1, but it was so pretty and a great fit. Got tons of compliments and felt really special for my big day.

Lightweight and comfy This is a cute little romper. I wore an XS, and thought it for great (but if you're fuller around your hips you would maybe want to size up). The material was very light, and it's such a basic style that it's really easy to match shoes and jewelry with. I wore a red jacket over it the whole night and liked the look. Be warned- the V is DEEP! You'll definitely need fashion tape.

Team RTR Review I wore this dress to an engagement dinner and loved it. It had the perfect shape and was both dressy and modern. The shift shape allowed for much room - great for all body types but the bust area does pull slightly near the shoulders so I recommend sizing up if you have a bust size larger than a B. Otherwise, I would highly recommend!

Beautiful, classy & formal. I liked this dress. It is formal. I usually wear a 6, but the 4 fit nicer.  I do have a full bust and it was very accomodating! The material is stretchy so it is super comfortable.
This was perfect for a fancy brunch bridal shower. Fit was great, but the scarf/neck wrap is *long*.
Perfect Bachelorette Dress Rented this dress for my bachelorette. Amazing fabric. Darker color in person. Runs a bit large.  I'm usually a 4, went with the size 2! So many compliments!

Fit like a glove! Great color! This dress was super flattering. I wouldn't have chosen it off the website, but I tried it on, on a whim in the RTR store (thinking there was no way the size 38 would fit) and was sold!

Lots of compliments especially with necklace. Pros: Fun flowy skirt. Heels made the trail the right height. Flattering to large breasted women.
Cons: Torso part was too big, while the waist band was too small. My originally plan 6R went to the 4R because the sleeves would slip. Waist band didn't differ between 6R and 4R much. Tight squeeze for 29in!
In conclusion: Excellent for regular size women, but be cautious with this option if petite.

Great dress- sexy and classy. I would definitely rent this again! But I may go with a smaller size next time.  It gapped where the sheer part is in the waist, which kinda bugged me, but it fit everywhere else.  It was still really fun to wear.  I was a little worried about the sleeve length bc i'm so tall, but they were plenty long!
was too big, sent it back.   its very pretty and had it fit I'm sure I would have loved it, but alas it was too big.
I love this dress.  It is very comfortable and the lace detail is beautiful.  Wish I owned it! Runs a bit on the larger side--I would consider going down a size.
Love this design. I probably should have got an XS but it wasn't available.

This dress was super fun to wear! Sexy and eye catching. You will be praised in this dress.  It's a snug fit. I normally wear an 8 but looked like a can of biscuits so I sized up for the 10 and felt great. It is very short so be prepared to find new ways of sitting and standing. All in all its super flattering.

a twist to a high tea birthday party! I LOVED this jumpsuit. I rented it to wear to my high tea party to celebrate my birthday. I loved that it is pink chiffon so that it goes well with the tea party theme, but also adds a bit of an edge being backless and a jumpsuit. I received so many compliments! I also loved that it hid my lower belly well so that I could eat a lot!

Gorgeous for a Fall Wedding! I rented this for an October wedding, and it was perfect! The color is more plum than it looks in the photos, but it worked perfectly. Its really form fitting, and the perfect combo of sexy & classy. It does run a bit small so size up.

It's comfortable and sexy!  It fits well, the fabric is great, it's a bit racy if you're big-chested but not scandalous. You could see a little bit of boob from the keyhole opening but not terrible. No need to wear a bra.

Really Sexy Dress! Rented this dress for a casual night out with my friends.  Got lots of compliments with this dress.  I wore Size 6 and the length was just perfect, falls right above my knee.  I wouldn't mind renting this dress again for a casual party!

Gorgeous Color! This dress was awesome.  I am 5'6'' 127, and I am so glad my backup size was the XS. Definitely size down for this one.  It was a very loose, comfortable fit.  I wore it with 4 inch heels- my sister hated it until I put the heels and long dangly necklace on, then she loved it! The color is amazing.
Cute weekend romper.  Found that the lining of the short peeked out a bit. Wouldn't wear for an event, but was fun to run around town in.

STYLIST REVIEW Bust: 36 A/B, Waist: 30-32, Hips: 40-42. This dress is perfect for that fun winter floral trend right now! Certainly wont be wearing a strapless bra with this one, and there is no extra built in support in the front, so no bra or a Nu Bra will be needed. I'm about 5'6", and this number hit be just above my knee, so its a great length for a slew of heights. I'd recommend this for all body types, except those with a baby bump, since the natural waist line may hit you a little too low to be comfortable. Pair this with a cool Kate Spade clutch and some fun chunky jewelry. The fabric of this style has no stretch at all, so go with your usual size and a backup size up.

I got so many compliments on how gorgeous the dress was! So happy with the rental. It surprisingly ran a little big- didn't have to wear spanx which is nice. But fits very well. Rubs a little under the arms because of the sequins but overall LOVED the dress!

The dress was beautiful! Got compliments all evening! The dress definitely runs small. I expected to wear the XS but it wouldn't even zip up. I am usually a 0 or 2. The S fit but was still tight around the bust. I ended up wearing a backless bra because I didn't like how you could see the bra outline in the back because it was too tight, it also peeked out from under the arms. Once that was resolved it fit perfectly. The dress is a little more matte than in the pictures. It also was a little lower on me than on the model, I'm 5'2". With all that said I still loved it! Would definitely recommend it just keep in mind it runs small.

Loved this dress! I ordered a 2 and a 4 and wound up wearing the 4.  The 2 fit better on top but tended to ride up around the hips.  The 4 draped better overall  (My measurements are 34-28-37).  Very sparkly and fun.  Fully lined so it is OK to wear without a bra.  Great dress!

Classy, comfortable, and sexy I loved this dress so much, it fit great and transitioned well from day to night for an early outdoor wedding.  I was a little surprised with how much cleavage it showed.  I wear a D cup and while I did not need a bra with this dress (it has a great built-in), it was a little revealing but in a very classy way.  It was perfect with the color, cut, lace, and length.  I would definitely rent this again because I received so many compliments.  I wore it with black wedge heels and silver jewelry.
Head turner! Fantastic dress, excellent quality. Just a beautiful overall fit. Very flattering. I recommend spanx

NOT flattering on petite frames. I didn't bother with a photo, because it was that bad. The dress fit well and the top was super flattering but the baggy shape just did nothing for my 5'0 frame. Still a beautiful dress and if you're a little taller would definitely recommend. I had my mom try it on to make sure (she's 5'5") and it looked amazing on her!
Classy, Flowy, Gorgeous Absolutely loved this top.  Looking to buy it.  Classy style and fit yet with a bohemian flare.  Great material and I received compliments all night.  Truly loved it.

Perfect dress for any occasion! This was my first experience with HL.  This dress was a great value so I didn't hesitate to rent it prior to a girls weekend in Miami.  It took a village to help me zip it up, but I blame 'the girls' for that one.  Once it was on, it was comfortable and SO flattering.  I received a ton of compliments and overall felt great all night.
Bday Date Night The fit was a bit big, but it didn't seem too noticeable.  I love the edgy, sexy feel of the romper.  Very comfortable!

Cute, but a bit large. I normally wear a size 0 so I ordered the XS, but it was still a bit large in certain areas. The straps kept slipping down my shoulder and the jumper was not fitted around the chest/torso and hip areas. That being said, it wasn't noticeably large either, just not well-fitted. Other than that it is a super cute jumper and is very very comfy. Received lots of compliments and felt very stylish in it. I wore it to a holiday dinner for a law firm and it was very appropriate.

Too short! Gorgeous in person and upper part fit perfect, bottom was baggy. I am 5'7 and if I raised my arms my butt was in full view. Couldn't wear it. Def for shorter girls. I usually wear a 0 or 2 and the 4 fit best.

Very nice, but maybe too much room... I rented this for a wedding, but didn't end up wearing it because I was afraid it was not fancy enough. I put that it runs true to size since I don't think I could have gone smaller around my back, but there was a lot of room in the stomach.
I wore this for a Gala event and received lots of compliments. Recommend! I'd go a size up           Had a small issue with the zipper it's hard to zip up.

Nice, lightweight material.  I loved the color of this jumpsuit; unfortunately it ran a bit large on me. Normally I wear a medium in most things but this jumpsuit in the medium I think is made for someone taller. I am 5'2 and the waist tie was below my hips. Will definitely rent this again in a smaller size!

Tornado, no power, candlelit dancing, but I also had an amazing dress! The dress was absolutely beautiful. I changed my order from a 4 & 6 to a 2 & 4 because of the other reviews. I'm very glad I did. The 2 was just a little tight around the chest, but fit great around my mid-section, whereas the 4 was just a little too big. Very beautiful dress and I received so many compliments about it!

I wore it for my Bridal shower. I loved the way this dress made me feel!  The dress was pretty tight in the boob region. I would recommend that if you have some decent sized ladies that your should size up. I was able to fit in the small size but it made my boobs plastered to my chest.

Favorite Rental EVER. I've never loved rompers...until this one.  I wore this out to a club in Charleston for my friend's bachelorette and it was flattering, comfortable and I got so many compliments...even in flats!
could not wear! WAS TOO BIG! RAN TOO BIG!

Pretty Dress! This dress runs true to size, maybe even a bit large. I added a strapless bra to help keep up the top portion and it worked perfectly. Minimal to no adjusting all night. Very comfortable fit that was flattering without being too tight and a beautiful nude color.

Amazing Quality and Detail. Much better in person than in photos My dress didn't come in on time so I was able to walk into the NYC RTR and pick out a dress to replace it. This beauty stood out. When flipping through dresses, this one stood out from the rest because of its amazing detail and fantastic quality. You know when you can just tell that somethings is made better than others? I took a close up of the "waistband" and bottom detail, hopefully it shows it better. This isn't a dress I would have picked based on website photos bc I would have thought it was a little boring. It's anything but in person.

I've got less info on sizing because I squeezed myself into a 0 since that's all they had in the shop. I'm typically a 4 but I could tell a 2 would have been perfect for this dress. So i'll say pick a size down for your backup. The "regular" length was too short but I went with it. I wonder if a 2 regular would have worked though.

Nothing better than a dress with pockets! This was a great dress for a fall wedding. My normal size was too big on top, and had some room in the waist, so I'm glad I ordered the size down, as that's what I wore for the event. Dress was comfortable to dance in and looked great in photos. I was not a fan of some of the details - where the skirt meets the bodice has a revealed hem, which looks kind of sloppy to me, but I'm no fashion expert. But still a solid rental overall.

Stylist Review  I was in love with this jumpsuit the moment I tried it on. The deep V along with short length give it a very sexy feel. I also love the contrasting long sleeve. One thing I would note about this jumpsuit is the tight fit in the arms, for this reason I felt like I could have gone with a size larger than my normal.
fits well, looks nice fits well, looks nice
Amazing dress! Compliments for days after the event. Fully recommend.  Wore it to our school gala. Was nervous about the 2L, I'm 5'5, but wore it with high heels and it perfectly skimmed the floor.

Super comfy!  This dress was absolutely perfect for my birthday weekend. I wore it for a day of winery tours and it was so comfortable. The straps are stretchy so you almost don't even feel them. I loved the mid-length look and the pockets. It was a perfect casual dress that could also be dressy. I really wanted to keep this one.

Ease and comfort! I am a tall, triangle-shaped lady. The dress was very comfortable, but even sizing down a little, it felt a little "gappy" around the bust. So, not a perfect fit, but it worked. Good for an outdoor summer wedding. Great fun on the dance floor, and my iphone fit right into one of the pockets!
Really cute! I wore this to a birthday party with black shorts. A little tight but I needed a 4. I wore the 2 though and I loved it.
Amazing for a Gala My husband was amazed! It was conservative enough with a slight edge!
N/A It was a size too small - I hope to order it a size up and try again.

The BEST formal non-maternity, maternity dress!  I was 27 weeks pregnant and so nervous about finding a dress (preferably non-maternity) that would fit well. This dress exceeed all of my expectations and fit perfectly everywhere - I didn't even need to use fashion tape on my chest (win!). 
Not pregnant, I usually wear a size 2-4, so I ordered a 6 and 8. The size 8 ended up fitting the best (mainly in the front slit, since the belly pulls it up prettt high). If your close to your third trimester and looking for a formal dress this is the one!!

Wedding ORDER A LARGER SIZE.  I am 5'7'' with an athletic build (135 lbs) and I almost couldn't get the dress zipped at my regular size 6.   Also, runs a little long, so you'll have to wear platform shoes so it doesn't drag.  I put on 4 inch platforms and it was still sitting on the ground.  I didn't end up wearing this dress because it didn't fit, but I didn't find the shape too flattering.  Its a little more of an A-line and not straight how it looks on the model.  Elizabeth and James usually has really flattering dresses, but this one didn't do it for me.  If you have an athletic build like me, I would skip this one.

The quality of the dress is outstanding. I am athletic on the top so I had to go with the larger size.
The zipper is a nightmare and if my husband was not there and I had to get into it alone I would never have gotten the zipper up.

Beautiful spring/summer wedding dress! This dress got so many compliments - all night. The color is a bit more teal than the royal blue color I was expecting but was a great color! As many others reviewed, this dress runs small. The 2 fit but would have been less comfortable for sitting and dancing at a wedding. Even with a larger chest on a smaller frame, the dress fit really well and I didn't have to wear a bra!

Great for the corporate party This is a really beautiful dress. I ordered it along with another one so I could choose when they came. I know that DVF typically runs small, so I ordered one and two sizes up from my usual size 8. The 12 is the one that fit. From the front, it was gorgeous, but the zipper in the back just detracted from the dress. It wouldn't quite lay flat and it's so industrial looking that it doesn't compliment the overall elegance of the dress. I decided to wear my second choice. This may work better for someone who is less curvy to help the zipper lie flat.

Classy But Sexy Dress I rented this dress for Thanksgiving in Las Vegas. It was sexy enough to keep up with the ladies of Vegas, but not so over the top that I felt uncomfortable at a nice restaurant. The lace is pretty thick, as is the black fabric in the front, so I didn't need to wear a bra with the dress, which I was psyched about. Those backless bras never work out for me, and having a bra strap across the back would have definitely ruined the classiness of this dress. I'm usually between a 4 and 6, and ordered the M, but probably needed the small. It was roomy, but wearable. A smaller size would have helped create/define my waist - since it was roomy, the lace cutouts on the waist didn't wrap around as much as I wanted them to... but it was still gorgeous! For comparison, I also ordered and wore the Parker Tia dress in a size medium, and that one fit and was borderline too tight, and I also own a few Parker dresses in size 6, and in size medium -- this definitely runs larger than any other Parker dresses I've worn.

Elegant! This dress was worn at a graduation.  The dress was very comfortable.  It does run a bit larger than a size 0, it felt more like a size 2, which I also ordered as a backup.  I'd like to add that the size 2 dress was free of charge, which was even better!  I received my order, with another dress and a purse, a day earlier than anticipated!  I'm very happy that it did because I was able to decipher if whether or not it was the "ideal" look I was hoping for, and it was!

Very small on top even if you size up After reading the other reviews, I ordered a size larger than I usually wear, but it still didn't help. Once I got it on, I couldn't raise my arms, and it was so tight on the top it made my chest look flat. It was also too big at the waist because of the larger size, so I ended up not wearing it. It's a really cute color though, I just wish it were designed better.

Super easy to wear and great cut! These are soooo lovely but they do run big. The crop is perfect-- wore with a wedge espadrille and a simple t-shirt. I could have easily gotten the 0 but the 2 was fine with a bit of room. Loved these and will def get again!
The people and pictures! Great fit. Strong fabric held everything in. Flattering and showed just enough skin to be sexy and classy.

LOVED this dress! I would rent it again! I received so many compliments on this dress! It hugs your body in all the right places and made me feel super sexy. I was also able to wear a regular bra, which is a bonus! As many of the other reviewers commented, the dress runs small and I had to go up a size. The sequins left the underside of  my arms somewhat scratched and irritated, but the dress was still worth it!
Great dress.  Loved the style - so different, yet classic. This dress was great.  I felt so pretty in it and got so many compliments!  It was formal but comfortable all night long.  Loved it!

Pretty Color - Tight in the arms This is a great dress! It was a little tight right under the arms, but nothing I couldn't deal with. Also wore strapless bra and spanks. Danced the night away and received a lot of compliments.
Perfect for a night in Vegas!  The large was big so I went with the medium and it was a great fit! I bought fabric tape because I was unable to wear a bra. Perfect for a flashy Vegas dress!
The fit is ok, not great. Doesn't feel designer.  Nice through the bust but not cinched enough at the waist to make the slightly shapeless waist-to-shin silhouette work.
This dress is amazing. I did not want to take it off.  I wore this to my daughter's rehearsal dinner. I got so many compliments .

Daytime bachelorette attire Something about Lilly shift dresses...even though I have a larger chest, I ALWAYS have to size down.  I'd recommend going down AT LEAST one size.  I feel like I could have done two and it would still have been cute.  That being said, great dress, very comfortable, would wear something similar again!

wore it for a bridal shower I'm usually an 8, and the 8 fit ok, it was just very tight in the bust, so I opted for the 10 for comfort.  Very cute, nice bright reddish pink color, great length for a shower.
Great dress!  I wore this to a cocktail party and it was a hit.
So comfortable. Flowed so nicely. Got gobs of compliments.  Looked great with gold bracelets.
It was a unique shape and I loved it and received compliments all day!  In love with the print on this dress. The fabric is a little bit heavier than expected, but overall I was very happy with it!

Interesting mixture of racy and demure Very pretty dress.  I found it to run every so slightly large on the top (for a small busted person).  It was an interesting mixture of racy and demure with the leather top and midi length pleated skirt.

This dress is so unique with it's champagne color and black highlights. Got lots of compliments! I knew that I had to make sure I looked red carpet ready because the wedding I was invited to was that of a fashion conscious couple. I ordered the size 2 and the 4 as the back-up. I ended up wearing the 4 because the zipper didn't work well on the 2. The 2 also seemed to be more snug, whereas the 4 fit like a glove. I am usually a size 0/2, so I would say this dress runs a little small. The color of the dress is beautiful too. I loved the fact that the front of the dress was a little shorter than the back. It is a very well made dress, with a built in slip. I received many compliments on the dress and would recommend it for a special event.

Perfect dress for an event or just every day! I really love the print and fabric of this dress.  It is super fun for spring and it has pockets!  I thought that the torso of this dress was a bit short, I was it was a tad bit longer.  The lining on the neckline also kept peeking out and it bothered me, as it was noticeable. I wore it with a coral cardigan, tan flats and pretty gold jewelry. The fit was nice, definitely not tight at all and pretty comfortable.  I would love to wear this again for a spring event.

Absolutely stunning dress! Body con, hugs all your curves.  Wore an XS (S was too big).  I wore this dress to a co-worker's afternoon/early evening fall wedding. Since there were going to be senior level staff there I wanted to look classy, but still a little sexy. This dress was a show stopper! I received compliments throughout the night from the dance floor, to the restroom, to the line at the bar. I am a very athletic female so finding a dress that makes me feel feminine and sexy without looking awkward or inappropriate is very hard. I danced comfortably the whole time and did not want to go home after the wedding- I wanted to go out to show off the dress even more!  I went with the XS as the S was just too big.  As a small chested female you can certainly get away without wearing a bra as it is a tight dress and the fabric is thick. Highly recommend this dress to anyone looking to feel fabulous and turn heads!

Order a size up and you'll be fine  I think if I ordered a larger size, I'm almost certain that this would have been fine. I usually do a small in tops but because of where the sleeves lay on the arm, I just couldn't lift my arms without creating a bubble of material on my chest. If you're planning on moving your arms (or have children), order a size up and that should solve the problem.

Perfect for a formal wedding. The dress was perfect for my height (5'-2") where it didn't get caught in my shoes or cause me to trip over the dress. The dress is very forgiving but isn't too loose once you slip it on.  The back feels low but I didn't have issues with my strapless bra showing on my back. People gave many compliments on the dress and I felt like I blended in at the very formal wedding that I attended. You will feel like you are on the red carpet when wearing this dress and the lovely thing is you can keep the jewelry and accessories simple.

Cute but awkwardly cut. I ordered a small because I read that there was a little stretch to the material. The top itself is fairly short waisted I spent most of the night pulling it down so the waist would be in the right spot. There's very little stretch to the material which made the arm holes a bit tight.
Didn't end up wearing was sick Ran small
super easy and cute dress It is comfortable, cute and very versatile.  I have worn it to a bbq and to a rehearsal dinner.
Great dress! Runs small, but with right size it fits every curve in the right way. Thick material so not ideal for summer outside. Would rent this dress again.

So obsessed with the versatility of this dress, I'm buying it for myself. I got this as one of my unlimited choices for a weekend trip to see family. This dress is perfection- you can easily dress it up with some jewelry and heels for a night out, or wear it to work/classes with lace up flats or boots.  It has two minor flaws though- the first is that it runs large. I got the 34 and could have easily gone a size down. The second is that the last button on the bottom of the dress is like six inches from the actual bottom, which is great for movement, but can be scandalous in certain situations, so proper underwear is necessary.
I was so comfortable in this dress and would totally order it again.  It was a little big on me. But it was still comfortable and I felt really good in it.
The Perfect Sexy but Classy Dress for a Night Out It fit great and was exactly what I expected when I ordered it. There is a built-in bra-thing so no need to wear a bra with it.

Loved, loved, loved this dress!!! The fit is so flattering for many body types, but maybe particularly if you want to cover up bigger hips and arms. Great for a smaller bust. The fabric feels pretty luxe and the swinging a line bottom is so fun. Got tons of compliments on this dress, just stunning!

Stunning eye-catching dress! This dress was absolutely amazing! This was my first time using RTR and I will definitely use it again. Both addresses arrived and to my delight I was able to wear the one two sizes smaller than I thought I needed. The fabric is thick in a good way and keeps all of those soft areas of your body in place, so much so that I didn't have to wear a spanx or a bra with this dress. This dress is particularly flattering for curves, which isn't always the case. I would tell you to err on the side of the smaller of the two sizes that you get to achieve the best fit. I rented this for a date night on the town and I got so many compliments every place we went. This dress screams "class". Rent this dress NOW. You will not be sorry!

My sister got engaged!!!! I rented this for sister for her special date night. Turned out even better because she got engaged. 

Great dress. She loves it and would wear it again. 

#engaged #datenight #truelove

PERFECT for a beach getaway  I wore this dress to dinner one night while on a girls trip to Rosemary Beach. It was the PERFECT sunset dinner dress. The colors were spectacular. The dress fit me very well up top and I'm fairly small chested, however it was a bit too loose in the waist area. For the pictures my girlfriends grabbed the dress from the back and took it in a little ;) But even thought it was a bit large, I would still recommend this dress for a beach vacation for sure.

Gorgeous dress!! It seems the dress runs a little big but not too crazy big. I'm between sizes 12 and 14 so I went with the size 12 and it was still a bit lose but a comfortable lose. It was the perfect length, it was sexy and I received many compliments.
This was the best value in formal attire for women. True to form and delivered on time.

Dress it up or down Great feminine top for jeans or skinny black pants. Runs a bit small with No stretch in fabric.
Wore with a black regular lace bra. With Unlimited I don't spend all my clothing $ on clothes I have a more extensive lingerie, shoe, jean collection to augment the faboulous rentals! Love RTR.

Wore to Jimmy Buffett concert Perfect for a concert, wedding, or any fun event. The colors are vibrant and bright. I got tons of compliments. I love the tassel detail on the back of the dress. I love this dress so much, I may have to buy it!

Lovely bridal shower dress! I wore this dress for my bridal shower and received many compliments. I love that it has pockets as that's always a perk for me when dresses have them! The size 4 fit, but I thought the 6 gave a little more length, which is always a concern for me and also gave me a little more room to move since the 4 seemed to be tight across the shoulders when I lifted my arms.

I attended a black tie wedding in the fall. This is dress is unbelievable on! I felt so amazing in it :) You could get away with wearing a regular bra with it but I was so nervous that a little bit of the strap might show that I just opted for a strapless bra. I wore this dress for 10 hours and I never felt like it needed to come off. It was not heavy and so easy to dance in! I wore 3 inch heals and the dress hit the floor perfectly. I would definitely recommend a long if you are tall. The pictures I attached don't do it justice, just bad lighting. I received so many compliments throughout the night!!

I had a hard time returning this dress! I wore this dress to a wedding and got SO many compliments! It was very comfortable, and very flattering because it hit at my natural waistline (my narrowest part) and flared out slightly over my stomach and hips. I was able to wear a regular bra that was very close to my skin color, and it was not obvious at all. The bust fit well (I'm 34DD), but didn't have much room to spare. I would definitely not recommend this dress for anyone shorter than 5'6". The back hem was only a couple of inches above my ankles, and I'm 5'7". Overall, would absolutely rent this dress again, and highly recommend it!
Cute but wrong size! Dress was super cute but too big.  I'm usually a 4 and the 40 didn't work - I would need a 38.

I got many compliments on the lace detailing over the nude slip, made the dress look very intricate. Everything about this dress was perfect, except for the length. It was a bit shorter than I am comfortable with. However, I still wore it to the event and still got lots of compliments. I did end up wearing the larger back up size, only to get some more coverage on my legs.

Great alternative to an LBD Wore this for a bachelorette party. Super great form fitting dress, and nice to have something a little different than an LBD.
