It looks really dark, almost black, in photographs, but in person it's a really nice dark blue. Thick fabric hides all bumps and lines, but it's stretchy enough to be flattering on pretty much any body type.

I got tons of compliments on this dress and it was perfect for a formal fall wedding!  I had read that this dress fit a little bit big, so I took everyone's advice and went down a size and was happy with my choice! I ended up wearing the 0 and it fit perfectly. The color is a bit more magenta in person than the maroon that it appears to be in pictures.

LOVED IT!! Very colorful and comfortable. The fit was great when I went one size down. I wore a bra with crossed straps and you couldn't see them at all. I loved the fabric of this dress, as it was extremely comfortable and breathable. I received a ton of compliments all night long. This is my second rental from RTR and both dresses have exceeded my expectations. I will keep coming back!

This dress was beautiful and very fun.  The color is much more neon than it looks in the picture - that being said, I still really liked the color. Just be prepared to be bright! Also, this run super big. Like really big. I am normally a 4, so I ordered a 4 and a 2. I wore the 2, but it was still a bit big - I wish I would have order a 2 and a 0.

perfect dress to dance in. incredibly comfy, definitely size down a size or two...dress came in great condition. would rent again. the material was perfect to keep the fit and flare shape, wore on a 90 degree day to a wedding and it was perfect.
Loved this vest to dress up a casual outfit and stay warm in a cold office. Will rent again.  I wore this open over a button down shirt. Tiny bit snug under the arms but not uncomfortable.

Chic rehearsal dinner dress Rented this for my rehearsal dinner (like many RTR-ers) and received a ton of compliments! I did end up wearing the smaller size; it's form-fitting but not at all uncomfortable. Highly recommend you wear spanx with it, as that was the only thing I tried that I couldn't see through the dress.

Indoor/outdoor party Cute dress! Fit was flattering. Was very long, had to wear super-high heels. Nice thick fabric, was indoors & outdoors on a cool night (wore a jacket part of the time) & stayed comfortable.

Comfortable and gorgeous! I loved this dress. I have a very small ribcage and a hourglass figure, and it fit perfectly. I got so many compliments. It was worn to a dinner banquet for work. Very comfortable - soft and fully lined. The sleeves made a unique statement. Wish I could own it - I'd wear it all the time.
Nice, but nothing special. Somewhat short in the arms, and there's a zipper up the back that rubs a bit.

Unlimited Selection This was an unlimited selection- I have had unlimited for 2 months and I am finding it may not be s good option for someone like me who doesn't go out much. This dress is great/ I gave it 4 stars because the sheer strips make it difficult to wear to work. The dress is short but it was not too short for me

Cute! Narrow in the shoulders. This was a great-looking jacket! Fun to wear something that is not in my normal wheelhouse. It did run a touch small in the shoulders--I typically wear a small in jackets, sometimes a medium. This one, I got the medium and it was still snug in the shoulders. Hard to wear much underneath it, which is no good when the weather is cold.
Perfect dress for Las Vegas!  I wore this dress for a bachelorette party in Las Vegas, and it was a hit!  It fit really well, and I received lots of compliments from strangers the whole evening.

Everyone loved the dress! I got so many compliments and asked where I got the dress from!  This was an amazing dress! I had to wear the 8L due to the waistband not stretching really. Otherwise I loved that dresss!

Beautiful! I loved this dress.  I didn't end up wearing it because I had another dress that I thought was more appropriate for my event but I would rent this for another event.  I am 5'4" and you can see that even with heels it almost hit the ground so probably not for anyone too much shorter than me.  I tried it on without a bra but probably best with no bra or nu bra.

I felt gorgeous and got so many compliments! This is a very well made dress. It retained its shape through 8 hours of dancing and dining. I wore 3" heels and the length was perfect. It was a little large in the bust for me, and I only wore a nu-bra due to the low back. The material is substantial enough that it held its shape there, but I could have filled it out more (Im not large chested). I would definitely rent again!

Wore to a wedding. At first, I wasn't sure about the ruffle but ended up loving it. Very elegant and I loved the fabric - doesn't show wrinkles.  In dresses I'm usually a 2, but as this was more fitted through the hips, I liked the fit of the 4 better.  Would rent again.
Felt like I was in a hippy paradise Seriously LOVED this dress. So loose & yet stylish - got SO many compliments.

Comfy, Warm, and Sexy Dress! I rented this for NYE and it was PERFECT! It was a very cold night, and I didn't even need coat! We weren't outside long, but the dress kept me perfectly warm for walking between doors and cars. It was also so comfortable and didn't ever ride up even with dancing. I got compliments all night and would rent again.
N/A Cute, but big sleeves and tight in the bust.

Liked the color, sleeves, and cut out a lot; did not like the slit or fit of the bottom.  PROS: The top half was great- I really liked the shape of the sleeves and the cut out. 

CONS: I found myself playing with the dress all night as the back zipper would not stay centered. Every time I got it to go straight the slit would bunch up. I could tell that the lining didn't lay flush to the dress. Not sure if this was to do with the dress or the size.

Great color and beautiful dress So, as a 5'5", 131 lb girl with a bit of a butt, this dress was not the greatest fit for me. I tried on the 4 as it was the size I anticipated wearing and it fit the top half of me great, but was super tight in the butt area. Enough so that I felt it necessary to opt for the 6. The 6 fit my bottom half better, but made the top bustle up a bit and cause the dress to not sit flat on my top. All in all a beautiful dress and got a lot of compliments, but definitely not great for a smaller girl with a bit of a butt!

The fit was perfect and I got so many compliments! This dress is possibly my favorite I've ever worn. Like everyone says, the fabric is VERY forgiving and with a pair of Spanx, all of my problem areas were hidden. The dress maintains its shape and the color is gorgeous. I got SO many compliments! My dress was definitely the best one there (besides the bride's of course!). 

The only con to this dress is that it came with a VERY pungent chemical smell that never quite went away even after letting it hang and "air out" for 24 hours. You couldn't smell it once I put on deodorant and perfume, but it was definitely noticeable if you were looking for it!

However, I would absolutely rent again!

Great dress- on trend with the cutout I am typically a 0 but needed the 2 in this one - I have a flat stomach but if its too tight your fat will come through the cut out in the front (not cute). The 2 fit perfectly and I was able to wear a normal bra. The slit was no where near too high. Material was nice and thick! Loved it!

I loved the dress! I got so many compliments on it!  Gorgeous dress! It was a little tight around my rib cage and my chest but I got into the dress with some help from my husband! The zipper was just a little stuck but other than that it was prefect!

Not the shape for me... This dress was just not the right shape for me at all. It made me seem wider in the shoulders and hips than I am. I'm usually a 2 but this was snug around the shoulders. Pretty material but the shape was just not for me!

Beautiful! This dress was so fun and wonderful.  The cut outs add appeal without being too revealing.
I was able to wear a regular bra though a a bra with wide straps or a wide bra band would show.  I wore a size 6 and the top was slightly too big. I received many compliments.

Pretty Dress This dress is lovely however there was way too much room on top for a nice fit.  Id usually be a 6, wore a 4 and was constantly adjusting my straps.  I wore it because it was the only dress I had, otherwise I wouldn't have worn it. The waist was a TTS.
Great cut, flattering at smallest part of waist!  Wore this for a work conference, received many compliments!

so flattering! fit just as expected based on other's reviews.  fit perfectly. i was expecting it to be short, but being 5' 3" it was great. could definitely be dressed up or down depending on where you are going. the fabric is not very breathable but it is soft and comfy. would definitely wear this again

Classy, but not too conservative. I wore this to a business dinner with my husband and his clients (husband and wife).  It was a Friday night in Miami so I didn't want to look too conservative, but still keep it classy.  This dress was perfect!  It even has pockets.  I have a large bust (36D) so shift dresses aren't always flattering on me.  I wore the 6 and it fit perfectly.  It even has pockets.  Thanks RTR for another great look!

Beautiful backless dress! I wore this dress to black tie optional gala in Washington, DC. It was perfect for the event! I got tons of compliments all night on my dress. I loved that it was a little short and backless because it wasn't my event so I could have fun with it. I sized up one size because I'm curvy with a large bust. Will totally rent this dress again!

Amazing color and love the lace! This dress was more beautiful in person! However, I wasn't a huge fan of how I looked in it. I am pretty pale, so the color (even though it was bright and colorful) washed me out a little. Despite how I felt, I got a lot of compliments and this dress was perfect for a day wedding.

Best Dressed Wore this for a summer wedding and was probably the best dressed. Definitely recommend for tall, slender girls with a little bit of curve. Perfectly accented my hips. The neckline was a little uncomfortable and the slit came stitched together. Like the back of a pencil skirt or blazer, you need to let the slit out. That made a huge difference.

Perfect romper for bachelorette party This was my first Rent the Runway experience and it was great! I wore this romper to a bachelorette party and it was perfect for the occasion. I wanted a relaxed fit so I went with the medium and it fit perfectly. Because I am on the bustier side, I was apprehensive about the romper being backless but I wore a backless, strapless bra with adhesive sides and it worked perfectly. The only problem I had with the romper was that the elastic hook at the neck was so stretched out that it had to be looped around the button twice. This required me to have some assistance when it came time to use the restroom but for one night, it was fine to deal with. Overall, I'm super happy with my experience, got lots of compliments on my outfit, and would definitely rent it again!
way too small in the arms!  Way too small in the arms!

Great for a formal event!  The color of the dress was great and it was perfect for the formal event I attended.  I am 5'6" and ordered both a 4R and 6R.  I was in between a 4 and 6 but was able to get in the 4 on for the event. The only negative was that the dress was a bit long even with heels.  If I were to rent again I would get a S.

Wore this dress for a night out in Vegas and it was perfect! The dress does run large in the waist as others have said.  I grabbed a skinny belt before we left and used that to cinch the waistline so it was a bit more flattering.  You couldn't even see the belt because the top blouses over, so it worked perfectly.  It's a very pretty dress and I felt sparkly!

Fabulous Dress for An Indoor Garden Party in Ireland!!  Beautiful form fitting emerald green dress that I wish I'd ordered in an 8!  The 6 was super snug and hugged every curve but I still wore it! I felt beautiful & confident at the VIP party after the concert. Thanks RTR!!
Super cute! Super short! At 5'10" it's really only suitable as a bathing suit cover up---but very cute!
Beautiful dress, very elegant and easy to dress up.  Fits great. However, wish I ordered the long instead of regular. I'm 5'9" so with heels it was a little shorter than I wanted.

Perfect Vegas dress! Fit like a glove. Color was gorgeous. Really sucks you in, but still comfortable to wear all night. I wore a stick on push up bra (but just didn't buckle the center clasp, so it wasn't visible) but you could totally go without a bra too. The material is thick and really nice quality. I think it's hard to go wrong with Herve Leger.

A really fun outfit to wear for a fun occasion! I wore this for a Bachelorette party and it was perfect! I ordered the 4 and 6 and could have gone with the 4 but the length of the body was a little too short for my build (I'm 5'9" and needed a little more length through the torso). I'm smaller chested and would have liked the top to be a bit tighter but overall loved this outfit and got many compliments on it.

Beautiful color! Great dress and such a beautiful color for a summer wedding. I wore the 4, and despite the fact that i usually have to wear a bra with everything, I didn't have to with this dress because there is boning in the bodice.

classy and comfortable! i ordered this dress for a night out in AC with my friends. i ordered the small and medium, and medium was more comfortable. however this was a bit more formal looking than I had hoped for a night out in AC so my friend actually wound up wearing it and also loved it! It's great, definitley cannot wear a regular bra and the material is thicker than i thought- which i was happy about. the back gives it some edge and i loved the lace! overall it was a great dress, super comfortable and i would definitley rent again for a different occassion!

Gorgeous! Accentuated all the right places, got TONS of compliments all night. Beautiful fit across the bust, shoulders, arms. Could have worn the 8, but felt more comfortable in the 10. Hugged the right places and with some spanx, the mid-section looked great! Got to even wear a bra for some added lift:) It was long without heels, but I wore 4-inch heels and loved that it still hit the floors. Gorgeous dress!

Beautiful material and fit...perfect! This dress is gorgeous! It certainly hugs every single curve, but the material is excellent quality. It runs a little small, but I am usually a 6, and the 6 fit like a glove (literally). I had to wear spanx, but they fit nicely under the dress. The length is very elegant, too, and looks great with a tall pair of heels.

Wore this jumpsuit as my second party outfit of my 40th bday celebration. It was showstopper. I am 5' 4", it did not fit me cropped. I usually wear a 6-8. I have an hourglass figure.  The 10 fit me like a dream.

Great color! This dress was not my favorite.  If you have a larger chest, it will definitely on full display.   I didn't feel comfortable at all, and wore my scarf most of the night to feel more covered.

so many compliments! the neckline and waistline are very flattering... a knock-out. i'm not usually comfortable being in a dress all night long, but this was a knock-out.  everyone complimented me on it and it's a very flattering dress.   i go between a 10 and 12, but found the 10L fit much better on top.  the bottom of the dress had some sequences missing, but nobody noticed it besides me... wouldn't change a thing about this beautiful dress!
Work skirt Runs a bit large - if you want it to sit properly on your waist & be able to tuck a shirt in, size down!

This dress was absolutely amazing. I didn't want to take off at the end of the night! I have large hips and bra size, and this dress accommodated that very well.  The waist was a bit loose, so I probably could have gone a size down.  It still looked amazing though! I am 5'7" and chose the long length, but I think regular would have been fine too.

Gorgeous dress but a little short! A little short for someone 5'9 wearing heels. Would have preferred to have some extra length. Typically wear a 14 but it was a bit tight in the hips so I wore the 16.

Work was entirely forgettable, but wow this vest was not. Looks hip, not hippy. Great style. It is a winter-ish look, so I'd be careful about wearing this in warmer climes - but it is a knock-out piece, a fantastic addition (thank you again, Unlimited) to an adventurous wardrobe.

Didn't wear, but it's a nice dress! Another dress that I didn't wear.  I am a regular size 14 and this dress swallowed me.  It was also very short waisted, which is a common problem for me.  It's a lovely fabric, though, and would look great on someone whom it fits well.

Stylist Review  A unique cut and design to this dress! This colorful dress runs true to size. I would go one size up for the backup as there is no stretch to this fabric. There is comfortable room at the bust so this dress is great for any cup size. A strapless bra needs to be worn because of the cut on this dress. It is fitted at the natural waist but there is a decent amount of room in the hips. Due to the high neck, I would not wear a necklace with this dress. Instead, I would pair it with a nice pair of diamond earrings and a bracelet to match.
I loved how comfortable this dress was and how great it looked in pictures! The dress was so awesome! I was so comfortable in it.

Great dress! Runs small Love the color and the cut. Usually wear a 0/2 but have a rear so the 4 was still pretty snug around the hips. The neckline was awesome and I went for a bracelet instead of a necklace for jewelry.

Out-of-control Stunning Dress! This dress made me feel like a queen. I've never gotten so many compliments on any ensemble, ever. I was at a large Philadelphia wedding as a guest where I knew a small percentage of the guests. Strangers would stop me to tell me how beautiful my dress was...or how beautiful *I* looked. It was amazing. 
Some thoughts on fit: 1) I am big busted and this was snug on me in the bust area. Cleavage was definitely in abundance but not distasteful. 2) The bustier was PERFECT. As a large chested woman, I was very, very nervous about support. It was perfect. 3) I had to do some pulling up from time to time, but the dress mostly stayed in place. I wore 3.5" heels and the dress was the perfect length. (Ordered 12L)
I found about 4 or 5 other Rent The Runway customers throughout the evening. We all admired each other's dresses and raved to others who weren't in the know. Overall amazing, amazing dress and, as usual, an amazing experience.
This dress was absolutely PERFECT! I got sooo many compliments throughout the night!  Fit is true to size but if you're larger chested I would order up

Loved love loved it! I got a lot of compliments, this dress was a beautiful fit, I have a small waist and my hips are wide in comparison, this sat perfectly and flattered. I felt very comfortable in the dress, not too hot. The only thing I had not considered was the bra situation, I ended up getting a last minute stick on bra, I wish I had planned that better.
Comfortable and perfect for work! Great material, but size up if you are busty.  I am normally a 6 but this 6 fit snugged in the chest area.  Otherwise, a great fit.

Way too big With pinning I'm sure this dress would look amazing but as far as actual fit goes the top was enormous! I can't imagine how anyone would actually fit into it. Definitely a big disappointment and I would not recommend renting it.
Super easy process. Can't wait to rent again!!  Perfect for a formal party! Runs a little small. So glad I got an extra size!
Cute and comfy! I wanna keep it! Fit was a little big but it does not look frumpy. I wore with black tights and booties. Tons of compliments. The sleeves are long but I loved them.
Perfect! This dress was AMAZING! I want to rent it again. I got so many compliments and felt like a  million bucks. It's so classy and elegant.

The color was perfect for a February wedding!  This was my first RTR dress and I loved it! I wore this to a wedding and received many compliments! I'm short so it was a little long but other than that, it was classy & comfortable.

Wore this for a formal event, loved it.  I'm 5'2, 115, and a 34C, I got the 0R and it was a little long on me I wore some heels so it wasnt that bad just had to lift it up as I walked down stairs. It was a little bit big around my chest but nothing a strapless bra couldnt fit. Overall great dress. Photographed well and got a lot of compliments. Reccomend to anyone!

I wore this both to work and out to dinner This is an amazing blouse.  It's sleek and different without looking outlandish. I was worried that the sleeves might be floppy/get in the way but that was not the case at all.   I got so many compliments when wearing with skinny jeans. The 44 fit well but I potentially could have sized down.
it was for a luuncheon. the sleeves are tight and it is hard to move in but got compliments on the color

Cute, comfortable, flattering and sexy! This dress was a great choice for the occasion. It could be dressed up more with jewelry, but I wanted a simpler look. Paired it with black pumps for a great night out!
Beautiful dress; received lots of compliments I had to safety pin the top - it was VERY low cut.

I wore this dress to the the 30th Annual Ranger Ball. It was perfect.  I was so nervous that this would be too long or not fit correctly. I'm 5'3 and with 4 inch heels, it was the PERFECT length. Very true to size and I received many compliments on it. The blue gives you that POP that everyone can't help but see. :)
Tried this dress on in the store and was immediately sold.  Unique, comfortable and flattering. Definitely recommend.

Love it! Love this dress! Fit true to size. I wore this to a formal wedding (I’m too short for a long dress!) Fabric was a beautiful elegant blue and was thick enough that I didn’t need spanks. Received so many complements would definitely recommend!! :)

Not great for work, looked terrible when moving. I've been looking for a sweater-type skirt for work to counter the typical issues I have with a pencil skirt (riding up, twisting around, etc.). This wasn't a good pick. It had more of a going-out fit (skin tight from hips to where the ruffle starts), which knocked it off my wear-to-work list. But it didn't even make the date night list because it looked totally comical when I walked. The pleats are connected at the bottom so it just bulges awkwardly. Go for it if that's your look, but I wouldn't recommend.

The color is awesome in person! I wore this to my sorority semiformal and I got so many compliments Fits true to size! I have a really small bust and typically have to wear XS in everything - the 0 fit perfectly! There was a little room in the bust, but like I said, I'm super small on top. It still stayed up well.
tight and sexy i didn't wear bc i liked something else better.  very stretchy.  Got the xs and it was a good fit.

Fabulous dress; got many compliments The fit was good even though I've gained a few pounds since I rented a dress.  Because of the slight stretch, it was very comfortable.  The length was perfect for my 2 inch heels.

Beautiful print & difficult fit  I'm usually a pretty regular size 4. This dress was beautiful but difficult to wear - too low / loose at the top. I'm ok with very low cut fitted tops but the fact that this was also loose was a little difficult.
really beautiful dress! very low cut but nothing a safety pin couldnt fix  runs a bit small but over all great fit

Lots of compliments! I wore this dress to a friend's wedding (Sept. 6). The dress ended up working out fine but the material was really heavy and the zipper was tough to get up/down. I am usually a size 10 and did not have a back up size available so I rented it and hoped it would fit. Although I ended up wearing the dress it was pretty tight under the bust, and I probably would have worn the 12 if I had been able to order it - definitely go up a size no matter what here.

Great length though and the pockets were wonderful.

Beautiful dress, but a bit too heavy to dance in Great dress for an event where one mostly stands and/or sits; it's a little too heavy and scratchy to really dance comfortably in. I didn't actually where this dress out, but I tried it on and realized that it wouldn't be right for my senior prom.
The other reviewers are right about the cleavage, it is pretty showy, but it's nothing fashion tape can't fix. :)
The length was great for me, I'm 5'8" and could wear 4 inchers with it nicely. 
Pro tip: size down!

Perfect Fit! This is a blazer that fit absolutely perfectly. Too often blazers are a little tight or loose in the shoulders and arms, but this one is a great cut. As other reviewers have said, it's a thick material, so works well for this time of year, or in an office with heavy air conditioning.
Didn't end up wearing this one Ran really big. Like loose everywhere. I wish I had sized down. The fabric has no stretch so I was worried about it being too small but this was definitely too big.

Ill-fitting. I rented this dress for a wedding but ended up wearing something I already owned. The size is strange: true to size at the shoulders and hips, but loose around the waist. It's pretty forgiving, I suppose, but people who wear a size 0 usually don't need the extra fabric around the waist.

Perfect summer wedding dress! I normally am a size 4 or 6 in dresses because of my wide ribs, but I fit into the backup size of small for this dress, which fit well. My only complaints are that the dress is pretty see through and thin and that the hook on the lower back of the dress can be uncomfortable and dig into your back. Overall, super bright and fun dress. I got a lot of compliments.

Sweater arrived in great condition but was too scratchy! This is a lovely design and flowy fit, but the sweater is not naturally soft (it is made of synthetic fibers that feel odd to my fingertips).  If this doesn't bother you, it would be a great pick!

Fantastic dress, cannot recommend it enough I wore this dress to my best friend's wedding, and even the bride couldn't get over how great this dress was!  I usually wear a size 6, but I wore a size 8 and it fit perfectly.  I was able to dance the night away without any problems.  I got a MILLION compliments- from the bride, the bridal party, the wedding guests, even people who were not at the event were texting me including my boss!!!  It fit my curves perfectly and I felt like a total babe.  Do yourself a favor- if you want to feel like a total sexpot, rent this dress.  You will not regret it.
Love the pockets! Fit was perfect, loved the pockets, it was one of the most comfortable dresses I ever wore

I wore this for my baby shower at 30 weeks pregnant.  The dress was form fitting, showed the bump, but also left me with room to breath.  Perfect for a fall baby shower.  I went one size up (would usually wear a 6 or medium) due to third trimester bump.

New Year's Eve! Ran a bit tight. Usually dresses are loose on me in the chest. That being said, maybe this was more true to size than most dresses? I usually wear a size 4 in similarly styled dresses (Calvin Klein, Ann Taylor, LOFT, Banana Republic), but this I had to go up to the 6 and that even left little room for error.  Beautiful though, got a lot of compliments!

TEAM RTR REVIEW This skirt is amazing - I would totally rent this again. I wore this paired back to a simple black tee and boots. This is way more stretchy than expected and would work for many body types. I typically have issues in the hip area but this skirt fit very true to size and was comfortable with a shirt tucked in. Highly recommend!
I loved how helpful they were and the dress is gorgeous!!!  I wore the smaller size (yay!) so I recommend going a size smaller when you order. It looks amazing on and it is so fun!

So cute I got this dress brand new which was awesome.  It also comes as two pieces, a slip and the top part which you can see.  The dress is so fun and comfortable but also stylish.  I'm short so it hits me right about the knee but still looks adorable.  Looked like it could be kind of shapeless but it is actually really flattering. I got it in April but you could def wear the top part by itself as cute beach cover.

Such a perfect everyday dress! I loved this! The color was so cute, and the length was actually perfect. I don't typically wear over the knee dresses, but I think since I'm on the shorter side (5'3), it didn't feel too short! The sleeves were a bit long, but nothing to fuss about! I love that they flared out, so cute! I wore with black over the knee boots since it was a little colder out and that worked perfectly!

Gorgeous Summer Design I'm typically a size 6 but only the 4 was available. The dress didn't have any give to it and had a very structured sheath fit. I would need a size 8, and will definitely try to rent the right size next time!
bold design  Love the color along with the bold design. The structure of the sleeves is very high fashion

Perfect shirt and fit for a date, day at the office or just out when you want to look cute!  Shirt was a great material that accommodated a large chest very well!  I am sitting down in this picture with the sleeves slightly raised, but other than that, it’s a good representation!

Accentuates EVERY Curve! This statement could be a huge positive or a huge issue, depending on your figure! For me, I feel it was the latter, so unfortunately it was not my favorite dress. I was very attracted to the color (obviously) and the beautiful design, but I had a premonition it wouldn't be the perfect cut for my shape. This dress is extremely fitting and over-accentuates any curves you have! I received many compliments all around, but it was a bit too snug for my taste. I'm not even sure a size up would have made a difference either. I feel like it looked a ton better on the other gals that reviewed this dress, but it is a beauty for sure.

Great summer weekend dress! I rented this dress for a weekend of relaxing and shopping. It was the perfect sun dress on a hot day, and super comfortable to wear. It ran a bit long (and I am tall), but if you wore heels it would be fine (I wore it with flats).

So comfortable and classic Fit my long waisted and broad shouldered body beautifully. I rented this as an extra as we had several events this weekend. So comfortable and understated. Fit is close but not tight. Very flattering. Would rent again.

Rented this dress for a wedding in Savannah, GA. It was absolutely perfect!  I rented the S and XS but ended up wearing the XS. The dress fit perfectly and I was comfortable and confident in it all night! I was hesitant to do rent the runway just because it was something I always considered but never did. It was totally worth it! I will be back to rent soon!

Not my favorite dress, but I sure received a lot of compliments! I wore this dress to my rehearsal dinner. There was something about this dress that I just didn't like. I think it was the way the top portion fit; the sleeves were a little funky and the top puckered around the chest. I just didn't find it to be all that flattering. That said, I still received a lot of compliments on it and it definitely had a chic element to it. The bottom part of the dress fit well and was fun to twirl in. If I had tried this dress on in the store, I would not have purchased it. I ordered the size 12 with a size 14 for backup and ended up wearing the 14. The dress has no stretch to it and the 12 was just a tad too tight around the middle. The 14 was a little big though, so I was kind of somewhere in the middle. It should be noted that the dress really is more of a cream/light tan than white. It does appear fairly white in photographs, though!

Sexy and classy. Loved this dress. The fit is very tight and I would have been more comfortable in one size larger, which was unavailable. But the material is thick with a snug stretch making it very slimming so you are not self conscious. There is not much room in the bust and I had to wear a bandeau style strapless bra that minimized rather than anything with padding or lift. The overall effect for me though felt expensive and the form fitting silhouette, as well as the interesting sleeve made it sexy and modern. Length is below the knee, so you will want a high heel. I wore a barely there strappy nude 4 inch heel, but you could also get very creative with your shoes in a dress like this. Loved it!

NYE gala Love this dress, it was stretchy and no annoying zippers to deal with.  Fit very comfortably, but looked elegant.  The sheer panels are not very sheer at all.  Was perfect for black tie affair.  It is a little long.

Way too short 99.999% of the time I take size XS, which is the size I ordered in this romper. I generally consider myself to have a small backside, but the shorts on this romper fit like hot shorts, making it unwearable in public. I did order size S for back up but it ended up being unavailable, so I can't comment on whether this size would have been more appropriate.

Light as a feather I am always skeptical about wearing white for the fear of it being see through but this dress had no flaw.
It was simple but the floral print made the dress stand out.
It was also very comfortable! It ran slightly larger on me but it wasn't very noticeable.
I would definitely rent again!

Perfect for a fall wedding in north Georgia Beautiful dress, absolutely perfect for a fall wedding in north Georgia. I've recently lost some weight and am normally a 6 (occasionally a 4 or an 8) - so I went with 6 and 8 backup to be safe. The 6 was still pretty loose, so either I've lost a bit more than I realized or the dress runs a smidge big. Anyway, it didn't really matter because the size was close enough and no one could tell but me (plus I'm kinda busty so I wonder if the 4 would have been too snug up top). Overall, though: very comfortable, cute, and easy to dance in, and I got lots of compliments. I would wear again, would just order a 4 and a 6 instead.

not for large busted ladies I am so bummed about this dress.  This is the second dress that hasn't fit due to my chest size.  I am a 32d or sometimes 34c, so not huge, but I have a slim waist.  So dresses that might fit me in the waist don't always fit me in the chest.  This dress is beautiful and I wish it worked! I might try a larger size but there might be better options out there for me.

Perfect dress for our Las Vegas Elopement . Short and fitted but not sheer. Easy to find bra and slip to wear under. My hair would get stuck in sequins a bit and runs a bit snug in arms, but very happy with fit and comfort.

Gorgeous material, Bulky fit The lace was beautiful, but the cut of the dress made the no-stretch lace unflattering in fit.  I looked like I had no waist from angle.  For body proportions that match the dress it would be lovely, but on me it created a blocky appearance. I was much happier with my first choice dress and wore that instead.
I didn't end up wearing it. Too small. Snug snug snug.
Blouse is very cute, flowey, and comfortable. Loved the fit and feel of this blouse. I wore it for Thanksgiving and it was perfect, looks classy while giving you lots of room to eat turkey!
Good everyday dress. Heavy-weight printed cotton is high quality. On trend, oversized sleeve. Size up for larger breasts.

Very pretty, not for someone with big bust size I really liked this shirt and was looking forward to wearing it. It didn't have a great fit for me. I would definitely need to wear a bra and it wasn't comfortable so I ended up returning it right away.

Rent this sweater if you like to wear blankets (like I do)  This sweater definitely runs extremely large - I normally wear a medium and ordered an XS based on other reviews. The sweater is thick and very warm - I wore it as a coat in this unusually balmy NYC late fall weather. I'm 5'2" and it went down past my knees. One thing I wish the photos showed were the sleeve/armpit area. The sweater was built so that it is extra wide and underarm seam goes all the way to your elbows - meaning that if you hold up your arms parallel with the ground you would likely take flight :) That being said I wanted to do everything in this sweater and never wanted to take it off.
So Cute!! Very comfortable - stayed up all night without pulling it up.  I wore it gambling in Atlantic City.  I got a lot of compliments.  It was classy and cute.  Fun with big dangling earrings.
Beautiful lace.  Fit like a glove. Perfect for wedding rehearsal!

Fantastic! I loved the dress!  The dress was very flatering and fit perfectly.  I wish I could have bought the dress.  I received the dress on time and the customer service was fantastic.  I would rent from RTR again.
Cute but not quite my style, a little stuffy librarian look Ran a little small through the bust

Got lots of compliments! Warm, runs large Love the pattern and design, got lots of compliments even from strangers. Runs very large, I usually wear S but XS is still large for me. It is a warm piece, good back layer to it.
Cute! There are hidden snap buttons that holds the dress in place so it felt a bit tight. But the dress was overall comfortable to wear.
Glad I sized up I sized up to a large based on other reviews and was able to wear it. Still snugger than I usually like my knit wear and definitely see through. Not bad, but not great.

Comfy, cool and SHORT This dress was just like it appears in the picture.  I wore it for a holiday party and the colors were festive and fun.  It was extremely comfortable.  Fair warning, this dress is super short!  I'm on the taller side at 5'6", but I couldn't raise my hands without a little cheek showing!  I wore black tights with it, but do not think I could have worn this without them.

So classy! Beautiful vintage look.  (Reviewing for my friend, her measurements above) This dress is breathtaking. The lace detail is dramatic without being Gothic looking, and the dress is sexy while still being covered up. Boning in the midsection and stretch throughout makes for a perfect fit.

Beautiful color This dress is great for a work event - I wore it to a conference in San Diego and I liked it because the fabric is fit (forgiving!) but the style is fitted so it still makes it kind of sexy.  I wore it with a blazer during the day and then took that off for evening.  Got complimented that it brought out the color of my eyes.  The one star deduction is because the bottom hem was out -- and that's how I received it.  RTR should have noticed that before they sent it out.  It was too late (I got it two days before my conference) so I didn't have time to contact RTR or have something else shipped.  I used fashion tape to hold it up but it still looked a little "bubbly" [like not flat] so that was the only bummer.

A fun dress that will mix up your everyday! Overall the dress fit, but it was a little tight. I am not busty, and I think the top would be tight on someone who had a bigger chest. The dress is fitted through the waist, hips, and butt, then changes to a fun tulle-like fabric at the bottom that is not overly heavy and adds movement to the dress. The butterfly print is really fun and stands out. Would recommend!

Looked great overall, though the shoulders were a little big on me. This dress was beautiful and very flattering. The only drawback was that the shoulder were a tiny bit big. Used fashion tape to make sure they stayed in place, but probably could have sized down a bit or gotten in an order for the petite but it was a last minute rental so took what was available. That said, the length on the regular with a pair of 3 1/2 inch heels was just fine. Got lots of compliments and felt very glamorous. Plus, being a little busty, it's great to find a dress you can actually wear a bra with.

I used this dress for a photoshoot, and I loved it so much that I bought it! It runs big. I am usually a size 4/6, and I wore a size 2. Warning: it looks boxy and kind of blah on the hanger, but it is gorgeous once you put it on!
so comfortable!  and got lots of compliments. loved the pockets and neckline

Beautiful color and flattering fit! This dress was perfect for a New Year's Eve wedding! The color is vibrant and the fit is very flattering. I liked that the fabric is somewhat thick and has a little stretch because the dress looked smooth and held me in. The off-the-shoulder neckline was beautiful and not too low, but I could still move and put my arms up (not all the way, but way more than most off-the-shoulder dresses). Highly recommend!

Formal Dinner- Needed less than a cocktail dress, more than a date night.  This was perfect! This dress was perfect for a Wednesday night casual dinner at a very formal restaurant in Pittsburgh. It was beautiful and I love the mesh inlays.  The back is also striking - so make sure to wear your hair up!
Now to the sizing: I usually wear a 0-2 in dresses (depending on how tight the bottom is). I have a very small upper body (usually XXS in tops) but volleyball player thighs.  Based on the reviews of this dress, and other Bibhu dresses, I decided to play it safe and order a size 2, and as a backup a size 4.  That was a mistake, this dress fits VERY true to size, so the 2 was even a bit large on me, and I would have better fit into the 0.  This is perfect for flat girls, but i do think it could work for busty girls.  I would advise ordering your usual size for higher end designers, but if you are busty, know that you may need to wear a camisole underneath.

Loved the dress! However, I can only give 3 stars due to fit.  This dress is beautiful! I usually wear a 2 but even the 4 around the hips was tight and uncomfortable.  I wore this on a winery tour to the Hampton's and received a lot of compliments!

Classic, yet sexy. Gorgeous color- perfect for a wedding Fits true to size. Lovely back but won't allow you to wear a regular bra. Received lots of compliments!  Comfortable and classy. A can't-go-wrong dress!

No event  Love this jumpsuit -- fabric is high quality and styling its awesome.   It runs small around the bust area and couldn't quite get it zippered; I am a large b to small c cup so keep that in mind when you rent.  I did unlimited, so didn't get a back up size, but would rent it again if I had the specific event in mind.

I wore this dress for a friends jewelry boutique opening in London.  I looked extra gorgeous! I ordered a size 10 with size 12 backup. They did not have the 10 available so sent the 12 and a replacement dress which did not suit my body. Luckily the 12 looked amazing! I'm broad hipped and broad shouldered with a big round butt and 36C bust, I do not have slender arms- this dress complimented me extremely well. The peekaboo opening was in a great area- the dress is form fitting and the length could potentially make it a conservative dress, but the window of flesh and my height with heels made the length very sexy. Everyone raved over the dress. The pattern is unique! I paired the dress with a rent the runway glitter clutch and gold three ringed necklace. I want to own this dress in all available colors!

Pretty, comfortable dress in a stunning blue. I liked this dress, but didn't love it. I wore it to a spring bridal shower, and i think it may have been a little dark and heavy for the occasion. Pros: I have a bit of a tummy, and the dress hid it well. I loved the pockets, and the color was beautiful. The lace detail was nice as well. I liked the length (just above the knees on me at 5'6"). The whole dress was very comfortable. Cons: The lining of the dress made it heavy. It reminded me of something my grandmother would wear (not the style, but the kind of fabric). I think also the sleeve length was not great for me, and I felt the dress may have made my shoulders look boxy (I'm fairly narrow on top). On the other hand, it could just be I'm not used to this kind of style. 

Some reviewers said the arms felt tight. I didn't find that to be the case.

Great dress - but size down.  I normally am a 4 or 6 depending on the dress, but there were no reviews or pictures on this dress when I ordered it and no sizing notes, so I just went with the 6 (38).  I really liked this dress but might have sent it back without wearing it if I didn't have this belt in my closet because it was literally just a bag on me.  I should have gone down at least to a size 36/4.  But I got a lot of compliments on it with the belt so if it ends up being too big maybe try that to save it!

Amazing This dress was beautiful and simple.  It did run small but the material hid all the flaws.  I didn't need to wear a bra.  Was able to dance all night and sit.  I did need to pull the dress down a few times because it bunched in the tummy area.

adorable sun dress for all occasions! This dress was perfect for a hot day, work, or even a casual wedding. I loved the cut, short enough to show a little leg but not too much! Also, the top was modest and I was able to wear it to work without a sweater!
Great Fit, very flattering  The sleeves run a little tighter than I expected but it fit very nicely. I would consider buying this dress.

Stylist Review  In complete LOVE with this dress.  It does run a little small, but I actually like the way it fit me.  The fabric has no stretch and the dress is definitely fitting in the hips and midsection, so I would size up for a back up size.  The dress seems to be kind of straight and narrow, so if you have an hourglass shape, keep this in mind and again, size up to be safe. A standard bra works just fine with this dress.  The ruffle totally makes this dress fun and you will receive nonstop compliments for sure.

Like Royalty! I am 5'4", 122lbs, 32C, with an athletic build.  I typically wear a size 2, but followed the advice of other reviewers and sized up.  The top of the 4 fit very well (with the help of those silicon sticky bras!), but the waist band was tight and got uncomfortable when sitting.  The length of the dress fell to about mid-shin.  For the wedding, which took place in a formal church, i covered the back and shoulders with a blazer.  I thought for sure i would want to wear the 6 for the rest of the night after sitting uncomfortably in church, but the top of the 6 gaped in the back and armpits and generally had a baggy fit, so i stayed with the 4.     All that being said, I felt gorgeous in this dress! It is easily one of the most beautiful dresses i have ever worn.   I received so many compliments (even with the blazer), and was continuously asked if i felt like a princess.   Absolutely I did!  The dress was great for dancing and the fun, full skirt meant that I didn't have to feel conscientious about the extra pieces of wedding cake i ate!

Modest but Flattering!  I wore this to a work conference evening event. The attire was resort cocktail. I wasn't really sure where to go with that but once again RTR saved the day! I loved this dress. It was modest enough to wear for a work event but it didn't make me feel frumpy. I like the tie at the waist that helps to accentuate your waist more to make it more feminine. The extra small was just a tad too tight on me. I almost wore it anyways but since it was a work event I went for the small that was a little lose.
See below please It was way to big for me. I wasn't even able to wear this. It was at my knee caps, and baggy in the waste. I couldn't keep the top to stay up right if I wanted too.

The dress was true to other reviews - ran a bit large but great fit.  RTR made it so easy. I loved how I felt in this dress.  People I didn't even know stopped me throughout the night and said "your dress is stunning!"  As other reviewers said, it fit a little large.  the 14L was big through the arm holes and I liked how the 12L fit better there.  Enough give in the skirt to accomodate.  I'm glad I got an L, R would have been short and I didn't wear very high heels.  Can't go wrong with this one!

Cocktail party wedding in Brooklyn  This was my "just in case" style, I ended up being really happy with it! A tiny bit loose in the bust area for me (I wear 32C) but not noticeable. Good weight for a fall wedding ans lovely draping. It was more high-low than I expected based on the photos, got lots of compliments!
Lovely red color! I normally wear a size 4 or 6 and I wore the size 6. Had to pin the top, but other than that, it worked out perfect. I received many compliments all night!

Stand out at any Party! Wore this to my husband's Christmas party. When my husband first saw me, his very first words were "damn!" LOL ... Is a show stopper! The slit is high but not inappropriate. Dress is stretchy and comfortable. Perfect for dancing!

Perfect for short torso. I have a normal torso, but I felt like this gave me a constant wedgie.  It was very cute when I didn't bend down, but if I had to pick my kids up or any toys, I was having to readjust it.

I've rented this dress for three times. First two times were intentional. The third time was an accident (I rent another dress but that dress couldn't be delivered so I got this as my backup). 
Here are things I love:
- The material is on the thicker side. It's perfect for chilly spring/summer time in San Francisco (you don't need to bring an extra jacket with you). For the winter, just add a wool jacket and tight and you are good to go. 
- Even for 5' 2, this is a perfect length for attending events with cocktail dress code. (it hits on my knee perfectly). 
- I've worn this to a professional work gala, a wedding anniversary celebration, and company's christmas party. And everyone praised about the cape design. 
- the neckline is high enough to keep everything covers up but it's also a perfect backdrop for you to be creative to showcase any fashion statement necklace you have. I've matched it with layering necklaces, a bold fashion statement necklace, and string of pearls. the sky is the limited. 
- and it's perfect for those who have a big belly...my belly is not flat. it's a dome shape. it hides everything perfectly. If you really worry about it, you can size it up. (when I was 150 lb, size 12 was perfect. but when i was 170 lb, size 14 was the way to go).

Absolute winner. I wore this dress for a black tie wedding in May. It's ABSOLUTELY gorgeous in person - the color is so unique and fit like a glove. I'm 5'1" and I have an hourglass/petite/athletic figure. It definitely runs small and sucks you in a bit, so if you're uncomfortable in tight clothes, I'd say that's the only reason to reconsider. This is such a beautiful dress and I enjoyed every second of wearing it!
Love the style, cut did not agree w me Lovely style. The small was too broad in the shoulders and interestingly too narrow at the waist. This may be better suited for shorter waisted figures.

Dress was gorgeous overall, but had to go a size up due to the tightness in the rib cage area. I normally wear a size 4-6 in dresses, however, I had to go a size up to the 8R due to the tightness in the rib cage. The size 6R fit, I just was not comfortable in it. Due to sizing up, the 8R straps were a little loose and I had to get a friend to safety pin them in the back so it looked like part of the dress. Love the pockets of the dress, and overall I got many compliments on the dress. One other con was that even with double sided tape near the cleavage area, the material kept turning outward maybe from it being worn too much. Overall it was a great fit for the vineyard wedding in VA!

Amazing Dress - Tons of Compliments!!!! Gorgeous gorgeous gorgeous!!!  It definitely highlights your girls, so if you have any qualms about cleavage this is not the dress for you.  Fit like a glove, and the sequins made it forgiving - good for a post-baby body :)

Loved the ombre colors! The dress was VERY form fitting, as I expected.  However, some dresses that are form fitting hold you in, but this was not that type of dress... a pair of Spanx is definitely recommended!  Other than that, the color and length were perfect.  I received many compliments from other guests.

Loved!  It has pockets. If you are mindful of your chest being exposed, might not be the one for you I loved this dress. Especially because of its pockets. I bought literally every type of bra, stickies to see what worked and for a larger chest (I am double D's) I was amazed by Tidetell Strapless Deep V Wing Breast Pad Push-up Invisible Silicone Bra from Amazon.  It kept me perky all throughout the night and we danced all night.

Beautiful color This dress is very pretty and the material is great! It did seem to run a bit big on me, especially in the chest area. It also has a very plunging neck line and had to pin it. I would rent again, but would size down
I have never got more compliments in my life. Wore this twice and had no less than 20 random people approaching me about it.  Looks great with boots and a jean jacket!

Nice alternative to my original pick This isn't the dress I originally asked for. It was one of several "alternates" that RTR asked me to choose from. I wasn't sure about it. I liked the way it looked on the model but I thought it would be a knit jersey and was worried about it clinging to the wrong places. Instead, it was a stiffer fabric (maybe satin?) and was lined. It was much more structured and flattering than I expected. And a little bonus for the short ladies (I am 5' 1".) Initially, the waist fell below my natural waistline and was hard to zip. I did a little trick that changed everything (in a good way): I pulled the waist of the dress up to my natural waist and "bloused" the extra fabric. It worked out well and I liked the way it looked on me. One downside: The black fabric across the shoulders is see-through. I didn't have time or the budget to get a new bra. I wore a black bra and the straps were visible in front.

Worn for my bridal shower. I received lots of compliments in this dress! Fit a bit larger than I expected. I typically wear 0-2, and this 0 still fit a bit loose. Wardrobe tape is certainly needed to hold the lace down on the neckline.

Gorgeous royal blue, and pockets! I initially panicked when I received this dress because the top was WAY too big (I'm a DDD and this never happens). I did some pinning and I think the results work. The rest of the dress fit perfectly and was an amazing color. It also photographed great and I could wear a regular bra with it. I received so many compliments all night.

Stunning! Sexy but sophisticated I wore this on a date with my hubby to the Yayoi Kusama exhibit at the Seattle Art Museum. It is definitely sexy with the body contact shape, but the longer length and flounce skirt make it refined and respectable. I wore it to the office then out on the town. I usually wear a 0 or 2 and this for great, even for a bust of 32DDD (lots of stretch!). I do think the cut is probably more appropriate for taller figures (I'm 5'9") otherwise that hemline could overwhelm you. Looooove it!

Comfortable, stylish and fun! I rented this for a company party, and it was great! As many reviews mention, it runs big. I normally where a 10-12 or L in dresses, and really I could have probably pulled off a small. The medium was fine, just a little loose around the seem line at the 'waist.' It was easy to dress up with a statement necklace and great heels. I really enjoyed wearing it, got great compliments and had a blast at the party.

Engagement Pictures! I wore this dress for my engagement pictures.  It is a thick cream fabric which flatters well.  It was a little tight in the bust and waist for me, but that is a common challenge for me.  Overall I was very happy with the dress and would recommend it to others.

Beautiful, flattering dress I rented this dress for my engagement party and could not have been happier with it! As other reviews note, it runs a bit small so I ordered a size up (I usually wear a 4). I received so many compliments and felt great in it! Highly recommend.

Coziest sweater ever! I wore this sweater/coat for the holidays, and it was SO comfortable!  I loved wrapping myself in it and it looked great, too.  It is huge though!  I usually wear a large and got this in L, and it was like a big drapey bathrobe, which was part of the reason why I loved it, but made it a bit awkward to wear.  There are also no fasteners on the sweater, so you have to wear it open, which is why it makes a better sweater/coat than an actual coat.
Perfect! Rented this for my daughter's first HS Homecoming and she looked beautiful!

I wore this to my Engagement Photo Session. Fit: Perfect Fit. It ran long because there was no 0P, but because I wore 5" heels, it was fine. It still ran a little long, but I liked it.
Detail: This dress has a dark purple hue to it. It also has silver designs. It looks prettier in person.
*I ordered a backup, but didn't even try it on. This dress was perfect and I wish I could afford the retail price. I would wear this to every wedding if I could. Would rent from here again.

I wore this dress for my birthday dinner.  It was a very flattering and comfortable dress! This dress fit very well.  I couldn't have asked for a much better fit.  I usually wear a size 6 dress, but got a large in this dress based off of other people's comments and photos.  I rented the gold necklace that the model in the photo wore.  This really made the outfit pop.  My fiance loved this dress on me.  Heck, I loved this dress on me!  It is very low cut, so you need to be comfortable with your décolletage showing if you are going to rent this dress.  I wore a push up bra, which created more curves.  But you could keep it more modest by avoiding the push up bra.  The material and stretch made this dress very comfortable to wear.  I liked the length of it.  It was short, but not too short.  The cut was very flattering, too.  I wish I didn't have to return it!

Compliment Worthy Skirt I enjoyed wearing this skirt and would likely rent it again.  You could easily wear it with heels or flip flops - to the office or running errands. It attracted compliments from strangers because of how unique in style it was.

This dress was gorgeous.  I was practically the only person in red, I really stood out! This dress fit wonderful.  I absoutely loved it!  My boyfriend said I looked great, too.  :D
I would recommend this dress for sure!  I may even rent it again in red and/or blue.

This dress was fun, perfect for spring time and a pop of color amidst a lot of little black dresses! I thought the dress ran a bit bigger size wise, but wasn't complaining at all! I paired it with a pair of nude wedges and felt great all night. It was comfortable to wear to my sit-down dinner, as well as fun to dance in! I would absolutely rent it again.

Perfect pop of color This was actually sent as a backup, because my original order was returned damaged. I was a bit nervous about getting a dress with sleeves as the backup as it was a warm day spent on a rooftop for a party, but it ended up working out. Very comfortable, no-fuss dress. Color is much more vibrant in real life than it appears in the photos online.

The sequins are fab-u-lous!  Background:  Selected this gown for a black tie wedding in NYC and I knew this would be a high brow event.  Rather than pack up a long gown and then have to deal with steaming it (and giving up the packing room), this was the perfect solution.

Fit:  I ordered the dress in 6L and 8L because I am 5'9" and planned to wear 3 inch heels.  I usually wear an 8 waist, and the dress design was perfect to accommodate my 34DD bust.  Ended up going with  the 8L because the waist...  But agree that you should error to the small side, the 6L was only a little too snug.  The length hit the floor and did not leave any room to show shoes.

Wow:  Upon arrival I received compliments alllll night long!  One woman even commented that with my updo and gown I reminded her of Betty Draper (swoon!).  Definitely old word glamour. 

Other:  I ordered the necklace suggested but felt that it was too much icing on the already fabulous cake.  I recommend hair up with chandelier earrings, just enough class.

Wore to a Medical School Gala. Very flattering and comfortable, but runs large! I rented this dress for my Medical School's end of the year Gala. I loved the classic style and slimming shape. I have rented from RTR many times before and have always received my dresses on time, however this dress came ON THE DAY of my event. Thankfully it arrived and the customer service at RTR was great! I ordered a 44L (size 6-my normal dress size) and a 46L (8) and wore the 44L. If the dress had come earlier, on the day I wanted it, I would have had the 42L sent overnight, because I felt that the 44L was too big. The material is VERY stretchy and comfortable, so I suggest ordering your normal size and then a size down! I  had to wear flats with the Long.  This dress will be TOO SHORT if you are much taller than 5'10, because it barely touched the floor! Overall, I was very pleased with the quality and fit (received tons of compliments), I just wish I could have gotten the smaller size!

Loved the color of this dress! It's definitely a bit lighter than the photo shows. I typically wear a size 2 but wore the 6 in this dress (as I have in other E&J dresses too!). The fit was tight but the fabric is nice and thick so I still felt comfortable.! I would definitely rent this dress again!

unique dress, comfortable fit  Loved this dress! Wore it to a wedding in October with summer weather still going on so it was perfect. It doesn’t have much give, but true to size. Had a slight tear near the left shoulder, but because of the pattern in the fabric you couldn’t really tell.

Perfect summer shirt The shirt is really well-made, and the color is lovely. As others have mentioned, size UP. It's cut very short, and if I hadn't gotten the large, it would have hit me above the belly button.

Compliments all night Dress was perfect for the occasion.  It's not a form fitting dress, it's a shift dress so it's suppose to be somewhat loose.  However, I preferred it to be a bit tighter so I went down a dress size.  Loved it!

I had to put some tape on the back because I have short torso,  I had to put some tape on the back because I have short torso, and I am 5'2 130 lbs ( 5 months pregnant) and the dress looked  amazing!!!

AMAZING, so many compliments!!!!! So sad to send it back! Runs long, needed 3.5 inch heels even in the petite size. Also runs a little large! I would have gone with the 2p if it was available. Front slit and neckline make this dress so unique, the fabric felt like I was wearing a silk bathrobe all night (SO COMFORTABLE!!!).

I wore this dress to a military ball and loved it. It was my backup but it worked out perfectly. The length was perfect with 2.5 inch heels.  It was a little big on top, but not so much that I felt uncomfortable in it.
nice dress very cute dress - nice cut around arm hole - good length and suitable for different events

Perfect for summer! I wore this to my friend's wedding in July and it was great! I got so many compliments on how cute it was and how great the color looked. It certainly was larger than I expected, so I had to pull up the back a few times because it would go below my bra. I am 5'7 and 135 pounds and normally wear small/medium. I got a small but still should have sized down to an extra small so I didn't have to worry about it sliding down every once in a while.

Wore this for Diner En Blanc in DC. The original dress I ordered didn't fit me quite right. Luckily, I had done in store pick up. The RTR staff were very helpful in finding me a different dress to swap. This dress was a little too big, but it did okay in a pinch. I wish it had come one size down, as that probably would have looked slightly better. 

Pros: Gorgeous dress, interesting fabric, lots of compliments.
Cons: Fabric was a little heavy and not the greatest for a fairly warm evening.

Channeling my inner Claire Underwood. This was my 3rd RTR dress and my favorite thus far-- even though it was a backup choice. The material was forgiving and flattering with a cute little peekaboo to keep it from being *too* conservative. I'm 5'3'' with a short torso and this hit me right beneath the knee which made me feel tall (yay!) I received so many compliments and will definitely rent this dress again.
Stunning and sophisticated  Love all la petite robe di chiara boni, if you like a fitted no zipper dress, this is for you.

Perfect New Years Eve birthday dress! This dress is beautiful and fun and I got so many compliments! The color has a red tint which would work with red shoes and is a more silver than it looks in some pictures. I ordered a S and XS and went with the XS which fit perfectly (I usually wear a 2 or 4). Because of the sequins, my arms got caught on the dress at times and I would have to pull it apart, but it wasn't too annoying. I wish I could buy this dress -it was perfect for a new years eve birthday! Another very successful RTR experience!

I rented this for Christmas It is a beautiful jumpsuit, but the sleeves kept lifting up, so that was a little bit annoying! I did not get a chance to take photos as the day past by too quickly. Overall, the jumpsuit was comfortable and I would rent it again.

Probably the most beautiful dress I've ever worn.  I kept getting compliments all night long! I thought that the dress fit perfectly but was a bit long.  At one point in the night I had to take off my heels (feet hurt too bad) and the dress dragged on the floor a bit.  Very comfortable dress and I felt great wearing it.
Cute but a little awkward fit Too short waisted - and the sweater part was pilling which made it look a bit tired

Perfect small-town Vermont wedding I'm a very consistent 6, and this dress was no exception...the cap-sleeves were a little restricting (in terms of dancing), and at 5'5", the dress was *almost* too long with 3" heels. I had to be really cognizant of the back of the dress to make sure I wasn't catching it on one of my heels. But I really loved the dress! I got compliments on it all night, and the pattern was so perfect for a fall wedding in Vermont. It was unlike anything I've worn before!

One of a kind, but SUPER small I wore this for my friends bachelorette party. I usually wear a small in dresses, but ordered a medium based on the reviews. I was going to get a large as a back-up, but they were out of stock. The medium fit VERY tight, to the point that I wasn't sure I would be able sit. RTRW was out of all the backup dresses I liked, so I had to go with the too-tight dress. It looked good and I got tons of compliments, but it would have looked better and been more enjoyable if it wasn't so tight. Order your bigger backup size + two sizes bigger on this one!
Not my style. Didn't end up wearing. Also, runs small. Didn't like how it looked on me. Also, ran small.

love this as a short gal!!! i'm typically a 2 or 4, but always a 2 in trina turk. this fit perfectly all around. i'm only 5'3" but was able to wear this w flats and heels so great for day to night. the band hit right above my hip and was extremely comfortable the entire day. did not wrinkle, great color, can be worn with a strapless bra or bra less. reg bra doesn't work because it cuts in a bit. v easy to get out of for a jumpsuit since it's just one zipper and a little tab. pockets are extremely useful useful. a great necklace really pulls this look together! highly highly recommend
Great fit Like others have mentioned E&J runs a little small.  I am a size 2 and the 4 was perfect.  I wouldn't size up anymore than one size as there is enough stretch in the fabric.  Great dress!
Was able to receive my replacement dress in plenty of time for the event. Also, no one else had it. Loved the dress but was unable to get it in the correct size I needed which would have been a 14.

IN LOVE WITH THIS DRESS!!!! I wore this to a wedding.  I rented 2R and 4R as backup, ended up wearing the 4R cause the back wouldn't zip up on the 2R and i didn't wanna mess up the zipper.  Very Elegant, Beautiful color, perfect length.  I wish i could buy it.  Will definitely order it again along with it's "red" sister style :-)

Great maxi for us tall girls. I really scored with my cruise picks from RTR Unlimited. I am not a huge fan of maxi dresses as they typically run short on my and I'm not always thrilled with the style in general. When I saw this dress though I knew it would be a great fit for one of my casual cruise dinners and I am a sucker for cut outs. First things first, I really wish I had sized down to a small. The dress doesn't have any give but I wouldn't say it 'runs large' like some of the other reviews. I'm typically a 4 (sometimes a 6) and thought it was a touch loose in the waist. Next, the dress came really wrinkly. It's evident that its the material and not really RTRs fault. I used a mini steamer on it and the wrinkles came out immediately.

I got loads of compliments on this number. At 5 foot almost 11 this dress just touched the top of my feet. I enjoyed that I wasn't tripping on it and people could see my sandals. The slip under the top layer of the dress was not too short (a first for me) and the pink is a real bright coral color. I would buy this dress in a heart beat if it was still summer as the price is actually not too shabby. No pockets on this number though ladies and a sticky bra or petals is a must. I also recommend nude underwear even with the slip.
It was a beautiful dress, perfect for a wedding. A great fit but very low cut.

Fancy Boho  I received this dress as a backup dress when my ideal style wasn't available. It fit well, it was VERY low cut but I also didn't fill it out well. It was a much higher quality dress and fabric than I expected based off the picture and was actually quite impressed though it wasn't my style.
This dress was great an comfortable for the outside evening event I attended.  The dress does run large. I probably could have worn a 10 or pinned it for more shape. The bead work is beautiful.

WOW dress!  I got so many compliments on this dress - the sleeves add just enough flair and the nice cut on the legs are a beautiful detail too. It made for the perfect dress for a wedding! I ordered a size up from what I typically wear but found the hips could have been taken in just a smidge if it was a dress I owned.

Fun for daytime I rented this for my grandma's birthday - we all wore blue for family photos. I was unsure, because I hadn't worn a romper as an adult, but it worked well. I ended up not wearing a bra, because of the way the straps are, as well as the open area in the back, but you could wear a strapless bra and pin the opening in the back closed with no issue. The torso was a little bit long for me - the crotch hung a bit lower than I wanted it to - but since the fit is pretty flowy, it worked out fine. It also fit my sister very well - she's 5'10" and the 12R fit her just fine. For her we ended up pinning the opening in the back so her bra wouldn't show. It was comfortable for both of us to wear all day. (12R on left, 10R on right)

I Liked the Concept I really liked the idea of this dress - the fabrication and the layering - but I wouldn't wear it twice.  The fit was off; the straps just kept falling off my shoulders - you may need a longer torso for this style.  It really wasn't flattering on me and the length was not quite long enough.  I wore a bra (though you don't really need to if you are similar in size) but my bra straps showed (which may bother some women).  Overall, it was just a lot of effort to wear this dress.

Perfect for black tie wedding!  This was my backup dress, but I loved it! Very flattering fit, especially for one shoulder. Got tons of compliments. The ruffle detail on the shoulder was the perfect pop to make it stand out from just a regular black dress. Highly recommend!
Strange shoulders This did not fit through my shoulders. I do have broad shoulders so that may be it.

Perfect for Vegas I wore this in Vegas for a bachelorette party, and it was perfect.  I was concerned I would be too warm with the long sleeves, but everything is so air conditioned that it worked out!  The dress fit like a glove, and was so comfortable.  It's short, but not obscenely so.  I usually wear a 6 and this was true to size.  Felt like a million bucks all night - would definitely rent again!
Drop dead beautiful.   Wore this to my engagement party.  Total hit.  Felt like the prettiest one there, as I should, I was the bride! ;)

Holiday party! I really enjoyed this dress. I think it ran slightly large. I tend to wear a 2 or 4 and the 2 definitely fit better. It does have 2 slits in the front which hit me about 3 inches above the knee, well below my fingertips so not too risqué. The slits however did make the dress a little challenging to sit in without exposing too much. The dress was just above the ground with 2-3 inch heels on me. The back is great, shows some skin without dipping too low. I don't think a bra is totally necessary, but I did wear my NuBra. The color was great as well, a really nice, deep royal blue. Would definitely recommend!

A Christmas Party The dress is of high quality and I got compliments all night! It is truly beautiful. It is not as jewel toned blue as I expected. It is more navy. I found that it runs a tad large. I am usually in between a 2 and 4 but the 4 was sold out. I wore the 2 and it fit perfect.

Beautiful color and lovely drape.  Simple and easy-fitting.   The dress fit loosely enough to be easily comfortable all night.  I waiver between M & L (because of wide hips/thighs) and I easily wore the M without shape wear.  It hit me just above knee length and I wore a normal bra (although had to be careful that the back didn't show, as you can see slightly in the back picture I posted - fashion tape would have been a good idea to hold it down, I guess).  I found it an easy wear for a summer night, with just enough detail (color and back drape) to make it interesting.
Wish I ordered a smaller size. This was too big everywhere for me.  the hooks in the front kept opening up.

Beautiful color and wound rent again! The color of the dress was stunning and perfect for a formal dinner. The dress doesn't have a lot of stretch though, so not super comfortable up top. Would recommend going up a size, I did.  There is a built in slip under the dress, so no need to wear one.
I felt amazing in this dress. If I could, I would wear it everyday! I rented this dress for a "black tie invited" wedding. It fit like a glove, and I received so many compliments on it!

Sexy and flattering and wearable This was a little hard to shimmy on (no fastenings, you literally pull it on over your head), but the fabric and the ruching combine to make it SO flattering and dead sexy.  Heavy fabric and a SNUG fit hold you in and its definitely form fitting.  This was my back up so I didn't end up wearing it, but I definitely strolled around the house to show off to my husband.  Don't even need a bra if you are smaller chested.  Beautiful and easy to wear for a formal gown.
